sentences.en: A senior official from the ministry met with local business owners to discuss the new tax rules.
sentences.zh: 部會的一位高層官員和當地企業主會面，討論新的稅法規定。

sentences.en: According to a city official, the new subway line will open to passengers in December.
sentences.zh: 根據一位市府官員的說法，新的捷運線將在十二月開放乘客搭乘。

sentences.en: The company hired a former official from the Ministry of Finance as its new legal adviser.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位前財政部官員擔任新的法律顧問。

sentences.en: Every visitor must be accompanied by an official from the factory during the safety inspection.
sentences.zh: 安全檢查期間，每位訪客都必須由工廠的負責人員陪同。

words.note: 語塊：government official（政府官員）、senior official（高層官員）、former official（前官員）、city official（市府官員）。official 當形容詞是「正式的、官方的」（official website 官網、official announcement 正式公告）；當名詞是「官員」。別搞混 officer（軍官、警官；公司的高階主管）和 office（辦公室）。

words.meaning: 專業精神；專業表現；敬業態度

sentences.en: Our clients often say they appreciate the professionalism of our staff, especially their quick and polite responses.
sentences.zh: 客戶常說很欣賞我們員工的專業，特別是他們回覆又快又有禮貌。

sentences.en: We can always rely on their professionalism, even when deadlines are very tight and the work is difficult.
sentences.zh: 即使期限很趕、工作很難，我們也總是可以信賴他們的專業。

sentences.en: The hotel manager praised the team for their professionalism and patience during the very busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 飯店經理稱讚團隊在忙碌的假期旺季中表現專業又有耐心。

sentences.en: Dressing neatly and arriving on time are simple ways to show professionalism at a job interview.
sentences.zh: 穿著整齊、準時到，是面試時展現專業的簡單方法。

sentences.en: Customers often judge a company's professionalism by how quickly it answers emails and phone calls.
sentences.zh: 顧客常常用回信和接電話的速度，來判斷一家公司夠不夠專業。

words.note: 語塊：rely on someone's professionalism（信賴某人的專業）、show／demonstrate professionalism（展現專業）、a high level of professionalism（高度專業）。⚠️ 多益常考詞性：their／his 後面要接名詞 professionalism；professional 是形容詞（a professional attitude）或「專業人士」（a professional）。

sentences.en: Please check the travel itinerary carefully and let us know if you need to change any flight times.
sentences.zh: 請仔細確認旅遊行程表，如果需要改任何航班時間請告訴我們。

sentences.en: The tour company sent each guest a detailed itinerary listing all hotels, meals, and activities for the trip.
sentences.zh: 旅行社寄給每位旅客一份詳細行程表，列出這趟旅程所有的飯店、餐點和活動。

sentences.en: Our assistant will finalize the itinerary for the sales trip to Japan by Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們的助理會在週五下午前確定日本業務出差的行程。

sentences.en: The itinerary includes a factory visit in Osaka and a meeting with clients in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 行程包括參觀大阪的工廠，以及和東京的客戶開會。

sentences.en: Due to the typhoon, the airline had to change the itinerary for all passengers flying to Okinawa.
sentences.zh: 因為颱風，航空公司必須更改所有飛往沖繩旅客的行程。

words.note: 語塊：travel itinerary（旅遊行程表）、a detailed itinerary（詳細行程）、plan／finalize an itinerary（規劃／確定行程）、The itinerary includes…（行程包括……）。和 schedule 的差別：schedule 是一般的時間表；itinerary 專指旅行或出差的路線和行程。發音 ai-TIN-uh-rair-ee。

sentences.en: The new pizza pans are thirty centimeters in diameter, which is perfect for family-size orders.
sentences.zh: 新的披薩烤盤直徑三十公分，很適合家庭號的訂單。

sentences.en: Please measure the diameter of each pipe before ordering any replacement parts from our main supplier.
sentences.zh: 向我們的主要供應商訂替換零件前，請先量好每根水管的直徑。

sentences.en: The company makes metal wheels that are about fifty centimeters in diameter for delivery carts.
sentences.zh: 這家公司生產直徑大約五十公分的金屬輪子，用在送貨推車上。

sentences.en: The diameter of the round meeting table is two meters, so it can seat up to ten people.
sentences.zh: 圓形會議桌的直徑是兩公尺，最多可以坐十個人。

sentences.en: Our engineers increased the diameter of the cooling fan to make the machine run more quietly.
sentences.zh: 我們的工程師加大了散熱風扇的直徑，讓機器運轉得更安靜。

words.note: 語塊：… centimeters in diameter（直徑……公分）、the diameter of＋東西（……的直徑）。相關字：radius（半徑）、circumference（圓周）、perimeter（周長）。dia＝穿過，meter＝測量 → 穿過圓心量的長度。

words.meaning: 警告；提醒（注意危險或問題）

sentences.en: Please warn new employees about the wet floor near the kitchen entrance before they start work.
sentences.zh: 新員工開始上班前，請提醒他們廚房入口附近地板很濕。

sentences.en: The manager asked us to warn customers that the store will close early on Friday.
sentences.zh: 經理請我們提醒顧客，店週五會提早關門。

sentences.en: Signs at the factory warn visitors not to touch any machines without a staff member present.
sentences.zh: 工廠裡的告示警告訪客，沒有員工在場時不要碰任何機器。

sentences.en: Our system will automatically warn you of any unusual or suspicious activity on your online bank account.
sentences.zh: 我們的系統會在你的網路銀行帳戶有異常或可疑活動時自動警告你。

sentences.en: Experts warn that rising shipping costs could increase the price of imported goods next year.
sentences.zh: 專家警告，運費上漲可能讓明年進口商品的價格上升。

words.note: 語塊：warn＋人＋about／of＋事情（提醒某人注意……）、warn＋人＋(not) to＋動詞（警告某人（不要）做……）、warn that＋句子（警告說……）。名詞 warning（警告），例如 a warning sign（警告標誌）。發音 [wɔrn]，跟 worn（穿過的）一樣，和 warm（溫暖的）不同。

words.meaning: （電影的）放映；（展覽的）展出；（房屋的）看屋

sentences.en: More than two hundred guests attended a special showing of the new film at the downtown theater.
sentences.zh: 兩百多位來賓參加了市中心戲院這部新電影的特別放映會。

sentences.en: The real estate agent arranged a private showing of the apartment for the young couple on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 房仲週六幫這對年輕夫妻安排私人看屋。

sentences.en: The museum offers a free showing of the documentary every Sunday afternoon in the main hall.
sentences.zh: 博物館每週日下午在大廳免費播放這部紀錄片。

sentences.en: After the first showing sold out, the theater added three more screenings for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 第一場放映賣光後，戲院週末又加開了三場。

sentences.en: Please arrive early for the house showing because the owners will leave at four o'clock.
sentences.zh: 看屋請提早到，因為屋主四點就要離開。

words.note: 語塊：attend a showing（參加放映會／看屋）、a special／private showing（特別／私人放映、看屋）、a house／property showing（看房子）。和 screening 很像（電影放映），showing 還可以用在房屋買賣和展覽。

words.meaning: 房屋貸款；房貸；抵押貸款

sentences.en: The young couple applied for a mortgage to buy their first apartment near the train station.
sentences.zh: 這對年輕夫妻申請房貸，要買他們在火車站附近的第一間公寓。

sentences.en: Our bank offers low interest rates for customers who take out a mortgage before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 年底前申辦房貸的客戶，我們銀行提供低利率。

sentences.en: After twenty years of monthly payments, Mr. Lin finally paid off his mortgage last spring.
sentences.zh: 每個月繳了二十年，林先生終於在去年春天還清房貸。

sentences.en: Rising interest rates have made mortgage payments more expensive for many families in the city.
sentences.zh: 利率上升讓這座城市很多家庭的房貸月付金變得更貴。

sentences.en: Before applying, please prepare your salary records, since the bank will review them for the mortgage.
sentences.zh: 申請前請準備好薪資證明，因為銀行會審核這些資料來決定房貸。

words.note: 語塊：apply for a mortgage（申請房貸）、take out a mortgage（辦房貸）、pay off a mortgage（還清房貸）、mortgage payments（房貸月付）。⚠️ 發音：t 不發音，唸 MOR-gij。和 loan 的差別：loan 是一般貸款，mortgage 專指用房子抵押的貸款。

words.meaning: 情勢的轉變；事情的（意外）發展

sentences.en: Given this turn of events, the company has decided to delay the opening of its new store.
sentences.zh: 考慮到情勢的轉變，公司決定延後新店開幕。

sentences.en: In a surprising turn of events, the smaller firm won the contract over its biggest rival.
sentences.zh: 出乎意料的是，這家較小的公司打敗最大的對手拿下合約。

sentences.en: The sudden turn of events forced the airline to cancel all flights to the island.
sentences.zh: 突如其來的變化，迫使航空公司取消所有飛往這座島的班機。

sentences.en: Nobody expected this turn of events when the construction project first started two years ago in March.
sentences.zh: 兩年前三月工程剛開始時，沒有人料到事情會這樣發展。

sentences.en: After an unexpected turn of events, the CEO announced that she would retire at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 在一連串意外的變化之後，執行長宣布她將在月底退休。

words.note: 語塊：given this turn of events（考慮到情勢的轉變）、in a surprising／an unexpected turn of events（出乎意料地）、a sudden turn of events（突然的變化）。turn＝轉彎，事情突然「轉彎」，往意想不到的方向發展。注意 events 要用複數。

words.meaning: （訊號、聲音、引擎）突然中斷、斷掉；戒掉（某種食物）；剪下

sentences.en: My phone signal tends to cut out whenever I take the train through the tunnel near the station.
sentences.zh: 每次搭火車經過車站附近的隧道，我的手機訊號就容易斷掉。

sentences.en: The sound began to cut out during the video conference, so we had to call the client back.
sentences.zh: 視訊會議時聲音開始斷斷續續，所以我們只好再回撥給客戶。

sentences.en: The engine of the delivery truck suddenly cut out on the highway, causing a long delay.
sentences.zh: 送貨卡車的引擎在高速公路上突然熄火，造成很長的延誤。

sentences.en: The doctor advised Mr. Chen to cut out sugary drinks to improve his health and lose weight.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議陳先生戒掉含糖飲料，改善健康也減重。

sentences.en: If the Wi-Fi connection continues to cut out, please contact our technical support team for help.
sentences.zh: 如果無線網路還是一直斷線，請聯絡我們的技術支援團隊。

words.note: 語塊：the signal／sound／connection cuts out（訊號／聲音／連線斷掉）、the engine cuts out（引擎熄火）、cut out sugar／junk food（戒掉糖／垃圾食物）。和 cut off 很像：cut off 是「被切斷」（The call was cut off），cut out 常指「自己時有時無、斷斷續續」。

words.meaning: 類似那樣的；差不多那個意思；那一類的

sentences.en: We need a catchy slogan, something like "Fresh Every Day" or something along those lines.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一句好記的標語，像「天天新鮮」，或類似那樣的。

sentences.en: The client wants a modern logo with blue and green colors, or something along those lines.
sentences.zh: 客戶想要一個藍綠色的現代感標誌，或差不多那種感覺的。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee suggested offering free delivery or a small gift, or anything else along those lines.
sentences.zh: 李小姐建議提供免運或小禮物，或其他類似的東西。

sentences.en: If you have any other ideas along those lines, please share them at Friday's marketing meeting.
sentences.zh: 如果你有其他類似的點子，請在週五的行銷會議上分享。

sentences.en: The manager said the budget might be cut by ten percent, or something along those lines.
sentences.zh: 經理說預算可能會砍一成左右，大概是那樣。

words.note: 語塊：something along those lines（類似那樣的東西）、or something along those lines（……之類的，放句尾）、ideas along those lines（類似的點子）。口語超常用，說話時不確定細節、只是舉個例子時用。也可以說 along these lines（類似這樣的）。

sentences.en: A street vendor near the station sells hot sweet potatoes and fresh juice every morning.
sentences.zh: 車站附近有個攤販每天早上賣烤地瓜和新鮮果汁。

sentences.en: The company is looking for a reliable software vendor to update its online ordering system.
sentences.zh: 公司正在找一家可靠的軟體廠商，來更新網路訂購系統。

sentences.en: Each food vendor at the night market must have a valid license from the city government.
sentences.zh: 夜市的每個小吃攤販都必須有市政府核發的有效執照。

sentences.en: Please compare the prices from at least three suppliers before choosing a vendor for the office chairs.
sentences.zh: 選定辦公椅的廠商前，請先比較至少三家供應商的價格。

sentences.en: The festival organizers will charge each vendor a small fee to set up a booth in the park.
sentences.zh: 活動主辦單位會向每個攤商收一點費用，讓他們在公園擺攤。

words.note: 語塊：street vendor（路邊攤販）、food vendor（小吃攤）、software vendor（軟體廠商）、choose a vendor（選定廠商）。和 supplier 很像：supplier 偏「供應原料、貨物給公司的人」，vendor 範圍更廣，路邊賣東西的小販也算。動詞 vend＝販賣，vending machine＝自動販賣機。

words.meaning: 複雜的情況；（意外的）問題；（醫學）併發症

sentences.en: The project was delayed because of an unexpected complication with the building permit for the new warehouse.
sentences.zh: 因為新倉庫的建築許可出了意外的問題，專案延誤了。

sentences.en: The surgery went smoothly, and the doctor said there was no sign of any complication afterward.
sentences.zh: 手術很順利，醫生說之後沒有任何併發症的跡象。

sentences.en: Bad weather added another complication to the already difficult task of delivering supplies to the island.
sentences.zh: 把物資送到島上本來就很難，壞天氣又讓情況更複雜。

sentences.en: If any complication arises during the software installation, please call our technical support team immediately.
sentences.zh: 安裝軟體時如果發生任何問題，請立刻打電話給我們的技術支援團隊。

sentences.en: Changing suppliers at the last minute could create a serious complication for our production schedule.
sentences.zh: 最後一刻更換供應商，可能會讓我們的生產時程出大問題。

words.note: 語塊：an unexpected complication（意外的問題）、a complication arises（出現問題）、cause／create complications（造成麻煩）、complications from surgery（手術併發症）。動詞 complicate（使複雜），形容詞 complicated（複雜的）。長很像的字：compilation（彙編）、compliment（讚美）。

words.meaning: 執行；實施；落實（計畫、政策、系統）

sentences.en: The company will implement a new security system in all of its offices next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月會在所有辦公室導入新的保全系統。

sentences.en: It took the team six months to fully implement the changes recommended by the consultants.
sentences.zh: 團隊花了六個月才完全落實顧問建議的改變。

sentences.en: The government plans to implement a new policy to reduce plastic waste in restaurants and convenience stores.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫實施新政策，減少餐廳和便利商店的塑膠垃圾。

sentences.en: Before we implement the new schedule, please collect feedback from all of the employees involved.
sentences.zh: 在實施新班表之前，請先收集所有相關員工的意見。

sentences.en: The manager asked Ms. Wu to implement the marketing plan as soon as the budget was approved.
sentences.zh: 經理請吳小姐在預算一核准就馬上執行行銷計畫。

words.note: 語塊：implement a plan／policy／system（執行計畫／實施政策／導入系統）、implement changes（落實改變）、fully implement（完全落實）。名詞 implementation（實施、執行）。⚠️ 別和 imply（暗示）搞混。同義詞 carry out（執行），implement 比較正式，多益和公司文件很常見。

sentences.en: The new dress code will be applied uniformly to all employees, including managers and part-time staff.
sentences.zh: 新的服裝規定會一律適用於所有員工，包括主管和兼職人員。

sentences.en: Please spread the glue uniformly across the entire surface before attaching the wooden panels to the wall.
sentences.zh: 把木板貼到牆上之前，請把膠均勻地塗滿整個表面。

sentences.en: The heater is designed to warm the whole room uniformly, so no corner feels cold.
sentences.zh: 這台暖氣機的設計能讓整個房間均勻變暖，每個角落都不會冷。

sentences.en: Discounts must be offered uniformly in every branch across the country to avoid confusing our customers.
sentences.zh: 全國每家分店的折扣都必須一致，以免讓顧客搞混。

sentences.en: The workers painted the walls uniformly so that the color looked the same from every angle.
sentences.zh: 工人把牆壁漆得很均勻，從每個角度看顏色都一樣。

words.note: 語塊：be applied uniformly（一律適用）、spread uniformly（塗／分布得很均勻）、uniformly distributed（平均分布）。uni（一）＋form（形狀）＝都是同一個樣子；制服 uniform 就是「大家穿一樣」。同義詞：evenly（均勻地）、consistently（一致地）。

sentences.en: All new employees must sign a confidentiality agreement before they are allowed to access any customer records.
sentences.zh: 所有新員工都必須先簽保密協議，才能查看任何客戶資料。

sentences.en: Our law firm takes client confidentiality very seriously and never shares information with outside parties.
sentences.zh: 我們律師事務所非常重視客戶資料保密，從不把資訊透露給外部人士。

sentences.en: To maintain confidentiality, please do not discuss the merger with anyone outside the project team.
sentences.zh: 為了保密，請不要和專案團隊以外的人談論合併的事。

sentences.en: The hospital uses a secure system to protect patient confidentiality when sending medical reports to other doctors.
sentences.zh: 醫院把病歷寄給其他醫生時，會用安全的系統保護病人隱私。

sentences.en: Because of confidentiality rules, the manager could not share the candidate's salary details with us.
sentences.zh: 因為保密規定，經理不能告訴我們應徵者的薪資細節。

words.note: 語塊：confidentiality agreement（保密協議，也叫 NDA）、maintain／protect confidentiality（保密）、client／patient confidentiality（客戶／病人資料保密）。形容詞 confidential（機密的），例如 confidential documents（機密文件）。⚠️ 別和 confidence（信心）搞混。

words.meaning: 試鏡；試演；（樂團、表演的）甄選

sentences.en: More than three hundred singers attended the open audition for the new television talent show last Saturday.
sentences.zh: 上週六有三百多位歌手參加了新電視選秀節目的公開試鏡。

sentences.en: She practiced every evening for two months before her final audition for the national symphony orchestra.
sentences.zh: 她在國家交響樂團最後一輪甄選前，每天晚上練習了兩個月。

sentences.en: The theater company will hold an audition next Monday to find actors for its holiday musical.
sentences.zh: 劇團下週一會舉辦試鏡，為節慶音樂劇找演員。

sentences.en: Applicants who pass the first audition will be invited to perform again in front of the director.
sentences.zh: 通過第一輪試鏡的人，會被邀請在導演面前再表演一次。

sentences.en: Please bring a recent photo and your résumé when you arrive for the audition at nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 九點來試鏡時，請帶一張近照和你的履歷。

words.note: 語塊：hold an audition（舉辦試鏡）、go to／attend an audition（去試鏡）、pass the audition（通過試鏡）、audition for＋角色（為……試鏡，這時 audition 是動詞）。字根 aud＝聽（audio、audience），原本是「表演給評審聽」。

sentences.en: The young actor got a small part in a commercial for a popular sports drink.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕演員在一支熱門運動飲料的廣告裡演了一個小角色。

sentences.en: Our company spent over one million dollars to film a television commercial for the new car.
sentences.zh: 我們公司花了一百多萬元幫新車拍電視廣告。

sentences.en: The new commercial will be shown on national television during the baseball finals next weekend.
sentences.zh: 新廣告下週末會在棒球總冠軍賽期間於全國電視播出。

sentences.en: Many viewers remembered the funny commercial and shared it with their friends on social media.
sentences.zh: 很多觀眾記得那支好笑的廣告，還在社群媒體上分享給朋友。

sentences.en: Ms. Wang was hired to write the script for a thirty-second radio commercial about the bank's new loans.
sentences.zh: 王小姐受聘為銀行新貸款方案寫一支三十秒廣播廣告的腳本。

words.note: 語塊：TV／radio commercial（電視／廣播廣告）、a part in a commercial（在廣告中的角色）、film／shoot a commercial（拍廣告）。和 advertisement 的差別：commercial 專指電視、廣播、影片的廣告；advertisement 範圍更廣，報紙、海報、網路廣告都算。commercial 當形容詞是「商業的」（commercial building 商業大樓）。

sentences.en: Customers can place their orders on a tablet at each table instead of waiting for a server.
sentences.zh: 客人可以用每張桌上的平板點餐，不用等服務生。

sentences.en: Every sales representative will receive a new tablet to show product videos and price lists to clients.
sentences.zh: 每位業務代表都會拿到一台新平板，用來給客戶看產品影片和價目表。

sentences.en: Please take one tablet twice a day after meals for seven days, and drink plenty of water.
sentences.zh: 請連續七天，每天兩次飯後吃一顆藥，並多喝水。

sentences.en: The hotel provides a tablet in each room so guests can order room service and book tours.
sentences.zh: 飯店每間房都有一台平板，房客可以點客房服務、預約導覽。

sentences.en: Our new app works on both a smartphone and a tablet, so you can study anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我們的新 App 在手機和平板上都能用，隨時隨地都能讀書。

words.note: 語塊：on a tablet（在平板上）、tablet computer（平板電腦）、take a tablet（吃一顆藥）。tablet 有兩個意思：①平板電腦（像 iPad）②藥片、錠劑（＝pill）。長很像的字：tabloid（八卦小報）。

sentences.en: The television station will air the new commercial during the evening news starting next Monday.
sentences.zh: 電視台從下週一開始，會在晚間新聞時段播出新廣告。

sentences.en: The company plans to air its holiday advertisement on three major television channels throughout December.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫整個十二月在三家主要電視台播出節慶廣告。

sentences.en: Due to the typhoon coverage, the network decided not to air the cooking show this week.
sentences.zh: 因為颱風新聞報導，電視台決定這週不播出料理節目。

sentences.en: Radio stations across the country will air the president's important speech live at nine on Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 全國的廣播電台會在週五早上九點現場播出總統的重要演說。

sentences.en: We need final approval from the client before we can air the thirty-second commercial on television.
sentences.zh: 我們要先拿到客戶的最後核准，才能在電視上播出這支三十秒廣告。

words.note: 語塊：air a commercial／show（播出廣告／節目）、be aired on TV（在電視上播出）、air live（現場直播）。air 名詞是「空氣」，當動詞是「播出」，因為節目是透過電波「放到空中」傳出去。on air＝正在播出中。

words.meaning: 換句話說；改寫（用自己的話重新表達）

sentences.en: Good paraphrasing skills help students and office workers explain difficult ideas clearly in their own words.
sentences.zh: 好的改寫能力，能幫學生和上班族用自己的話把難懂的概念說清楚。

sentences.en: By paraphrasing the customer's complaint, the agent showed that she had listened carefully and understood the problem.
sentences.zh: 客服人員把顧客的抱怨用自己的話重說一遍，表示她有仔細聽、也了解問題。

sentences.en: The training course includes a short lesson on paraphrasing so that reports do not copy other sources.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程有一堂簡短的改寫課，避免報告直接抄別人的內容。

sentences.en: Simple paraphrasing is not enough; you must also include the original source in your reference list.
sentences.zh: 光是改寫還不夠，你也必須在參考資料裡列出原本的出處。

sentences.en: Our editor is very good at paraphrasing long technical documents into short and easy summaries for clients.
sentences.zh: 我們的編輯很擅長把冗長的技術文件改寫成簡短好懂的摘要給客戶。

words.note: 語塊：paraphrasing skills（改寫能力）、by paraphrasing＋內容（透過換句話說）、paraphrase in your own words（用自己的話說）。動詞 paraphrase（改寫、換句話說）。para（旁邊）＋phrase（說法）＝換個說法。多益閱讀和聽力很常考「換句話說」：答案常常是原文的 paraphrase，不會一字不差。

sentences.en: Applicants must have a university diploma and at least two years of experience in sales.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須有大學文憑，並有至少兩年業務經驗。

sentences.en: She received her high school diploma at the age of seventeen and then moved to Taipei.
sentences.zh: 她十七歲拿到高中畢業證書，之後搬到台北。

sentences.en: Please bring a copy of your diploma and your passport to the job interview on Monday.
sentences.zh: 週一面試時，請帶畢業證書影本和護照。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin holds a diploma in hotel management from a well-known hospitality school in Switzerland.
sentences.zh: 林先生有瑞士一所知名餐旅學校的飯店管理文憑。

sentences.en: The university will mail each graduate's diploma within six weeks after the graduation ceremony in June.
sentences.zh: 大學會在六月畢業典禮後六週內，把畢業證書寄給每位畢業生。

words.note: 語塊：university／high school diploma（大學／高中畢業證書）、receive a diploma（拿到畢業證書）、hold a diploma in＋科目（有……的文憑）。和 degree 的差別：degree 是「學位」本身（bachelor's degree 學士、master's degree 碩士），diploma 是證明你畢業的那張「證書」。doctorate 是博士學位。

sentences.en: The company hired an independent auditing firm to review its financial records for the past three years.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一家獨立的會計師事務所，審核過去三年的財務紀錄。

sentences.en: Internal auditing helps managers find mistakes in company spending before they become serious financial problems.
sentences.zh: 內部稽核能幫主管在公司支出的錯誤變成嚴重財務問題之前就發現。

sentences.en: Ms. Kao has more than ten years of experience in auditing and accounting for large banks.
sentences.zh: 高小姐有十多年替大型銀行做審計和會計的經驗。

sentences.en: The auditing process usually takes about four weeks and requires full access to all sales records.
sentences.zh: 審計流程通常大約需要四週，而且要能查看所有銷售紀錄。

sentences.en: All branches must follow the new auditing standards that were introduced by the head office in January.
sentences.zh: 所有分公司都必須遵守總公司一月推出的新稽核標準。

words.note: 語塊：auditing firm（會計師事務所、審計公司）、internal auditing（內部稽核）、the auditing process（審計流程）。動詞／名詞 audit（審計、查帳），做審計的人是 auditor（稽核員、審計師）。⚠️ 別和 audition（試鏡）搞混，兩個都來自 aud（聽）。美式口語 audit a class 是「旁聽一門課」。

words.meaning: 修剪；剪短；削減（成本、預算）；精簡

sentences.en: The gardener will trim the bushes in front of the office building every two weeks.
sentences.zh: 園丁每兩週會修剪辦公大樓前的灌木叢。

sentences.en: To stay within budget, the company plans to trim travel costs by twenty percent next year.
sentences.zh: 為了不超出預算，公司計畫明年把差旅費削減兩成。

sentences.en: Please trim the report to two pages so the directors can read it before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 請把報告精簡到兩頁，讓董事們在開會前看完。

sentences.en: The hair salon offers a quick free service to trim customers' bangs between their regular appointments.
sentences.zh: 這家美髮店提供快速的免費修瀏海服務，客人在兩次預約之間都可以來。

sentences.en: The restaurant decided to trim its menu and focus on its ten most popular dishes.
sentences.zh: 餐廳決定精簡菜單，專心做最受歡迎的十道菜。

words.note: 語塊：trim costs／the budget（削減成本／預算）、trim the bushes／hedges（修剪灌木／樹籬）、trim your hair（修頭髮）、trim the menu／report（精簡菜單／報告）。和 cut 的差別：cut 可以剪很多；trim 是「稍微剪掉一點、修整」。商業上 trim costs 比 cut costs 語氣溫和。

words.meaning: （銷售、經濟的）衰退；低迷；（表現）低潮

sentences.en: After a prolonged slump in sales, the electronics company finally reported a small profit this quarter.
sentences.zh: 經過長期的銷售低迷，這家電子公司這一季終於有了小額獲利。

sentences.en: The housing market has been in a slump for almost two years because of high interest rates.
sentences.zh: 因為利率很高，房市已經低迷將近兩年了。

sentences.en: Tourism in the region suffered a sharp slump after the airport was closed for repairs.
sentences.zh: 機場關閉整修後，這個地區的觀光業大幅衰退。

sentences.en: Many small shops struggled to survive the economic slump that followed the closure of three large factories in town.
sentences.zh: 鎮上三間大工廠關閉後經濟衰退，很多小店都很難撐下去。

sentences.en: The coach believes the team will recover from its slump once the injured players return.
sentences.zh: 教練相信受傷的球員回來後，球隊就能走出低潮。

words.note: 語塊：prolonged slump（長期低迷）、sales slump（銷售下滑）、economic slump（經濟衰退）、in a slump（處於低潮）、recover from a slump（走出低潮）。slump 也可以當動詞：Sales slumped（銷量大跌）。相近：decline（下降）、recession（經濟衰退，比較正式、規模大）。

words.meaning: 長期的；持續很久的；延長的

sentences.en: The prolonged heat wave caused electricity demand across the city to reach a record high last week.
sentences.zh: 持續很久的熱浪，讓全市上週的用電量創下新高。

sentences.en: After a prolonged period of negotiations, the two companies finally agreed on the terms of the merger.
sentences.zh: 經過很長一段時間的談判，兩家公司終於談妥合併條件。

sentences.en: Prolonged use of the machine without breaks may cause it to overheat and stop working.
sentences.zh: 機器長時間連續使用不休息，可能會過熱而停止運作。

sentences.en: The airline apologized for the prolonged delay and offered every passenger a free meal voucher.
sentences.zh: 航空公司為長時間的延誤道歉，並給每位乘客一張免費餐券。

sentences.en: Doctors warn that prolonged exposure to loud noise in factories can slowly damage workers' hearing over time.
sentences.zh: 醫生警告，在工廠長期暴露在噪音中，會慢慢傷害工人的聽力。

words.note: 語塊：a prolonged period（很長一段時間）、prolonged slump（長期低迷）、prolonged delay（長時間延誤）、prolonged exposure／use（長期暴露／使用）。動詞 prolong（延長）。pro（往前）＋long（長）＝拉長。和 long 的差別：prolonged 強調「比預期或正常的更久」，常帶負面感覺。

words.meaning: 連環車禍；（工作、東西的）堆積

sentences.en: A ten-car pileup on the highway this morning caused long delays for commuters heading into the city.
sentences.zh: 今天早上高速公路發生十車連環車禍，讓進城的通勤族塞了很久。

sentences.en: Heavy fog was the main cause of the multi-car pileup near the airport exit last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚機場出口附近的連環車禍，主要原因是濃霧。

sentences.en: Because of the holiday, there was a pileup of orders that took our warehouse staff three days to process.
sentences.zh: 因為連假，訂單堆積如山，倉庫員工花了三天才處理完。

sentences.en: Drivers are advised to slow down in rainy weather to avoid a dangerous pileup on the freeway.
sentences.zh: 建議駕駛下雨天減速，避免在高速公路發生危險的連環車禍。

sentences.en: The pileup of unanswered emails grew quickly while Mr. Lin was on vacation for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 林先生休假兩週期間，沒回的電子郵件很快就堆成一大堆。

words.note: 語塊：a multi-car／ten-car pileup（多車／十車連環車禍）、a pileup on the highway（高速公路連環撞）、a pileup of work／orders（工作／訂單堆積）。來自片語 pile up（堆起來）。也可以寫成 pile-up。

sentences.en: The company raised its prices slightly to offset the higher cost of raw materials this year.
sentences.zh: 公司稍微調漲價格，來抵銷今年原料成本的上漲。

sentences.en: Strong online sales helped offset the losses caused by the closure of two physical stores downtown.
sentences.zh: 網路銷售很好，幫忙彌補了市區兩家實體店關閉造成的損失。

sentences.en: The higher rent was partly offset by savings on electricity in the new energy-efficient office.
sentences.zh: 新的節能辦公室省下的電費，抵銷了一部分較高的房租。

sentences.en: Our airline lets passengers pay a small fee to offset the carbon emissions from their flights.
sentences.zh: 我們航空公司讓乘客付一點費用，來抵銷飛行產生的碳排放。

sentences.en: The bonus is meant to offset the extra hours that employees worked during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 這筆獎金是為了補償員工在忙碌的假期旺季多工作的時數。

words.note: 語塊：offset the cost(s)／losses（抵銷成本／損失）、be offset by＋東西（被……抵銷）、offset carbon emissions（碳抵銷）。三態都一樣：offset–offset–offset。同義詞：make up for、compensate for（補償）。

sentences.en: Our airline offers several domestic flights every day between Taipei and Kaohsiung for business travelers.
sentences.zh: 我們航空公司每天都有好幾班台北和高雄之間的國內航班，供商務旅客搭乘。

sentences.en: The company plans to expand into overseas markets after strong growth in the domestic market last year.
sentences.zh: 公司去年在國內市場成長強勁，之後打算擴展到海外市場。

sentences.en: Rising fuel prices have made domestic travel more expensive for families during the summer holidays.
sentences.zh: 油價上漲讓家庭在暑假期間的國內旅遊變得更貴。

sentences.en: Most of our raw materials come from domestic suppliers, which helps us keep shipping costs low.
sentences.zh: 我們大部分的原料來自國內供應商，這幫助我們壓低運費。

sentences.en: The new hotel provides domestic help, such as cleaning and laundry, for guests who stay longer than a week.
sentences.zh: 新飯店為住超過一週的客人提供家務服務，像是打掃和洗衣。

words.note: 語塊：domestic flights（國內航班）、the domestic market（國內市場）、domestic travel（國內旅遊）。domestic 有兩個主要意思：①國內的（反義詞 international／overseas 國外的）②家庭的、家務的（domestic chores 家事）。多益最常考「國內的」。

sentences.en: The delay in shipping was partially caused by the heavy snow that closed several major roads last week.
sentences.zh: 出貨延誤有一部分是因為上週大雪封閉了好幾條主要道路。

sentences.en: The new parking garage is partially funded by the city government, and the rest comes from private investors.
sentences.zh: 新的停車場部分由市政府出資，其餘來自民間投資人。

sentences.en: The conference room will remain partially closed until the new lighting system is installed next Monday.
sentences.zh: 在下週一新照明系統裝好之前，會議室會維持部分關閉。

sentences.en: The supplier admitted that it was partially responsible for the damaged goods and offered us a discount.
sentences.zh: 供應商承認貨物損壞他們要負部分責任，並給了我們折扣。

sentences.en: The report was only partially completed when the manager asked the team to present their findings.
sentences.zh: 經理要團隊報告結果時，報告只完成了一部分。

words.note: 語塊：be partially responsible for（要負部分責任）、partially caused by（部分是因為……）、partially funded by（部分由……出資）、partially completed（完成了一部分）。容易搞混：particularly（特別地）拼法很像但意思完全不同。partly 跟 partially 意思差不多，口語比較常用 partly。

sentences.en: Many travelers book their tickets early because airfares usually rise sharply during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 很多旅客提早訂票，因為假期期間機票價格通常會大漲。

sentences.en: The travel agency compares airfares from several airlines to find the cheapest option for our sales team.
sentences.zh: 旅行社會比較好幾家航空公司的票價，幫我們業務團隊找最便宜的選擇。

sentences.en: Higher fuel costs have pushed up airfares on most international routes since the beginning of the year.
sentences.zh: 從年初開始，燃料成本上升已經讓大多數國際航線的機票價格上漲。

sentences.en: Our company will cover airfares and hotel costs for all employees attending the conference in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 公司會負擔所有參加東京會議員工的機票和飯店費用。

sentences.en: Because of strong competition between budget carriers, airfares to Bangkok have dropped noticeably this month.
sentences.zh: 因為廉價航空之間競爭激烈，這個月飛曼谷的機票價格明顯下降了。

words.note: 語塊：compare airfares（比較機票價格）、airfares rise／drop（機票漲價／降價）、cover airfares（負擔機票費用）。airfare 是「機票的價錢」，不是機票本身；機票本身是 plane ticket。fare 是交通工具的「票價」，例如 bus fare（公車票價）、taxi fare（計程車費）。

sentences.en: All staff at the front desk are required to wear black patent leather shoes as part of the hotel uniform.
sentences.zh: 飯店櫃台所有員工都必須穿黑色漆皮鞋，這是制服的一部分。

sentences.en: The store displayed a new line of patent leather handbags near the entrance to attract holiday shoppers.
sentences.zh: 店家在入口附近展示新系列的漆皮手提包，吸引假期購物的顧客。

sentences.en: Our engineering team decided to apply for a patent on the new battery design before showing it to investors.
sentences.zh: 我們的工程團隊決定在給投資人看之前，先為新的電池設計申請專利。

sentences.en: The company currently holds a patent for the cooling technology used in most of its laptops.
sentences.zh: 公司目前擁有大部分筆電使用的散熱技術專利。

sentences.en: The government granted the startup a patent last month, which will protect its invention for twenty years.
sentences.zh: 政府上個月核准了這家新創公司的專利，能保護它的發明二十年。

words.note: 語塊：patent leather（漆皮，表面亮亮的皮革）、apply for a patent（申請專利）、hold a patent（擁有專利）。patent 最常見的意思是「專利」；patent leather 是固定說法，指亮面漆皮。小心拼法很像的 patient（病人；有耐心的）和 parent（父母）。

words.meaning: 提交的文件；投稿；申請件

sentences.en: The committee will accept submissions for the annual design contest until the end of next month.
sentences.zh: 委員會會收年度設計比賽的投稿，收到下個月底為止。

sentences.en: All submissions must include a short summary and the applicant's contact information on the first page.
sentences.zh: 所有提交的文件第一頁都必須附上簡短摘要和申請人的聯絡資料。

sentences.en: The deadline for submissions has been extended by one week because of problems with the online system.
sentences.zh: 因為線上系統出了問題，提交截止日延後了一週。

sentences.en: We received more than two hundred submissions for the new logo after announcing the competition on social media.
sentences.zh: 在社群媒體上宣布比賽後，我們收到超過兩百件新標誌的投稿。

sentences.en: The editors review all submissions carefully and will contact the selected writers by email next Friday.
sentences.zh: 編輯會仔細審閱所有投稿，並在下週五用電子郵件聯絡入選的作者。

words.note: 語塊：accept submissions（接受投稿／提交）、the deadline for submissions（提交截止日）、receive submissions（收到投稿）。動詞是 submit（提交），例如 submit a report（交報告）。容易搞混：commission（佣金）、admission（入場；入學）、permission（許可），字尾一樣但意思不同。

sentences.en: Please include your previous work experience and any professional licenses, if applicable, in the application form.
sentences.zh: 請在申請表上填寫你過去的工作經驗，如果有的話，也附上專業證照。

sentences.en: The new safety rules are applicable to all employees who work in the warehouse or loading area.
sentences.zh: 新的安全規定適用於所有在倉庫或裝卸區工作的員工。

sentences.en: Please attach a copy of your university diploma, if applicable, when you send us your résumé next week.
sentences.zh: 下週寄履歷給我們時，如果有的話，請附上大學畢業證書影本。

sentences.en: Customers must pay all applicable taxes and fees when they purchase products from our online store.
sentences.zh: 顧客在我們網路商店購買商品時，必須支付所有適用的稅金。

sentences.en: The manager explained that the travel policy is not applicable to short trips within the city.
sentences.zh: 經理解釋，差旅規定不適用於市區內的短程出差。

words.note: 語塊：if applicable（如果適用的話；如有的話）、be applicable to（適用於……）、applicable taxes／fees（相關的稅金／費用）。表格上常看到 if applicable，意思是「有的話才填，沒有就不用填」。和 available（可用的、有空的）不一樣：applicable 是「規定或條件適用」。

sentences.en: New employees will be paid according to the following pay scale, which is based on experience and education.
sentences.zh: 新進員工會依照以下的薪資等級表支薪，依據經驗和學歷而定。

sentences.en: The company reviews its pay scale every year to make sure salaries remain competitive in the industry.
sentences.zh: 公司每年都會檢討薪資級距，確保薪水在業界保有競爭力。

sentences.en: Our factory plans to increase production on a large scale once the new machines arrive in March.
sentences.zh: 新機器三月到貨後，我們工廠打算大規模增加產量。

sentences.en: Customers were asked to rate the service on a scale of one to ten after their hotel stay.
sentences.zh: 顧客退房後被請求用一到十分來評分服務。

sentences.en: Because of budget limits, the marketing team decided to scale back the advertising campaign this quarter.
sentences.zh: 因為預算有限，行銷團隊決定這一季縮減廣告活動的規模。

words.note: 語塊：pay scale／salary scale（薪資等級表）、on a large scale（大規模地）、on a scale of 1 to 10（用1到10分來評）、scale back（縮減規模）。scale 還有「體重計、秤」的意思（bathroom scale）。和 scope（範圍）不同：scale 是「規模、等級」，scope 是「涵蓋的範圍」。

sentences.en: A one-year subscription to our business magazine includes twelve issues delivered directly to your office.
sentences.zh: 我們商業雜誌的一年訂閱包含十二期，直接寄到你的辦公室。

sentences.en: Subscribers can also read all the back issues of the magazine on our website at no extra charge.
sentences.zh: 訂閱者也可以免費在網路上閱讀雜誌的過期刊物。

sentences.en: The technical support team quickly resolved the issues that customers reported with the new software update.
sentences.zh: 技術支援團隊很快就解決了顧客回報的新軟體更新問題。

sentences.en: Please contact the human resources department if you have any issues with your monthly paycheck.
sentences.zh: 如果你的月薪有任何問題，請聯絡人資部門。

sentences.en: The upcoming issues of the newsletter will focus on ways to reduce energy use in the office.
sentences.zh: 接下來幾期的電子報會著重在辦公室節能的方法。

words.note: 語塊：12 issues（12期）、back issues（過期刊物）、resolve issues（解決問題）、have issues with（……有問題）。issue 在雜誌、報紙情境是「期」，例如 the latest issue（最新一期）；在辦公室情境常是「問題、議題」，比 problem 委婉。也可以當動詞：issue a statement（發表聲明）、issue a refund（核發退款）。

sentences.en: Subscriptions to the design magazine cost sixty dollars and include twelve issues annually, delivered by mail.
sentences.zh: 設計雜誌的訂閱費用是六十元，每年有十二期，用郵寄送達。

sentences.en: The company holds its shareholder meeting annually in the main conference hall at its headquarters.
sentences.zh: 公司每年在總部的大會議廳召開一次股東大會。

sentences.en: Employee performance is reviewed annually, and salary increases are based on the results of the review.
sentences.zh: 員工表現每年考核一次，加薪是根據考核結果決定的。

sentences.en: The award is presented annually to the sales representative with the highest customer satisfaction rating.
sentences.zh: 這個獎每年頒給顧客滿意度最高的業務代表。

sentences.en: Our software license must be renewed annually, so please remind the IT department before December.
sentences.zh: 我們的軟體授權每年都要續約，所以請在十二月前提醒資訊部門。

words.note: 語塊：twelve issues annually（每年十二期）、be reviewed annually（每年考核一次）、be renewed annually（每年續約）、be held annually（每年舉辦）。形容詞是 annual（每年的），例如 annual report（年報）。類似：monthly（每月）、weekly（每週）、quarterly（每季）。

words.meaning: 未經請求的；主動提供的；不請自來的

sentences.en: Our email system automatically moves unsolicited emails from unknown senders into a separate spam folder.
sentences.zh: 我們的電子郵件系統會自動把陌生寄件人主動寄來的信件移到垃圾郵件匣。

sentences.en: The magazine does not accept unsolicited manuscripts, so writers must first send a short proposal to the editor.
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌不接受未經邀約的投稿，所以作者必須先寄簡短的提案給編輯。

sentences.en: Employees should not give unsolicited advice to clients about matters outside their own area of expertise.
sentences.zh: 員工不應該在自己專業以外的事情上，主動給客戶沒被要求的建議。

sentences.en: The company received several unsolicited job applications after its new office opened in the business district.
sentences.zh: 公司在商業區開了新辦公室後，收到好幾份主動投遞的求職申請。

sentences.en: Customers can call this number if they wish to stop receiving unsolicited calls from our marketing department.
sentences.zh: 如果顧客不想再接到我們行銷部門主動打去的電話，可以撥打這支電話。

words.note: 語塊：unsolicited emails／calls（垃圾信件／推銷電話）、unsolicited advice（沒人要求的建議）、unsolicited manuscripts／applications（主動投稿／主動投遞的履歷）。un（不）＋solicited（被請求的）＝沒人請你、自己主動來的。動詞 solicit 是「請求、徵求」，例如 solicit feedback（徵求意見）。

sentences.en: The client requested a revision to the contract because the delivery date was listed incorrectly.
sentences.zh: 客戶要求修改合約，因為交貨日期寫錯了。

sentences.en: The design team made a minor revision to the logo after receiving feedback from the marketing director.
sentences.zh: 設計團隊收到行銷總監的意見後，對標誌做了小幅修改。

sentences.en: The budget proposal is still under revision and will be sent to the board of directors next week.
sentences.zh: 預算提案還在修改中，下週會送交董事會。

sentences.en: Each revision of the user manual must be approved by the quality control manager before it is printed.
sentences.zh: 使用手冊每次修訂都必須經過品管經理核准才能印刷。

sentences.en: After a careful revision of last year's sales figures, the accountant found several small errors in the report.
sentences.zh: 仔細重新檢查去年的銷售數字後，會計發現報告裡有幾個小錯誤。

words.note: 語塊：make a revision to（對……做修改）、request a revision（要求修改）、under revision（修改中）、minor／major revision（小幅／大幅修改）。動詞是 revise（修改、修訂）。容易搞混：provision（提供；條款）、division（部門；分配）拼法很像但意思不同。英式英文的 revision 也有「複習（考試）」的意思。

words.meaning: 匯款；繳納（remit 的過去式／過去分詞）

sentences.en: Payment will be remitted to your bank account within thirty days after we receive the signed invoice.
sentences.zh: 收到簽名的發票後，款項會在三十天內匯到你的銀行帳戶。

sentences.en: The supplier confirmed that the full payment was remitted by wire transfer on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 供應商確認全額款項已在週一早上透過電匯付出。

sentences.en: All taxes collected from customers must be remitted to the government by the fifteenth of each month.
sentences.zh: 向顧客收取的所有稅金，都必須在每個月十五號前繳交給政府。

sentences.en: The freelance writer's fee was remitted only after the editor approved the final version of the article.
sentences.zh: 編輯核准文章定稿之後，自由撰稿人的稿費才匯出。

sentences.en: Once the funds are remitted, the accounting department will send you a receipt by email.
sentences.zh: 款項匯出後，會計部門會用電子郵件寄收據給你。

words.note: 語塊：payment will be remitted（款項將會匯出）、remit payment（匯款；付款）、be remitted to＋帳戶／對象（匯給……）。原形是 remit（匯款、繳納），名詞 remittance（匯款）。比 pay 或 send money 更正式，常出現在發票和合約上。容易搞混：admitted（承認了）、permitted（允許了）、omitted（省略了）。

words.meaning: 電匯（wire 的過去式／過去分詞）；接上電線

sentences.en: A payment of nine hundred dollars can be wired to your account as soon as the contract is signed.
sentences.zh: 合約一簽好，九百元的款項就可以電匯到你的帳戶。

sentences.en: The client wired the money to our company account last Friday, so the order can be shipped today.
sentences.zh: 客戶上週五把錢電匯到我們公司帳戶了，所以訂單今天就能出貨。

sentences.en: Your salary will be wired directly to your bank account on the last business day of each month.
sentences.zh: 你的薪水會在每個月最後一個工作天直接匯入你的銀行帳戶。

sentences.en: The deposit must be wired to the hotel at least two weeks before the conference begins.
sentences.zh: 訂金必須在會議開始前至少兩週匯給飯店。

sentences.en: Please call the finance office to confirm that the funds were wired to the correct account number.
sentences.zh: 請打電話給財務辦公室，確認款項有匯到正確的帳號。

words.note: 語塊：be wired to your account（電匯到你的帳戶）、wire money／funds（電匯金錢／款項）、wire transfer（電匯）。wire 原本是「電線」，當動詞是「透過銀行電匯」。和 remit 意思很接近：remit 是「付款、匯款」的正式說法，wire 特別指「銀行電匯」。wired 也可以指「接好電線的」或口語「很亢奮的」。

sentences.en: The engineer applied for a patent on her invention before presenting it at the technology fair.
sentences.zh: 工程師在科技展上發表她的發明之前，先申請了專利。

sentences.en: The company plans to bring the new invention to market by the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 公司打算在明年底前把這項新發明推向市場。

sentences.en: Many of the most useful office tools began as a simple invention by an ordinary employee.
sentences.zh: 很多最好用的辦公室工具，一開始都是普通員工的一個簡單發明。

sentences.en: The judges at the contest praised the student's invention for its practical design and low production cost.
sentences.zh: 評審稱讚這位學生的發明設計實用、生產成本又低。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibit shows how the invention of the telephone changed the way businesses communicate.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽介紹電話的發明如何改變了企業溝通的方式。

words.note: 語塊：patent an invention／apply for a patent on an invention（為發明申請專利）、bring an invention to market（把發明推向市場）、the invention of＋東西（……的發明）。動詞 invent（發明），發明家是 inventor。別跟 investigation（調查）搞混：兩個都是 inv 開頭、-tion 結尾，investigation 比較長，開頭是 invest（投資）。也小心 innovation（創新），指新的做法或改良，不一定是新東西。

words.meaning: 先決條件；必要條件；先修課程

sentences.en: Applicants must meet all the prerequisites for the position, including three years of sales experience.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須符合這個職位的所有先決條件，包括三年的業務經驗。

sentences.en: Before enrolling in the advanced accounting course, employees must first complete the prerequisites offered on our website.
sentences.zh: 員工在報名進階會計課程之前，必須先完成線上提供的先修課程。

sentences.en: A valid driver's license and a clean driving record are prerequisites for the delivery driver job.
sentences.zh: 有效的駕照和良好的駕駛紀錄，是送貨司機這份工作的必要條件。

sentences.en: The manager explained that strong communication skills are among the key prerequisites for promotion to team leader.
sentences.zh: 經理解釋，良好的溝通能力是升任組長的主要先決條件之一。

sentences.en: Please review the prerequisites listed on the training website before you register for any workshops next month.
sentences.zh: 下個月報名任何工作坊之前，請先看一下培訓網站上列出的先決條件。

words.note: 語塊：meet the prerequisites（符合先決條件）、complete the prerequisites（完成先修課程）、be a prerequisite for（是……的必要條件）。pre（之前）＋requisite（必需的）＝事先必須具備的東西。和 requirement（要求、條件）意思接近，prerequisite 特別強調「做某件事之前就要先有」。別跟 preference（偏好）、precaution（預防措施）搞混。

sentences.en: Our research center uses cutting-edge technology to test new medical devices before they reach the market.
sentences.zh: 我們的研究中心用最先進的技術，在新醫療器材上市前進行測試。

sentences.en: The company hired several engineers to help develop cutting-edge products for the growing electric car market.
sentences.zh: 公司聘了好幾位工程師，幫忙為成長中的電動車市場開發尖端產品。

sentences.en: Visitors to the trade show were impressed by the cutting-edge design of the new smartphone models.
sentences.zh: 參觀商展的人對新款智慧型手機最新穎的設計印象深刻。

sentences.en: The university is proud of its cutting-edge research in renewable energy and has received many international awards.
sentences.zh: 這所大學以它在再生能源方面的尖端研究為傲，也得過很多國際獎項。

sentences.en: To stay competitive, the factory replaced its old machines with cutting-edge equipment from a German supplier.
sentences.zh: 為了保持競爭力，工廠用德國供應商的最先進設備取代了舊機器。

words.note: 語塊：cutting-edge technology（最先進的技術）、cutting-edge research（尖端研究）、cutting-edge products／equipment／design（最新的產品／設備／設計）。字面是「切割的刀鋒」，刀最前面的那一點＝走在最前面。同義詞：state-of-the-art、advanced、the latest。也可以當名詞：at the cutting edge of（站在……的最前線）。

words.meaning: 課程（整體的課程內容、課綱）

sentences.en: The training center updated its curriculum to include more courses on digital marketing and data analysis.
sentences.zh: 訓練中心更新了課程內容，加入更多數位行銷和資料分析的課。

sentences.en: New employees follow a two-week curriculum that covers company policies, safety rules, and customer service.
sentences.zh: 新進員工要上兩週的課程，內容包括公司政策、安全規定和客戶服務。

sentences.en: The school plans to design a new curriculum focused on practical business English for working adults.
sentences.zh: 學校打算設計一套新的課程，專門給上班族學實用的商業英文。

sentences.en: Teachers were invited to share their ideas before the curriculum for next year was finalized.
sentences.zh: 在明年的課程確定之前，老師們受邀分享他們的想法。

sentences.en: A strong language program is an important part of the curriculum at many international schools in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 在台北的許多國際學校，扎實的語言課程是整體課程中很重要的一部分。

words.note: 語塊：update the curriculum（更新課程）、design／develop a curriculum（設計課程）、part of the curriculum（課程的一部分）。curriculum 是「整套課程」，course 是「其中一門課」。複數是 curricula 或 curriculums。別跟 curriculum vitae（CV，履歷）搞混，雖然開頭一樣，但 CV 是履歷。

sentences.en: Registration for courses in the fall semester will open online on the first Monday of August.
sentences.zh: 秋季學期的課程報名，會在八月第一個星期一開放線上登記。

sentences.en: The company offers to pay half of the tuition for employees who take evening classes this semester.
sentences.zh: 這學期上夜間課程的員工，公司願意負擔一半的學費。

sentences.en: Several local businesses will hire students as interns during the spring semester to help with marketing projects.
sentences.zh: 春季學期期間，好幾家本地企業會聘學生當實習生，協助行銷專案。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen will teach two business English courses at the university at the end of the semester.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐學期末會在大學教兩門商業英文課。

sentences.en: Students who study abroad for a semester often find it easier to get jobs at international companies.
sentences.zh: 出國讀一學期的學生，通常比較容易找到國際公司的工作。

words.note: 語塊：the fall／spring semester（秋季／春季學期）、this／next semester（這／下學期）、study abroad for a semester（出國讀一學期）。semester 是一年分兩段的「學期」；term 也可以指學期，但更廣，也能指任期、條款。別跟 seminar（研討會）搞混，開頭很像但意思不同。

words.meaning: 展覽館；（博覽會的）國家館；涼亭

sentences.en: More than fifty companies will display their latest products in the exhibition pavilion at next month's trade fair.
sentences.zh: 下個月的商展上，超過五十家公司會在展覽館展示他們的最新產品。

sentences.en: The Japanese pavilion attracted the largest number of visitors at the international food expo held in Taipei last weekend.
sentences.zh: 上週末在台北舉辦的國際食品博覽會上，日本館吸引了最多參觀者。

sentences.en: The company picnic will be held in the park pavilion, so employees do not need to worry about rain.
sentences.zh: 公司野餐會在公園的涼亭舉行，所以員工不用擔心下雨。

sentences.en: Visitors can pick up free maps and brochures at the information desk inside the main pavilion.
sentences.zh: 參觀者可以在主展館裡的服務台拿免費地圖和簡介手冊。

sentences.en: The city council approved a plan to build a new pavilion for outdoor concerts near the river.
sentences.zh: 市議會核准在河邊蓋一座新的戶外音樂會場館。

words.note: 語塊：exhibition pavilion（展覽館）、the Japanese／Taiwan pavilion（日本館／台灣館，指國家館）、park pavilion（公園涼亭）。pavilion 有兩種常見意思：①博覽會或展覽裡的「展館」 ②公園裡有屋頂、沒有牆的「涼亭」。和 booth（攤位）不同：booth 是一家公司的小攤位，pavilion 是一整座館或一大區。

words.meaning: 被報導；被特別介紹；以……為特色（feature 的過去式／過去分詞）

sentences.en: This is the first time our bakery has been featured in a national food magazine.
sentences.zh: 這是我們麵包店第一次被全國性的美食雜誌報導。

sentences.en: The young designer was featured on a popular morning TV show after winning the international competition.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕設計師在國際比賽得獎後，登上了一個熱門的晨間電視節目。

sentences.en: Our new product line will be featured prominently at the front of every store during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 假期期間，我們的新產品系列會被擺在每家店最前面最顯眼的位置。

sentences.en: The museum's latest exhibition featured paintings by several local artists who had never shown their work before.
sentences.zh: 博物館最新的展覽展出了幾位從沒公開作品的本地藝術家的畫作。

sentences.en: Several of our employees were featured in the company newsletter for their excellent customer service this year.
sentences.zh: 我們有好幾位員工因為今年客戶服務表現優秀，被刊登在公司電子報上。

words.note: 語塊：be featured in＋雜誌／報紙（被……報導、刊登）、be featured on＋電視節目／網站（登上……）、be featured prominently（被放在顯眼位置）。feature 當動詞是「以……為特色；特別介紹、報導」，當名詞是「特色、功能」（a new feature 新功能）。介系詞：雜誌、報紙、電子報用 in；電視、網站、節目用 on。

sentences.en: The gallery will display a collection of watercolors painted by local artists throughout the month of December.
sentences.zh: 藝廊整個十二月會展出一系列本地藝術家畫的水彩畫。

sentences.en: The hotel lobby is decorated with soft watercolors of mountains and lakes from around Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳掛著台灣各地山景和湖景的柔和水彩畫。

sentences.en: Participants in the weekend workshop will learn how to paint with watercolors using simple brushes and paper.
sentences.zh: 週末工作坊的學員會學習用簡單的畫筆和紙來畫水彩。

sentences.en: All the watercolors in the exhibition are for sale, and the profits will be donated to a children's hospital.
sentences.zh: 展覽中所有的水彩畫都可以購買，收益會捐給一家兒童醫院。

sentences.en: The art supply store offers a ten percent discount on watercolors and sketchbooks for students with a valid ID.
sentences.zh: 美術用品店為持有效證件的學生提供水彩顏料和素描本九折優惠。

words.note: 語塊：paint with watercolors（用水彩畫畫）、an exhibition of watercolors（水彩畫展）、a collection of watercolors（一系列水彩畫）。watercolors 有兩個意思：①水彩顏料 ②水彩畫（作品）。英式拼法是 watercolours。類似：oil painting（油畫）、sketch（素描）。

sentences.en: Many investors started buying shares in the electric car company after it announced record profits.
sentences.zh: 這家電動車公司宣布創紀錄的獲利後，很多投資人開始買它的股票。

sentences.en: Employees who have worked here for five years can buy shares at a discount through the company program.
sentences.zh: 在這裡工作滿五年的員工，可以透過公司的方案用優惠價買股票。

sentences.en: The founder sold half of his shares last year to raise money for a new business in Japan.
sentences.zh: 創辦人去年賣掉一半的股份，籌錢在日本開新事業。

sentences.en: The price of shares in the airline rose sharply after the government lifted travel restrictions.
sentences.zh: 政府解除旅遊限制後，這家航空公司的股價大幅上漲。

sentences.en: Each of the three partners owns equal shares of the restaurant and makes decisions together every month.
sentences.zh: 三位合夥人各擁有這家餐廳相同的股份，每個月一起做決定。

words.note: 語塊：buy／sell shares（買／賣股票）、shares in＋公司（……公司的股票）、the price of shares／share price（股價）。share 當名詞是「股份、股票」，也有「一份、分擔的部分」的意思（a fair share 應得的一份）；當動詞是「分享」。和 stock 的差別：stock 泛指股票（不可數），shares 是一股一股可以數的。持有股票的人叫 shareholder。

sentences.en: Every customer who completes our online survey will receive a gift certificate worth twenty dollars.
sentences.zh: 每位填完我們線上問卷的顧客都會收到一張價值二十元的禮券。

sentences.en: The restaurant gave us a gift certificate to apologize for the long wait on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 餐廳送我們一張禮券，為星期五晚上讓我們等很久道歉。

sentences.en: Gift certificates can be redeemed at any of our stores, but each certificate must be used before the expiration date.
sentences.zh: 禮券可以在我們任何一家門市使用，但每張禮券都必須在到期日前用完。

sentences.en: Participants who attend all five training sessions will be issued a certificate of completion by the human resources department.
sentences.zh: 參加全部五堂培訓課的學員，會由人資部門核發結業證書。

sentences.en: Applicants must submit a copy of their teaching certificate along with their résumé before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須在月底前，把教師證書影本連同履歷一起交出來。

words.note: 語塊：gift certificate（禮券）、redeem a gift certificate（使用禮券）、certificate of completion（結業證書）、be issued a certificate（被核發證書）。certificate 是「證書、證明文件」，gift certificate 是「禮券」，同義詞是 gift card、gift voucher。和 certification（認證、資格）不同：certificate 是那張紙，certification 是取得資格這件事。

words.meaning: （公司的）靜修營、研習營；休憩處；撤退

sentences.en: The management team will attend a three-day corporate retreat in the mountains to plan next year's strategy.
sentences.zh: 管理團隊會參加在山上舉辦的三天企業靜修營，規劃明年的策略。

sentences.en: Last year's company retreat helped employees from different departments get to know each other better.
sentences.zh: 去年的公司員工旅遊活動，讓不同部門的員工更了解彼此。

sentences.en: The resort has become a popular weekend retreat for busy professionals who want to escape the city.
sentences.zh: 這間度假村成了想逃離城市的忙碌上班族熱門的週末休憩地點。

sentences.en: Our sales team is planning a two-day retreat to discuss new ways to reach customers overseas.
sentences.zh: 我們業務團隊正在規劃兩天的研習營，討論接觸海外客戶的新方法。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a quiet retreat with yoga classes and healthy meals for guests who need to relax.
sentences.zh: 飯店為需要放鬆的客人提供安靜的休養行程，有瑜珈課和健康餐點。

words.note: 語塊：corporate／company retreat（公司的員工靜修營、外地研習）、a weekend retreat（週末休憩處）、go on a retreat（參加靜修／研習活動）。在多益裡，retreat 通常是公司帶員工到外地，一邊開會規劃、一邊放鬆交流的活動。原本意思是「撤退」，也可以當動詞：The army retreated（軍隊撤退）。

sentences.en: The radio host gave a short introduction to the interview before asking the chef about her new restaurant.
sentences.zh: 電台主持人在問主廚新餐廳的事之前，先為這段訪談做了簡短的開場介紹。

sentences.en: This workshop offers a basic introduction to digital marketing for small business owners with no experience.
sentences.zh: 這個工作坊為沒有經驗的小企業老闆提供數位行銷的基礎入門。

sentences.en: The introduction of the new scheduling software has saved our staff several hours every week.
sentences.zh: 新排班軟體的導入，讓我們的員工每週省下好幾個小時。

sentences.en: After a brief introduction by the CEO, the head of research presented the results of the study.
sentences.zh: 執行長簡短開場致詞之後，研究主管報告了研究結果。

sentences.en: Mr. Park asked his assistant to make an introduction between him and the new supplier at the trade fair.
sentences.zh: 朴先生請助理在商展上替他和新供應商介紹認識。

words.note: 語塊：an introduction to＋東西（……的開場白；……入門）、make an introduction（幫人介紹認識）、the introduction of＋新東西（……的引進、推出）、a brief／short introduction（簡短的介紹）。動詞 introduce（介紹；引進）。別跟 instruction（指示、說明）搞混：introduction 是「介紹、開頭」，instruction 是「教你怎麼做」。

sentences.en: Please check the safety equipment carefully before you start your shift at the factory each morning.
sentences.zh: 每天早上在工廠開始上班前，請仔細檢查安全設備。

sentences.en: Nurses who work the night shift receive extra pay and two additional days off each month.
sentences.zh: 上夜班的護理師每個月有額外津貼和多兩天休假。

sentences.en: Mr. Lee asked a coworker to cover his shift on Friday so he could attend his daughter's graduation.
sentences.zh: 李先生請同事星期五幫他代班，這樣他才能去參加女兒的畢業典禮。

sentences.en: The restaurant hired three part-time workers to help during the busy lunch shift on weekends.
sentences.zh: 餐廳請了三位兼職人員，幫忙週末忙碌的午餐時段。

sentences.en: Employees must sign out at the front desk at the end of every shift so managers can track working hours.
sentences.zh: 員工每次下班時都必須在櫃台簽退，讓經理可以記錄工時。

words.note: 語塊：start／finish your shift（開始／結束輪班）、the night／day shift（夜班／日班）、cover someone's shift（幫某人代班）、work the morning shift（上早班）。shift 是「輪班的一段工作時間」。也可以當動詞或名詞指「轉變、移動」：a shift in strategy（策略的轉變）、shift the meeting to Monday（把會議改到星期一）。

sentences.en: This weekend only, all sirloin steaks in the meat department are half off for members of our rewards program.
sentences.zh: 僅限本週末，肉品區所有沙朗牛排對會員計畫的會員半價優惠。

sentences.en: The chef recommends ordering the grilled sirloin with roasted vegetables and a glass of red wine.
sentences.zh: 主廚推薦點炭烤沙朗搭配烤蔬菜和一杯紅酒。

sentences.en: Our butcher cuts each sirloin steak by hand to make sure every piece is the same thickness.
sentences.zh: 我們的肉販每塊沙朗牛排都是手工切的，確保每塊厚度都一樣。

sentences.en: The banquet menu includes a choice of sirloin, salmon, or a vegetarian pasta dish for each guest.
sentences.zh: 宴會菜單讓每位客人從沙朗、鮭魚或素食義大利麵中選一道。

sentences.en: Customers can save up to ten dollars when they buy two packages of sirloin at the same time.
sentences.zh: 顧客同時買兩盒沙朗最多可以省十元。

words.note: 語塊：sirloin steak（沙朗牛排）、grilled sirloin（炭烤沙朗）、a cut of sirloin（一塊沙朗）。其他常見牛排部位：tenderloin／filet mignon（菲力）、rib-eye（肋眼）、T-bone（丁骨）。

sentences.en: All sirloin steaks are half off this weekend, so the supermarket expects the meat section to be very busy.
sentences.zh: 這週末所有沙朗牛排半價，所以超市預計肉品區會很忙。

sentences.en: Customers who show their membership card can get winter jackets at half off until the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 出示會員卡的顧客，到月底前可以用半價買冬季外套。

sentences.en: The bookstore is offering half off all travel guides to celebrate the opening of its second location.
sentences.zh: 書店為了慶祝第二家分店開幕，所有旅遊指南都打五折。

sentences.en: Tickets for the afternoon show are half off for students and senior citizens with a valid ID.
sentences.zh: 下午場的票，學生和年長者持有效證件可享半價。

sentences.en: Because the shipment arrived damaged, the supplier agreed to give us half off our next order of printer paper.
sentences.zh: 因為送來的貨有損壞，供應商同意下一筆印表機紙的訂單給我們打五折。

words.note: 語塊：be half off（半價）、get＋東西＋at half off（用半價買到）、offer half off＋東西（某東西打五折）。off 在這裡是「減掉、折扣」：20% off（打八折）、$10 off（折十元）。同義：half price、50% off。注意：中文的「八折」英文是 20% off（減掉 20%）。

sentences.en: Store managers should speak with customers to explain the weekly deals in their specific sections of the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 門市經理應該和顧客聊聊，說明超市各自負責區域的每週優惠。

sentences.en: Shoppers can find great deals on kitchen appliances during our annual year-end sale next month.
sentences.zh: 下個月的年終特賣，顧客可以買到很划算的廚房家電。

sentences.en: Sign up for our newsletter to receive special deals and discount codes directly in your inbox.
sentences.zh: 訂閱我們的電子報，就能直接在信箱收到特別優惠和折扣碼。

sentences.en: The travel agency offers several package deals that include airfare, hotel rooms, and guided tours of the city.
sentences.zh: 旅行社提供好幾種套裝優惠，包含機票、飯店房間和市區導覽行程。

sentences.en: Our sales team closed three major deals with overseas clients this quarter, which raised our revenue significantly.
sentences.zh: 我們業務團隊這一季和海外客戶談成了三筆大交易，讓營收大幅增加。

words.note: 語塊：great deals on＋東西（……很划算的優惠）、special deals（特別優惠）、package deals（套裝優惠）、close a deal（談成交易）。deal 有兩個常見意思：①划算的價格、優惠（a good deal 很划算）②交易、生意（make a deal 達成協議）。也可以當動詞：deal with（處理）。

sentences.en: Various timeslots remain open for next week's training sessions, so please sign up on the company website.
sentences.zh: 下週的培訓課程還有好幾個時段空著，請到公司網站報名。

sentences.en: Patients can book available timeslots online instead of calling the clinic during busy morning hours.
sentences.zh: 病患可以在網路上預約空的時段，不用在忙碌的早上打電話到診所。

sentences.en: All the afternoon timeslots for the job interviews were filled within two hours of the announcement.
sentences.zh: 面試的所有下午時段，在公告後兩小時內就全部額滿了。

sentences.en: The radio station sells advertising timeslots during the morning news at a higher price than in the evening.
sentences.zh: 電台早上新聞時段的廣告時段，賣得比晚上貴。

sentences.en: Customers who choose evening delivery timeslots may have to pay an additional fee of five dollars.
sentences.zh: 選擇晚上配送時段的顧客，可能要多付五元費用。

words.note: 語塊：timeslots remain open／available（時段還有空位）、book a timeslot（預約時段）、all timeslots are filled（時段全滿）。也常寫成兩個字 time slots，單數 timeslot／time slot。slot 本身是「時段；（放東西的）狹縫、投幣口」。和 timetable（時刻表、行程表）不同：timetable 是整張表，timeslot 是其中一格時段。

sentences.en: The historic mansion on the hill has been turned into a luxury hotel with twenty guest rooms.
sentences.zh: 山丘上的那棟歷史豪宅已經改建成有二十間客房的豪華飯店。

sentences.en: Visitors can take a guided tour of the mansion and its gardens every Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 每週六早上，參觀者可以跟著導覽參觀這棟豪宅和它的花園。

sentences.en: The company held its anniversary dinner in an old mansion that is often rented for weddings and banquets.
sentences.zh: 公司在一棟常被租來辦婚禮和宴會的老豪宅舉辦週年晚宴。

sentences.en: The real estate agent showed the wealthy buyer a large mansion with a swimming pool and a private garden.
sentences.zh: 房仲帶這位有錢的買家看了一棟有游泳池和私人花園的大豪宅。

sentences.en: After the renovation is complete, the old mansion will reopen to the public as a museum of local history.
sentences.zh: 整修完成後，這棟老宅會改成地方歷史博物館，重新對外開放。

words.note: 語塊：a historic mansion（歷史豪宅）、a tour of the mansion（參觀豪宅）、a luxury mansion（豪華宅邸）。mansion 是很大、很豪華的獨棟房子。注意：英文的 mansion 不是中文說的「大樓公寓」（那是 apartment building／condo），雖然日文的マンション指公寓。別跟 mention（提到）搞混。

words.meaning: 露台；（地面層的）戶外平台

sentences.en: Each ground-floor room features a walk-out patio with direct access to the hotel's swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 每間一樓的房間都有可以直接走出去的露台，直通飯店游泳池。

sentences.en: Guests can enjoy breakfast on the patio while looking out over the garden and the lake.
sentences.zh: 客人可以在露台上吃早餐，同時欣賞花園和湖景。

sentences.en: The restaurant added an outdoor patio last spring so customers could dine outside in warm weather.
sentences.zh: 餐廳去年春天增加了戶外露台，讓客人天氣暖和時可以在外面用餐。

sentences.en: The apartment comes with a private patio, which is perfect for small dinner parties with friends.
sentences.zh: 這間公寓附有私人露台，很適合跟朋友辦小型晚餐聚會。

sentences.en: Workers will repair the stone floor of the patio before the company barbecue next Saturday.
sentences.zh: 工人會在下週六公司烤肉活動前，修好露台的石頭地板。

words.note: 語塊：a walk-out patio（可以直接從房間走出去的露台）、an outdoor patio（戶外露台）、a private patio（私人露台）、on the patio（在露台上，用 on）。和 balcony（陽台）的差別：patio 在地面層，通常鋪石頭或磚；balcony 在樓上，從牆壁突出去，有欄杆。

sentences.en: Every room on the upper floors has a private balcony with a beautiful view of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 高樓層的每間房都有私人陽台，可以欣賞美麗的海景。

sentences.en: Guests are reminded not to hang towels or clothes over the balcony railing for safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 為了安全，提醒房客不要把毛巾或衣服掛在陽台欄杆上。

sentences.en: We booked a room with a balcony so that we could enjoy coffee outside every morning.
sentences.zh: 我們訂了有陽台的房間，這樣每天早上就能在外面喝咖啡。

sentences.en: Smoking is not allowed inside the hotel rooms, but guests may smoke outside on the balcony.
sentences.zh: 飯店房間內禁止吸菸，但房客可以到外面陽台抽菸。

sentences.en: Tickets for seats in the theater balcony are cheaper, but the view of the stage is still excellent.
sentences.zh: 劇院樓座的票比較便宜，但看舞台的視野還是很好。

words.note: 語塊：a private balcony（私人陽台）、a room with a balcony（有陽台的房間）、on the balcony（在陽台上，用 on）、a balcony with a sea view（有海景的陽台）。和 patio（露台）的差別：balcony 在樓上、有欄杆；patio 在地面層。另外 terrace 通常比 balcony 大，可以是屋頂或大型平台。

sentences.en: The executive suite includes a large whirlpool bath where guests can relax after a long day of meetings.
sentences.zh: 行政套房有一個大型按摩浴缸，讓客人在一整天的會議後放鬆。

sentences.en: The fitness center on the third floor has a sauna, an indoor pool, and a whirlpool for hotel guests.
sentences.zh: 三樓的健身中心有三溫暖、室內游泳池和按摩池，供飯店房客使用。

sentences.en: For safety reasons, children under twelve may not use the whirlpool without an adult present.
sentences.zh: 為了安全，十二歲以下的孩童沒有大人陪同不能使用按摩池。

sentences.en: The whirlpool will be closed for cleaning every Monday morning from eight to ten o'clock.
sentences.zh: 按摩池每週一早上八點到十點會關閉清潔。

sentences.en: Many guests choose the honeymoon package because the room comes with a private whirlpool tub on the balcony.
sentences.zh: 很多客人選蜜月方案，因為房間的陽台上附有私人按摩浴缸。

words.note: 語塊：a whirlpool bath／tub（按摩浴缸）、a private whirlpool（私人按摩池）、sauna and whirlpool（三溫暖和按摩池）。whirl（旋轉）＋pool（池）＝水會轉圈噴的池子，也可以指河海裡的「漩渦」。同義詞：Jacuzzi（品牌名，常當一般名詞用）、hot tub（熱水按摩池）。

sentences.en: In Mr. Chen's absence, his assistant will answer all questions about the project and approve small expenses.
sentences.zh: 陳先生不在的期間，他的助理會回答所有專案相關的問題，並核准小額支出。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin was asked to lead the weekly meeting during the manager's absence on a business trip to Japan.
sentences.zh: 經理去日本出差不在的期間，林小姐被請來主持每週會議。

sentences.en: Employees who need a leave of absence for more than two weeks must submit a request to human resources.
sentences.zh: 需要請假超過兩週的員工，必須向人資部門提出申請。

sentences.en: Several customers complained about the absence of clear instructions in the user manual for the new printer.
sentences.zh: 好幾位顧客抱怨新印表機的使用手冊缺少清楚的說明。

sentences.en: Frequent absence from work without a good reason may affect an employee's annual performance review.
sentences.zh: 沒有正當理由經常缺勤，可能會影響員工的年度考績。

words.note: 語塊：in someone's absence／in the absence of someone（某人不在的時候）、during someone's absence（某人不在期間）、a leave of absence（休假、留職停薪）、the absence of＋東西（缺少……）。形容詞 absent（缺席的）。反義詞 presence（出席、在場）。

sentences.en: Ms. Huang will be responsible for taking down the minutes of the meeting and sending them to all department heads.
sentences.zh: 黃小姐會負責做會議記錄，並寄給所有部門主管。

sentences.en: Please review the minutes from last week's board meeting before we discuss the new budget today.
sentences.zh: 今天討論新預算之前，請先看一下上週董事會的會議記錄。

sentences.en: The secretary distributed copies of the minutes so that employees who missed the meeting could catch up.
sentences.zh: 秘書發了會議記錄的影本，讓沒參加會議的員工能跟上進度。

sentences.en: According to the minutes, the committee agreed to postpone the product launch until early next spring.
sentences.zh: 根據會議記錄，委員會同意把產品上市延到明年初春。

sentences.en: Anyone who notices a mistake in the minutes should contact the meeting organizer by Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 任何人發現會議記錄有錯誤，請在星期五下午前聯絡會議主辦人。

words.note: 語塊：take (down) the minutes（做會議記錄）、the minutes of the meeting（會議記錄）、according to the minutes（根據會議記錄）、review the minutes（審閱會議記錄）。在會議情境，minutes 是「會議記錄」，一定用複數，不是「分鐘」。做記錄的人叫 minute-taker 或 note-taker。

sentences.en: The company bought tickets to the opera for its top sales representatives as a reward for reaching their targets.
sentences.zh: 公司買了歌劇票給業績最好的業務代表，獎勵他們達成目標。

sentences.en: The new opera house downtown will host performances by famous international singers starting early next spring.
sentences.zh: 市中心新的歌劇院明年春天起會有國際歌手的演出。

sentences.en: Guests staying at our hotel can receive a discount on tickets to the opera at the city theater.
sentences.zh: 住我們飯店的客人，可以用優惠價買市立劇院的歌劇票。

sentences.en: After dinner, the clients were taken to see a famous Italian opera that lasted almost three hours.
sentences.zh: 晚餐後，客戶被帶去看了一齣將近三小時的著名義大利歌劇。

sentences.en: The local opera company is looking for volunteers to help sell tickets and greet guests at the entrance.
sentences.zh: 本地歌劇團正在找志工幫忙賣票，並在入口接待來賓。

words.note: 語塊：go to the opera（去看歌劇）、an opera house（歌劇院）、an opera company（歌劇團）、an opera singer（歌劇演員）。和 musical（音樂劇）不同：opera 幾乎全部用唱的，常是古典音樂；musical 有唱也有對話，比較流行。soap opera 是「肥皂劇、連續劇」。

words.meaning: 推出；發起；展開（launch 的過去式／過去分詞）

sentences.en: The mobile application was launched last month and has already been downloaded more than fifty thousand times.
sentences.zh: 這個手機應用程式上個月推出，已經被下載超過五萬次了。

sentences.en: Our company launched a new product line of eco-friendly cleaning supplies at the trade fair in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 我們公司在台北的商展上推出了一系列新的環保清潔用品。

sentences.en: The marketing team launched an advertising campaign on social media last week to attract younger customers.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊上週在社群媒體上展開廣告活動，吸引年輕顧客。

sentences.en: The city government launched an investigation into the cause of the power outage that affected thousands of homes.
sentences.zh: 市政府針對影響數千戶的停電原因展開調查。

sentences.en: The sports drink was officially launched in Japan after two years of research and testing.
sentences.zh: 這款運動飲料經過兩年研發和測試後，正式在日本上市。

words.note: 語塊：launch a new product（推出新產品）、launch a campaign（展開活動）、launch an investigation（展開調查）、be officially launched（正式推出）。launch 是「推出、發起、開始」，原本是「發射（火箭）」。名詞也是 launch：a product launch（產品發表會）。注意拼法是 launch，不是 lauch。和 release（發行，常用在電影、音樂）意思接近。

words.meaning: 二氧化物（carbon dioxide 二氧化碳）

sentences.en: The factory installed new filters last year to reduce its carbon dioxide emissions by thirty percent.
sentences.zh: 工廠去年裝了新的過濾器，把二氧化碳排放量減少了三成。

sentences.en: Our electric delivery trucks help the company lower the amount of carbon dioxide it releases into the air.
sentences.zh: 我們的電動貨車幫助公司降低排放到空氣中的二氧化碳量。

sentences.en: Plants in the office absorb carbon dioxide and can make the air feel fresher for employees.
sentences.zh: 辦公室裡的植物會吸收二氧化碳，能讓員工覺得空氣比較清新。

sentences.en: The government plans to charge companies a fee for every ton of carbon dioxide they produce.
sentences.zh: 政府打算對企業每生產一噸二氧化碳就收取一筆費用。

sentences.en: A sensor in the meeting room warns staff when the level of carbon dioxide becomes too high.
sentences.zh: 會議室裡的感測器會在二氧化碳濃度太高時警告員工。

words.note: 語塊：carbon dioxide（二氧化碳，CO₂）、carbon dioxide emissions（二氧化碳排放）、reduce／cut carbon dioxide（減少二氧化碳）。di（二）＋oxide（氧化物）＝二氧化物。相關：carbon footprint（碳足跡）、greenhouse gas（溫室氣體）、oxygen（氧氣）。

words.meaning: 排放；排放物（尤其是廢氣）

sentences.en: Most carbon emissions in the region are produced by burning fossil fuels in power plants and vehicles.
sentences.zh: 這個地區大部分的碳排放，都是發電廠和車輛燃燒化石燃料產生的。

sentences.en: The energy company promised its shareholders that it would reduce its emissions by half before the year 2035.
sentences.zh: 這家能源公司向股東承諾，會在 2035 年前把排放量減半。

sentences.en: New government rules require all delivery trucks to meet stricter emissions standards starting next January.
sentences.zh: 政府新規定要求所有貨車從明年一月起符合更嚴格的排放標準。

sentences.en: Switching to solar panels helped the factory cut its greenhouse gas emissions by twenty percent last year.
sentences.zh: 改用太陽能板讓工廠去年的溫室氣體排放減少了兩成。

sentences.en: Customers can check the emissions of each car model on our website before visiting the showroom.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在去展示中心之前，先在我們網站上查每款車的排放量。

words.note: 語塊：carbon emissions（碳排放）、reduce／cut emissions（減少排放）、emissions standards（排放標準）、greenhouse gas emissions（溫室氣體排放）。動詞 emit（排放、發出）。別跟 missions（任務）、admissions（入場、入學）、omissions（遺漏）搞混，字尾都一樣。

words.meaning: 化石燃料（煤、石油、天然氣）

sentences.en: Many countries are trying to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels by investing in wind and solar power.
sentences.zh: 許多國家正投資風力和太陽能發電，試著減少對化石燃料的依賴。

sentences.en: Emissions from burning fossil fuels are one of the main causes of air pollution in large cities.
sentences.zh: 燃燒化石燃料產生的排放，是大城市空氣污染的主要原因之一。

sentences.en: The airline announced it will replace some fossil fuels with cleaner fuel made from used cooking oil.
sentences.zh: 航空公司宣布會用廢食用油做的較乾淨燃料，取代部分化石燃料。

sentences.en: Rising prices for fossil fuels have made electric cars more attractive to many drivers this year.
sentences.zh: 化石燃料價格上漲，讓電動車今年對很多駕駛更有吸引力。

sentences.en: The new factory runs entirely on renewable energy and does not burn any fossil fuels at all.
sentences.zh: 新工廠完全使用再生能源，完全不燃燒任何化石燃料。

words.note: 語塊：burn fossil fuels（燃燒化石燃料）、dependence on fossil fuels（對化石燃料的依賴）、replace fossil fuels（取代化石燃料）。fossil（化石）＋fuels（燃料）。常見的化石燃料：coal（煤）、oil（石油）、natural gas（天然氣）。相反的是 renewable energy（再生能源）。

sentences.en: To some extent, the drop in sales was caused by the rainy weather during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 某種程度上，銷售下滑是假期期間下雨造成的。

sentences.en: Engineers are still trying to determine the full extent of the damage after the fire in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 倉庫火災後，工程師還在試著確認損失的全部範圍。

sentences.en: The manager was surprised by the extent to which customers relied on the online chat service.
sentences.zh: 經理很驚訝顧客依賴線上客服的程度。

sentences.en: To a large extent, the success of the project depended on the hard work of the design team.
sentences.zh: 專案的成功很大程度上是靠設計團隊的努力。

sentences.en: The report explains the extent of the company's investment in renewable energy over the past five years.
sentences.zh: 報告說明了公司過去五年投資再生能源的程度。

words.note: 語塊：to some extent（某種程度上）、to a large／great extent（很大程度上）、the full extent of（……的全部範圍、嚴重程度）、the extent to which（……的程度）。別跟動詞 extend（延長、延伸）搞混，拼法只差一個字母（-ent 名詞／-end 動詞）。

sentences.en: The new café downtown has a relaxed atmosphere that attracts many freelancers who work on their laptops.
sentences.zh: 市中心那家新咖啡店氣氛很輕鬆，吸引很多帶筆電工作的自由工作者。

sentences.en: Our manager works hard to create a friendly atmosphere where employees feel comfortable sharing new ideas.
sentences.zh: 我們經理很努力營造友善的氣氛，讓員工能自在地分享新點子。

sentences.en: Factories and cars that burn fossil fuels release large amounts of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere every year.
sentences.zh: 燃燒化石燃料的工廠和汽車，每年都把大量二氧化碳排放到大氣中。

sentences.en: Guests praised the hotel restaurant for its warm atmosphere and excellent service during the holiday dinner.
sentences.zh: 客人稱讚飯店餐廳在節日晚宴時氣氛溫馨、服務很好。

sentences.en: The atmosphere in the office became tense as the deadline for the big project got closer.
sentences.zh: 隨著大專案的截止日越來越近，辦公室的氣氛變得很緊繃。

words.note: 語塊：a relaxed／friendly／warm atmosphere（輕鬆／友善／溫馨的氣氛）、create an atmosphere（營造氣氛）、into the atmosphere（排到大氣中）。atmosphere 有兩個意思：①氣氛、氛圍（餐廳、辦公室）②大氣層（地球外面那層空氣）。形容詞 atmospheric（大氣的；有氣氛的）。口語也常用 vibe 表示氣氛。

sentences.en: The cultivation of trees along the highway helps absorb carbon dioxide and reduce noise for nearby residents.
sentences.zh: 在高速公路旁種植樹木，有助吸收二氧化碳，也能幫附近居民減少噪音。

sentences.en: The tea company has been involved in the cultivation of high-quality tea leaves in the mountains for fifty years.
sentences.zh: 這家茶葉公司在山上種植高品質茶葉已經五十年了。

sentences.en: Rice cultivation requires a large amount of water, so farmers in the region are testing new irrigation methods.
sentences.zh: 種稻需要大量的水，所以這個地區的農民正在測試新的灌溉方法。

sentences.en: The government offers financial support to farmers who switch to the cultivation of organic vegetables.
sentences.zh: 政府提供資金補助給改種有機蔬菜的農民。

sentences.en: Strong relationships with clients require careful cultivation over many years, according to our sales director.
sentences.zh: 我們業務總監說，和客戶的良好關係需要多年細心經營。

words.note: 語塊：the cultivation of trees／crops（種植樹木／農作物）、rice／tea cultivation（種稻／種茶）、land under cultivation（耕地）。動詞 cultivate（種植；培養、經營），例如 cultivate relationships with clients（經營客戶關係）。和 agriculture（農業，整個產業）不同：cultivation 是「種植、栽培」這個動作。

sentences.en: The marketing department will use social media to publicize the grand opening of our new store in Taichung.
sentences.zh: 行銷部門會用社群媒體宣傳我們台中新店的盛大開幕。

sentences.en: We hired a local agency to help publicize the charity concert and increase ticket sales.
sentences.zh: 我們請了一家本地廣告公司，幫忙宣傳慈善音樂會、提高門票銷量。

sentences.en: The city plans to publicize the new recycling rules through posters, radio ads, and community meetings.
sentences.zh: 市政府打算透過海報、廣播廣告和社區會議，宣傳新的回收規定。

sentences.en: Small businesses often publicize special events on their websites because it costs much less than television advertising.
sentences.zh: 小商家常在自己的網站宣傳特別活動，因為比電視廣告便宜很多。

sentences.en: The company decided not to publicize the details of the agreement until both sides had signed the contract.
sentences.zh: 公司決定在雙方簽約之前，先不公開協議的細節。

words.note: 語塊：publicize an event（宣傳活動）、publicize the opening（宣傳開幕）、widely publicized（廣為宣傳的）。名詞 publicity（宣傳；知名度）。和 publish（出版、發表）不同：publish 是「把書、文章印出來或貼出來」，publicize 是「讓很多人知道」。同義詞：promote、advertise。英式拼法是 publicise。

words.meaning: 業餘的；外行的；不專業的

sentences.en: The photography contest is open to amateur photographers who have never sold their work professionally.
sentences.zh: 這個攝影比賽開放給從沒專業賣過作品的業餘攝影師參加。

sentences.en: Many amateur athletes from local companies will take part in the charity marathon next Sunday.
sentences.zh: 很多來自本地公司的業餘運動員，下週日會參加慈善馬拉松。

sentences.en: The community center offers weekly classes for amateur painters who want to improve their watercolor skills.
sentences.zh: 社區中心為想精進水彩技巧的業餘畫家，每週開課。

sentences.en: Although the band started as an amateur group playing in coffee shops, it now performs at large concert halls.
sentences.zh: 雖然這個樂團一開始只是在咖啡店表演的業餘團體，現在已經在大型音樂廳演出。

sentences.en: Several customers complained that the website looked amateur and did not match the quality of our products.
sentences.zh: 好幾位顧客抱怨網站看起來很不專業，跟我們產品的品質不相符。

words.note: 語塊：amateur photographers／athletes（業餘攝影師／運動員）、an amateur group／team（業餘團體／隊伍）、look amateur（看起來不專業）。amateur 是「業餘的」，反義詞是 professional（專業的、職業的）。可以當名詞：He is an amateur.（他是業餘的）。也可以帶負面意思：「外行、不專業」。

sentences.en: Visitors can pick up a free pamphlet about the museum's history at the information desk near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 參觀者可以在入口附近的服務台拿一本介紹博物館歷史的免費小冊子。

sentences.en: The health department distributed a pamphlet explaining how to prevent the flu during the winter months.
sentences.zh: 衛生局發了一本小冊子，說明冬天如何預防流感。

sentences.en: Please read the safety pamphlet carefully before you operate any of the machines in the factory.
sentences.zh: 操作工廠裡任何機器之前，請仔細閱讀安全手冊。

sentences.en: Our marketing team designed a colorful pamphlet to introduce the new apartment buildings to potential buyers.
sentences.zh: 我們行銷團隊設計了一本彩色小冊子，向潛在買家介紹新的公寓大樓。

sentences.en: Each new employee receives a short pamphlet that explains the company's rules about vacation and sick leave.
sentences.zh: 每位新員工都會拿到一本簡短的小冊子，說明公司休假和病假的規定。

words.note: 語塊：a free pamphlet（免費小冊子）、distribute a pamphlet（發小冊子）、a safety／information pamphlet（安全／資訊手冊）、pick up a pamphlet（拿一本小冊子）。pamphlet 是幾頁訂在一起、介紹或說明某件事的小冊子。相近：brochure（宣傳型錄，比較精美、常用在商品和旅遊）、leaflet／flyer（只有一張的傳單）、handout（會議或課堂發的講義）。

sentences.en: The art center will hold a pottery exhibit featuring bowls and vases made by local artists next month.
sentences.zh: 藝術中心下個月會舉辦陶藝展，展出本地藝術家做的碗和花瓶。

sentences.en: Employees can sign up for a pottery class on Friday evenings as part of the company's wellness program.
sentences.zh: 員工可以報名週五晚上的陶藝課，這是公司健康計畫的一部分。

sentences.en: The gift shop sells handmade pottery and other traditional crafts from villages across the island.
sentences.zh: 禮品店販售手工陶器和來自全島各村莊的其他傳統工藝品。

sentences.en: Visitors to the factory can watch skilled workers make pottery by hand on a spinning wheel.
sentences.zh: 參觀工廠的人可以看技術熟練的工人用轉盤手工做陶器。

sentences.en: Please handle the pottery carefully when unpacking the boxes, because some pieces are very old and fragile.
sentences.zh: 拆箱時請小心拿這些陶器，因為有些作品非常古老又易碎。

words.note: 語塊：a pottery exhibit／exhibition（陶藝展）、a pottery class（陶藝課）、handmade pottery（手工陶器）、make pottery（做陶器）。pot（壺、罐）→ pottery（陶器）、potter（陶藝家）。別跟 poetry（詩）搞混，拼法很像。相關：ceramics（陶瓷，比較正式）、porcelain（瓷器）。

sentences.en: Cleaning crews will vacuum the carpets in all meeting rooms on Friday evening after the staff have gone home.
sentences.zh: 星期五晚上員工下班後，清潔人員會幫所有會議室的地毯吸塵。

sentences.en: The hotel replaced the old carpets in every guest room as part of its renovation project last year.
sentences.zh: 飯店去年整修時，把每間客房的舊地毯都換掉了。

sentences.en: The store sells handmade carpets from Turkey and Iran in a wide range of colors and sizes.
sentences.zh: 這家店販售從土耳其和伊朗來的手工地毯，有各種顏色和尺寸。

sentences.en: Please do not bring drinks into the lobby, because the new carpets are expensive and difficult to clean.
sentences.zh: 請不要帶飲料進大廳，因為新地毯很貴又很難清潔。

sentences.en: A professional company will come next week to deep clean the carpets on the second and third floors.
sentences.zh: 下週會有專業公司來深層清潔二樓和三樓的地毯。

words.note: 語塊：vacuum the carpets（用吸塵器吸地毯）、replace the carpets（換地毯）、clean the carpets（清潔地毯）、handmade carpets（手工地毯）。carpet 通常鋪滿整個地板、固定住；rug 是比較小、可以移動的小地毯。red carpet 是「紅地毯；隆重的接待」。

words.meaning: 無障礙；方便使用、進入的程度

sentences.en: The new office was designed to meet the accessibility requirements of workers with disabilities, including wide doors and ramps.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室的設計符合身障員工的無障礙需求，包括寬門和坡道。

sentences.en: The company hired a consultant to improve the accessibility of its website for users with poor eyesight.
sentences.zh: 公司請了顧問，為視力不好的使用者改善網站的無障礙設計。

sentences.en: Before choosing a venue for the conference, the organizers checked its accessibility for guests in wheelchairs.
sentences.zh: 主辦單位在選會議場地前，先確認了輪椅來賓進出是否方便。

sentences.en: The city council approved funding to improve accessibility at all subway stations over the next three years.
sentences.zh: 市議會核准了經費，在未來三年改善所有捷運站的無障礙設施。

sentences.en: Good accessibility to public transportation is one reason many businesses choose to rent offices in this area.
sentences.zh: 交通便利、容易搭大眾運輸，是很多公司選擇在這區租辦公室的原因之一。

words.note: 語塊：accessibility requirements（無障礙需求、規定）、improve accessibility（改善無障礙設施／便利性）、accessibility for＋人（對……的方便程度）。形容詞 accessible（可進入的；方便使用的），例如 wheelchair accessible（輪椅可通行）。別跟 availability（是否有空、可取得）搞混：accessibility 是「好不好進去、好不好用」，availability 是「有沒有、空不空」。

sentences.en: The training program was created to help people with disabilities find stable jobs in the hotel industry.
sentences.zh: 這個培訓計畫是為了幫助身心障礙者在飯店業找到穩定的工作。

sentences.en: Our company provides special equipment, such as adjustable desks and screen readers, for employees with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 我們公司為身心障礙員工提供特殊設備，例如可調整高度的書桌和螢幕報讀軟體。

sentences.en: The law requires public buildings to be designed so that visitors with physical disabilities can enter easily.
sentences.zh: 法律規定公共建築的設計，要讓有肢體障礙的訪客能輕鬆進入。

sentences.en: Several companies in the region won awards this year for hiring and supporting workers with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 這個地區有好幾家公司今年因為聘用和支持身障員工而得獎。

sentences.en: The science museum offers free guided tours for children with learning disabilities every Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 科學博物館每週六早上為有學習障礙的孩童提供免費導覽。

words.note: 語塊：people／workers with disabilities（身心障礙者／身障員工）、physical disabilities（肢體障礙）、learning disabilities（學習障礙）。單數 disability；dis（不）＋ability（能力）。形容詞 disabled（身障的），但現在比較有禮貌的說法是 people with disabilities，把「人」放前面。別跟 abilities（能力）、facilities（設施）搞混。

words.meaning: 身心障礙的；（機器、功能）停用的

sentences.en: The building has wide elevators and ramps so that disabled workers can move easily between floors.
sentences.zh: 大樓有寬敞的電梯和坡道，讓身障員工可以輕鬆在樓層間移動。

sentences.en: Several parking spaces near the entrance are reserved for disabled drivers and their family members.
sentences.zh: 入口附近有好幾個停車位保留給身障駕駛及其家人。

sentences.en: The government offers tax benefits to companies that hire disabled employees and provide them with proper training.
sentences.zh: 政府提供稅務優惠給聘用身障員工並提供適當訓練的公司。

sentences.en: The online payment function has been temporarily disabled while our technicians fix a security problem.
sentences.zh: 技術人員修復安全問題期間，線上付款功能暫時停用。

sentences.en: Please make sure the alarm is disabled before you open the back door of the store in the morning.
sentences.zh: 早上打開店後門之前，請確認警報已經解除。

words.note: 語塊：disabled workers／employees（身障員工）、disabled parking（身障停車位）、be temporarily disabled（暫時停用）。和 people with disabilities 意思一樣，但現在比較有禮貌的說法是把「人」放前面：workers with disabilities。disabled 也可以指機器或功能「被關掉、停用」，例如 The account has been disabled.（帳號已被停用）。

sentences.en: Retired employees will receive their monthly pension payment directly in their bank accounts on the fifth of each month.
sentences.zh: 退休員工每個月五號會直接在銀行帳戶收到每月退休金。

sentences.en: The company contributes six percent of each worker's salary to a pension plan every month.
sentences.zh: 公司每個月都會提撥每位員工薪水的百分之六到退休金計畫。

sentences.en: Mr. Wu decided to retire early and live on his pension after working at the bank for thirty years.
sentences.zh: 吳先生在銀行工作三十年後，決定提早退休，靠退休金生活。

sentences.en: Employees who leave the company before five years of service may not be eligible for the full pension.
sentences.zh: 服務未滿五年就離職的員工，可能無法領取全額退休金。

sentences.en: The government announced changes to the pension system that will affect workers who retire after 2030.
sentences.zh: 政府宣布退休金制度的改變，會影響 2030 年後退休的勞工。

words.note: 語塊：pension payment（退休金給付）、pension plan／system（退休金計畫／制度）、live on a pension（靠退休金生活）、be eligible for a pension（有資格領退休金）。pension 是退休後定期領的錢。相關：retirement（退休）、retiree（退休人員）、pensioner（領退休金的人）。在歐洲 pension 也可以指小旅館、民宿。別跟 tension（緊張）、mansion（豪宅）搞混。
