sentences.zh: 病人應該提早十五分鐘到牙醫診所填寫必要的表格。

sentences.en: Employees who need a flu shot can visit a clinic near the office during their lunch break.
sentences.zh: 需要打流感疫苗的員工可以利用午休時間去辦公室附近的診所。

sentences.en: The new medical clinic will be open seven days a week, including evenings and national holidays.
sentences.zh: 新診所一週七天都看診，包括晚上和國定假日。

sentences.en: Dr. Wong recently moved her dental clinic to a larger building closer to the subway station.
sentences.zh: 王醫師最近把她的牙醫診所搬到離捷運站更近、更大的大樓。

words.note: 語塊：medical clinic（診所）、dental clinic（牙醫診所）、visit a clinic（去診所看病）。clinic 是「診所」；hospital 是「醫院」，規模比較大。clinical 是形容詞「臨床的」。

sentences.en: The massage chair uses gentle vibration to relax each muscle contraction in the back and shoulders.
sentences.zh: 按摩椅用輕微的震動來放鬆背部和肩膀每一次的肌肉收縮。

sentences.en: Many small businesses closed during the period of economic contraction that followed the financial crisis.
sentences.zh: 金融危機後的經濟緊縮期間，許多小公司倒閉了。

sentences.en: Physical therapists teach exercises that improve muscle contraction for elderly patients who are recovering from knee surgery.
sentences.zh: 物理治療師教膝蓋手術後復原中的病人可以改善肌肉收縮的運動。

sentences.en: Analysts warn that a sharp drop in exports could lead to an economic contraction later this year.
sentences.zh: 分析師警告，出口大幅下滑可能導致今年稍晚經濟緊縮。

sentences.en: The fitness tracker measures each muscle contraction to show users how hard they are working.
sentences.zh: 這款健身手環測量每次肌肉收縮，讓使用者知道自己有多用力。

words.note: 語塊：muscle contraction（肌肉收縮）、economic contraction（經濟緊縮）。contraction 是「收縮」；contradiction（矛盾）只多兩個字母，意思不同。

sentences.en: Doctors say that standing up and stretching every hour can improve blood circulation for office workers.
sentences.zh: 醫生說，每小時起來伸展一下可以促進上班族的血液循環。

sentences.en: The new massage chair is designed to improve blood circulation in the legs and lower back.
sentences.zh: 新款按摩椅設計來促進腿部和下背部的血液循環。

sentences.en: People with poor blood circulation are advised to avoid sitting in one position for long periods.
sentences.zh: 血液循環不良的人被建議不要長時間維持同一個姿勢坐著。

sentences.en: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are two simple ways to improve blood circulation and overall health.
sentences.zh: 規律運動和均衡飲食是促進血液循環和整體健康的兩個簡單方法。

sentences.en: The spa offers a special treatment for customers who suffer from poor blood circulation in their feet.
sentences.zh: 水療中心為腳部血液循環不良的顧客提供特別療程。

words.note: 語塊：improve blood circulation（促進血液循環）、poor blood circulation（血液循環不良）。circulation 也可以指報紙雜誌的「發行量」（a daily circulation of 50,000）。

sentences.en: The fitness magazine claims that drinking green tea in the morning can boost metabolism throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 那本健身雜誌宣稱早上喝綠茶可以提高一整天的新陳代謝。

sentences.en: People with a slow metabolism may find it harder to lose weight even when they exercise regularly.
sentences.zh: 新陳代謝慢的人即使規律運動，也可能比較難減重。

sentences.en: Our nutrition experts will explain how sleep and stress can affect your metabolism at Thursday's seminar.
sentences.zh: 我們的營養專家會在週四的講座說明睡眠和壓力會怎麼影響你的新陳代謝。

sentences.en: The trainer recommended short, intense workouts to boost metabolism for members who have very busy work schedules.
sentences.zh: 教練建議行程忙碌的會員做短時間高強度的運動來提高新陳代謝。

sentences.en: As people get older, a slow metabolism is common, so doctors recommend staying active every day.
sentences.zh: 人年紀越大，新陳代謝慢是常見的事，所以醫生建議每天保持活動。

words.note: 語塊：boost metabolism（提高新陳代謝）、slow metabolism（新陳代謝慢）。metabolism 是「新陳代謝」；形容詞是 metabolic（代謝的）。

sentences.en: The new training program is designed to elevate the level of customer service in all of our stores.
sentences.zh: 新的訓練計畫是為了提高我們所有門市的客服水準。

sentences.en: After a long flight, passengers are advised to elevate their legs to improve blood circulation.
sentences.zh: 長途飛行後，建議乘客把腿抬高以促進血液循環。

sentences.en: The restaurant hopes to elevate the level of its cooking by hiring a famous chef from Paris next year.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳希望明年聘請一位巴黎的知名主廚來提升名聲。

sentences.en: The designers used warm lighting and wooden furniture to elevate the overall look of the hotel lobby.
sentences.zh: 設計師用溫暖的燈光和木製家具提升飯店大廳的整體質感。

sentences.en: Investing in staff education is one of the best ways to elevate the level of quality in a company.
sentences.zh: 投資員工教育是提高公司品質水準最好的方法之一。

words.note: 語塊：elevate the level of（提高……的水準）、elevate your legs（把腿抬高）。elevate 比 raise 正式；elevator（電梯）就是從這個字來的。

sentences.en: New employees will work under the supervision of a senior technician during their first three months.
sentences.zh: 新員工前三個月會在一位資深技師的監督下工作。

sentences.en: The construction project requires close supervision because the building is located next to a busy school.
sentences.zh: 這個工程需要密切監督，因為大樓就在一所人很多的學校旁邊。

sentences.en: All laboratory experiments must be carried out under the supervision of a qualified research scientist.
sentences.zh: 所有的實驗室實驗都必須在合格研究科學家的監督下進行。

sentences.en: Interns at the law firm handle simple cases under the supervision of experienced attorneys in the main office.
sentences.zh: 律師事務所的實習生在資深律師的監督下處理簡單的案件。

sentences.en: Young children may use the swimming pool only under close supervision by a parent or a lifeguard.
sentences.zh: 小孩子只有在父母或救生員密切看顧下才能使用游泳池。

words.note: 語塊：under the supervision of（在……的監督下）、close supervision（密切監督）。supervision 是名詞；supervise 是動詞「監督」；supervisor 是「主管」。

sentences.en: Running three times a week is a good way to build stamina before the company marathon in May.
sentences.zh: 一週跑三次步是五月公司馬拉松前增強體力的好方法。

sentences.en: Working long shifts at the hospital requires both physical stamina and a calm, patient personality.
sentences.zh: 在醫院上長班需要體力，也需要沉穩的個性。

sentences.en: The coach designed a training plan to help the players build stamina during the off-season.
sentences.zh: 教練設計了一套訓練計畫，幫助球員在休賽季增強體力。

sentences.en: Negotiating a complex contract for several days requires a great deal of mental stamina from the sales team.
sentences.zh: 連續好幾天談一份複雜的合約，需要業務團隊有很強的精神耐力。

sentences.en: Tour guides need excellent physical stamina because they often walk for hours with large groups of visitors.
sentences.zh: 導遊需要很好的體力，因為他們常常帶著一大群遊客走好幾個小時。

words.note: 語塊：build stamina（增強體力）、physical stamina（體力）、mental stamina（精神上的耐力）。stamina 是「耐力」；strength 偏「力氣」，stamina 偏「能撐多久」。

sentences.en: The engineering firm agreed to undertake a project to rebuild the old bridge over the river.
sentences.zh: 那家工程公司同意承接重建河上那座舊橋的專案。

sentences.en: The university will undertake research on how remote work affects employee health and productivity in large cities.
sentences.zh: 那所大學將進行研究，探討遠距工作如何影響員工健康和生產力。

sentences.en: Ms. Davis was asked to undertake the task of organizing the company's twentieth anniversary celebration.
sentences.zh: Davis 小姐被要求承擔籌辦公司二十週年慶的任務。

sentences.en: Before you undertake a project of this size, make sure that you have enough staff and funding.
sentences.zh: 在承接這麼大規模的專案之前，要先確定你有足夠的人力和資金。

sentences.en: Our consultants are qualified to undertake research in both the European and Asian markets for our clients.
sentences.zh: 我們的顧問有資格在歐洲和亞洲市場進行研究。

words.note: 語塊：undertake a project（承接專案）、undertake research（進行研究）、undertake a task（承擔任務）。undertake 比 do 或 start 正式，常用在工作、研究、責任。undertaker 卻是「殯葬業者」。

sentences.en: The factory hired fifty new workers in order to keep pace with demand for its electric scooters.
sentences.zh: 工廠為了跟上電動機車的需求，新聘了五十名工人。

sentences.en: It is difficult for small companies to keep pace with technology that changes so quickly every year.
sentences.zh: 小公司很難跟上每年變化這麼快的科技。

sentences.en: Salaries at the firm have not been able to keep pace with the rising cost of living in the city.
sentences.zh: 那家公司的薪水一直跟不上城市生活成本的上漲。

sentences.en: Our online store added more servers to keep pace with demand from the growing number of customers during the sale.
sentences.zh: 我們的網路商店增加了伺服器，以跟上特賣期間越來越多的顧客。

sentences.en: Retailers must keep pace with changing consumer tastes if they want to remain competitive in the market.
sentences.zh: 零售商如果想在市場上保持競爭力，就必須跟上不斷變化的消費者喜好。

words.note: 語塊：keep pace with demand（跟上需求）、keep pace with technology（跟上科技）。keep pace with 和 keep up with 意思相近，都是「跟上」。

sentences.en: The company plans to conduct research on consumer habits before launching its new line of snacks.
sentences.zh: 公司在推出新的零食系列之前，計畫先研究消費者的習慣。

sentences.en: According to our latest market research, young customers prefer to shop through mobile apps rather than visit physical stores.
sentences.zh: 根據我們最新的市場調查，年輕顧客比較喜歡用手機 App 購物。

sentences.en: The firm spends about ten percent of its annual budget on research and development every year.
sentences.zh: 那家公司每年把大約百分之十的年度預算花在研發上。

sentences.en: Dr. Simmons will present her research on renewable energy at the international conference in Berlin.
sentences.zh: Simmons 博士會在柏林的國際研討會上發表她對再生能源的研究。

sentences.en: Before opening a new branch, we always conduct research to understand the needs of local residents.
sentences.zh: 開新分店前，我們一定會先做研究，了解當地居民的需求。

words.note: 語塊：conduct research（進行研究）、market research（市場調查）、research and development（研發）。research 當名詞通常不可數，不加 s；「一項研究」可以說 a study。

sentences.en: Ms. Walsh has been promoted to director of product development at our regional office in Singapore.
sentences.zh: Walsh 小姐被升為我們新加坡辦公室的產品開發總監。

sentences.en: The company encourages professional development by paying for employees to attend online courses in the evening.
sentences.zh: 公司透過替員工支付線上課程的費用，鼓勵職業發展。

sentences.en: A new housing development with three hundred apartments is being built near the central train station.
sentences.zh: 火車站附近正在興建一個有三百戶公寓的新住宅建案。

sentences.en: Funding for product development has increased significantly since the firm received a large investment last spring.
sentences.zh: 自從公司獲得一大筆投資後，產品開發的經費大幅增加。

sentences.en: Workshops on leadership skills are part of the professional development program for all newly promoted managers.
sentences.zh: 領導技巧工作坊是新任經理職業發展計畫的一部分。

words.note: 語塊：product development（產品開發）、professional development（職業發展）、housing development（住宅建案）。development 可以是「發展」，也可以指「新建案」；developer 是「開發商」。

sentences.en: The city government will take steps to reduce traffic congestion in the downtown area next year.
sentences.zh: 市政府明年會採取措施減少市中心的交通壅塞。

sentences.en: Managers must take steps to ensure that all employees follow the new safety regulations in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 經理必須採取措施，確保所有員工遵守新的安全規定。

sentences.en: The airline promised to take steps to prevent similar delays from happening again in the future.
sentences.zh: 航空公司承諾會採取措施，避免以後再發生類似的延誤。

sentences.en: We need to take steps to protect customer data after the recent problems with our online system.
sentences.zh: 在最近線上系統出問題之後，我們需要採取措施保護顧客資料。

sentences.en: The hotel plans to take steps to lower its energy use, such as installing solar panels on the roof.
sentences.zh: 飯店計畫採取措施降低用電，例如在屋頂裝太陽能板。

words.note: 語塊：take steps to（採取措施去……）。take steps 和 take measures、take action 意思接近；後面接 to + 原形動詞。

sentences.en: The software company is based in Seoul but has sales offices in Tokyo and Singapore.
sentences.zh: 那家軟體公司總部設在首爾，但在東京和新加坡都有業務辦公室。

sentences.en: We are looking for a designer who is based in the Taipei area and can attend weekly meetings.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位住在台北地區、可以參加每週會議的設計師。

sentences.en: Ms. Ferrara works for a consulting firm based in Milan that specializes in fashion retail.
sentences.zh: Ferrara 小姐在一家總部位於米蘭、專門做時尚零售的顧問公司工作。

sentences.en: Although our team is based in London, most of our clients are located in North America.
sentences.zh: 雖然我們團隊在倫敦，但大部分客戶都在北美。

sentences.en: The airline, which is based in Dubai, will add three new routes to Southeast Asia this summer.
sentences.zh: 這家總部在杜拜的航空公司今年夏天將新增三條飛往東南亞的航線。

words.note: 語塊：be based in（總部設在……）、a company based in（總部在……的公司）。be based in 接地點；be based on 是「根據」，介系詞不同意思就不同。

sentences.en: The grand opening of our new branch in Kaohsiung will take place as planned on the first of June.
sentences.zh: 我們高雄新分店的盛大開幕會按照計畫在六月一日舉行。

sentences.en: The website will be unavailable for two hours on Sunday morning because of planned maintenance on our servers.
sentences.zh: 因為伺服器預定維修，網站週日早上會有兩個小時無法使用。

sentences.en: The planned opening of the shopping mall has been delayed because several stores are not ready yet.
sentences.zh: 購物中心的預定開幕延後了，因為好幾家店還沒準備好。

sentences.en: If everything goes as planned, the new production line will start operating at the beginning of next month.
sentences.zh: 如果一切按照計畫進行，新的生產線下個月初就會開始運作。

sentences.en: Residents were informed of the planned water outage through letters that were delivered to every apartment.
sentences.zh: 居民透過送到每一戶的信件得知預定停水的消息。

words.note: 語塊：as planned（按照計畫）、planned maintenance（預定的維修）、planned opening（預定開幕）。planned 是「預定的」；planed（刨平的）少一個 n，是木工用語。

sentences.en: The automobile company plans to open a production plant in Vietnam to reduce its manufacturing costs.
sentences.zh: 那家汽車公司計畫在越南開設生產工廠，以降低製造成本。

sentences.en: More than two hundred local residents will be hired when the new production plant opens next spring.
sentences.zh: 新的生產工廠明年春天開工時，將會聘僱兩百多名當地居民。

sentences.en: The production plant manager will give the visiting investors a tour of the facility on Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 工廠廠長週三早上會帶來訪的投資人參觀廠區。

sentences.en: Because of the heavy snow, operations at the production plant were suspended for two days last week.
sentences.zh: 因為大雪，生產工廠上週停工了兩天。

sentences.en: The company decided to open a production plant closer to its main customers in order to shorten delivery times.
sentences.zh: 公司決定在離主要客戶更近的地方開設生產工廠，以縮短交貨時間。

words.note: 語塊：open a production plant（開設生產工廠）、production plant manager（工廠廠長）。plant 在商業英文常指「工廠」，不是「植物」；factory 意思相同。

sentences.en: The report shows a sharp rise in online sales since the company launched its new mobile app in March.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示，自從公司三月推出新的手機 App 以來，網路銷售急劇上升。

sentences.en: A rise in fuel prices has forced many airlines to increase their ticket prices for international flights.
sentences.zh: 油價上漲迫使許多航空公司調高國際航班的票價。

sentences.en: The number of people working from home has been on the rise for the past several years.
sentences.zh: 過去幾年來，在家工作的人數一直在增加。

sentences.en: Economists predict a small rise in unemployment as several large factories close at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家預測，隨著幾家大工廠年底關閉，失業率會小幅上升。

sentences.en: Store managers have noticed a rise in demand for healthy snacks among customers in their twenties.
sentences.zh: 店長們注意到二十幾歲顧客對健康零食的需求增加了。

words.note: 語塊：a rise in（……的上升）、a sharp rise（急劇上升）、on the rise（正在增加）。rise 當名詞是「增加」，後面接 in；raise 當名詞是「加薪」（美式：a raise）。

sentences.en: The CEO took the opportunity to reiterate the importance of customer satisfaction at the annual meeting.
sentences.zh: 執行長利用年度大會的機會重申顧客滿意度的重要性。

sentences.en: In her email, the manager wanted to reiterate her commitment to supporting the team through the busy season.
sentences.zh: 經理在電子郵件中想重申她會在旺季支持團隊的承諾。

sentences.en: I would like to reiterate that all visitors must wear safety helmets while they are inside the factory.
sentences.zh: 我要再次強調，所有訪客在工廠內都必須戴安全帽。

sentences.en: The spokesperson will reiterate the company's commitment to reducing plastic waste during the press conference.
sentences.zh: 發言人會在記者會上重申公司減少塑膠垃圾的承諾。

sentences.en: Let me reiterate the importance of submitting your expense reports before the end of each month.
sentences.zh: 我再強調一次，每個月底前交出支出報告是很重要的。

words.note: 語塊：reiterate the importance of（重申……的重要性）、reiterate one's commitment to（重申對……的承諾）。reiterate 是「再說一次、強調」，比 repeat 正式；iterate 是「反覆執行」。

sentences.en: The new museum downtown features works of contemporary art by young painters from across Asia.
sentences.zh: 市中心的新博物館展出來自亞洲各地年輕畫家的當代藝術作品。

sentences.en: Our hotel combines traditional architecture with contemporary design to create a unique experience for guests.
sentences.zh: 我們飯店結合傳統建築和現代設計，為客人打造獨特的體驗。

sentences.en: The festival will feature performances of contemporary music by both local and international artists in the park.
sentences.zh: 音樂節將有國內外藝人演出的當代音樂表演。

sentences.en: The furniture store specializes in contemporary design, so most of its products have simple, clean shapes.
sentences.zh: 那家家具店專門做現代設計，所以大部分產品的造型都簡單俐落。

sentences.en: Critics praised the gallery for presenting contemporary art in a way that is easy for beginners to understand.
sentences.zh: 評論家稱讚那家藝廊以初學者容易理解的方式呈現當代藝術。

words.note: 語塊：contemporary art（當代藝術）、contemporary design（現代設計）、contemporary music（當代音樂）。contemporary 和 modern 都是「現代的」，contemporary 更強調「當下這個時代」，也可當名詞「同時代的人」。

sentences.en: The bakery still uses traditional methods to make its bread, even though it now has modern ovens.
sentences.zh: 那家麵包店雖然現在有了新式烤箱，仍用傳統方法做麵包。

sentences.en: Visitors to the city can enjoy traditional cuisine at the night market near the old temple.
sentences.zh: 到這座城市的遊客可以在老廟附近的夜市享用傳統料理。

sentences.en: The hotel's rooms feature traditional design elements such as sliding wooden doors and paper lanterns.
sentences.zh: 飯店的房間有木門和紙燈籠等傳統設計元素。

sentences.en: Many customers prefer traditional methods of payment, so the store will continue to accept cash and checks.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客比較喜歡傳統的付款方式，所以店家會繼續接受現金和支票。

sentences.en: The restaurant's menu offers traditional cuisine from southern Italy as well as a few modern dishes.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的菜單提供義大利南部的傳統料理，也有幾道現代菜色。

words.note: 語塊：traditional methods（傳統方法）、traditional cuisine（傳統料理）、traditional design（傳統設計）。traditional 是「傳統的」；conventional（慣例的、傳統的）意思接近，但偏「一般常見的做法」。

sentences.en: The craft shop sells glazed pottery made by local artists in a small village near the mountains.
sentences.zh: 那家手工藝品店販售山區附近一個小村莊在地藝術家做的上釉陶器。

sentences.en: The bathroom walls were covered with glazed tiles that are easy to clean and resistant to water.
sentences.zh: 浴室牆面貼著容易清潔又防水的釉面磁磚。

sentences.en: Every morning, the café offers fresh coffee and a glazed doughnut for only three dollars.
sentences.zh: 咖啡廳每天早上提供新鮮咖啡加一個糖霜甜甜圈，只要三美元。

sentences.en: The renovation of the hotel lobby included replacing the old floor with glazed tiles in a light color.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳的翻修包括把舊地板換成淺色的釉面磁磚。

sentences.en: Visitors to the exhibition can watch artists shape and paint glazed pottery in a workshop next to the gallery.
sentences.zh: 參觀展覽的遊客可以在展場旁的工作室看藝術家塑形、彩繪上釉陶器。

words.note: 語塊：glazed pottery（上釉的陶器）、glazed tiles（釉面磁磚）、glazed doughnut（糖霜甜甜圈）。glaze 是「釉、糖衣」，glazed 是「上了釉的」；glass（玻璃）和 gazed（凝視）長得像，別搞混。

sentences.en: The new office desks have a dark wood finish that matches the cabinets in the conference room.
sentences.zh: 新的辦公桌是深色木紋表面，和會議室的櫃子很搭。

sentences.en: Customers who order printed photographs online can choose a glossy finish for an additional two dollars per set.
sentences.zh: 在網路上訂購沖洗照片的顧客，每組多付兩美元就可以選亮面。

sentences.en: The designer recommended a matte finish for the kitchen cabinets because it does not show fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 設計師建議廚房櫥櫃用霧面，因為不會留下指紋。

sentences.en: Our premium business cards are printed on thick paper with a glossy finish that looks very professional.
sentences.zh: 我們的高級名片印在有亮面處理的厚紙上，看起來非常專業。

sentences.en: The furniture maker applies a protective finish to every table to prevent damage from water and heat.
sentences.zh: 那家家具廠會在每張桌子上塗一層保護塗層，避免被水和熱損壞。

words.note: 語塊：a glossy finish（亮面）、a matte finish（霧面）、wood finish（木頭表面處理）。finish 當名詞可以指家具、紙張的「表面處理」；finish 當動詞是「完成」。

sentences.en: The new software is designed to help small businesses manage their accounts and invoices more efficiently.
sentences.zh: 新軟體是設計來幫助小公司更有效率地管理帳務的。

sentences.en: This chair is specially designed to support your lower back during long hours of office work.
sentences.zh: 這張椅子是專門設計來在長時間辦公時支撐你的下背部。

sentences.en: The training program is designed to prepare new employees for their roles in the customer service department.
sentences.zh: 這個訓練計畫旨在讓新員工準備好在客服部的工作。

sentences.en: The building's windows are designed to let in natural light while keeping the rooms cool in summer.
sentences.zh: 大樓的窗戶設計成可以讓自然光進來，同時讓房間在夏天保持涼爽。

sentences.en: Our new backpack is designed to carry a laptop, documents, and a water bottle comfortably.
sentences.zh: 我們的新背包是設計來舒適地裝筆電、文件和水壺的。

words.note: 語塊：be designed to（被設計來……）、be specially designed to（專門設計來……）。be designed to + 原形動詞（設計來做……）；be designed for + 名詞（為……設計）。

sentences.en: Restaurants can save a lot of money if they buy in bulk from our wholesale warehouse.
sentences.zh: 餐廳如果在我們的批發倉庫大量購買，可以省很多錢。

sentences.en: Customers who order in bulk will receive a fifteen percent discount and free delivery to their offices.
sentences.zh: 大量訂購的顧客可以享有八五折和免費送貨到辦公室。

sentences.en: The office manager decided to buy paper and printer ink in bulk to reduce monthly supply costs.
sentences.zh: 辦公室經理決定大量購買紙張和印表機墨水，減少每個月的耗材成本。

sentences.en: Products that are sold in bulk usually come in simple packaging to save on materials and shipping.
sentences.zh: 大量販售的商品通常用簡單的包裝，以節省材料和運費。

sentences.en: Schools that order in bulk before August can receive their textbooks in time for the new semester.
sentences.zh: 在八月前大量訂購的學校，可以及時在新學期拿到課本。

words.note: 語塊：buy in bulk（大量購買）、order in bulk（大量訂購）。in bulk 指「大量、整批」；bulky 是形容詞「體積大的、笨重的」。

sentences.en: The clothing brand will open a retail outlet in the new shopping center near the airport next year.
sentences.zh: 那個服飾品牌明年將在機場附近的新購物中心開設一家門市。

sentences.en: The company operates a retail outlet in every major city and sells most of its products online as well.
sentences.zh: 那家公司在每個大城市都有一家門市，大部分產品也在網路上販售。

sentences.en: Each retail outlet is required to submit a weekly sales report to the regional manager every Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 每家門市都必須在每週一早上把每週銷售報告交給區域經理。

sentences.en: Customers can pick up their online orders at any retail outlet without paying an additional shipping fee.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在任何一家門市取網路訂單，不用另外付運費。

sentences.en: The electronics maker decided to open a retail outlet downtown so that customers could test its products in person.
sentences.zh: 那家電子廠決定在市中心開一家門市，讓顧客可以親自試用產品。

words.note: 語塊：open a retail outlet（開設門市）、each retail outlet（每家門市）。outlet 可以指「零售店」，也可以指「插座」或 outlet mall（暢貨中心）。

sentences.en: All visitors to the construction site must observe the safety rules and wear a helmet at all times.
sentences.zh: 所有到工地的訪客都必須遵守安全規則，而且隨時戴著安全帽。

sentences.en: The bank will observe the national holiday and remain closed on Monday, so please plan your visits accordingly.
sentences.zh: 銀行會因國定假日在週一休息，所以請事先安排好前來的時間。

sentences.en: Researchers will observe closely how shoppers move through the store before they redesign the layout.
sentences.zh: 研究人員在重新設計店面配置前，會仔細觀察顧客在店裡怎麼走動。

sentences.en: New employees are encouraged to observe experienced staff members during their first week of training.
sentences.zh: 新員工在第一週訓練期間被鼓勵觀察資深員工的做法。

sentences.en: Drivers who do not observe the speed limits on the factory grounds will lose their parking permits.
sentences.zh: 在廠區內沒有遵守速限的駕駛會被取消停車許可。

words.note: 語塊：observe the rules（遵守規則）、observe a holiday（過節；放假）、observe closely（仔細觀察）。observe 除了「觀察」，也有「遵守規定」的意思，和 follow、obey 接近；preserve（保存）長得像。

sentences.en: Buses to the conference center leave the hotel with an interval of twenty minutes throughout the morning.
sentences.zh: 往會議中心的接駁車整個上午每隔二十分鐘從飯店出發。

sentences.en: The security guards patrol the building with an interval of thirty minutes between each round during the night shift.
sentences.zh: 夜班警衛巡邏大樓時，每一輪之間間隔三十分鐘。

sentences.en: After a short interval, the second half of the concert began with a famous piece by Beethoven.
sentences.zh: 短暫休息後，音樂會下半場以一首貝多芬的知名曲子開場。

sentences.en: The interval between the two training sessions gives employees enough time to have lunch and check their email.
sentences.zh: 兩場訓練課程之間的空檔讓員工有足夠時間吃午餐和收信。

sentences.en: Doctors recommend a short interval of rest every hour for workers who spend the day looking at computer screens.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議整天看電腦螢幕的上班族每小時休息一下。

words.note: 語塊：an interval of（……的間隔）、a short interval（短暫的間隔）、the interval between（……之間的間隔）。interval 指「兩件事之間的時間」；at regular intervals（定期地）是常見複數用法。intermission 指表演的「中場休息」。

sentences.en: The airline issued a statement to express regret for the long delays that passengers experienced last weekend.
sentences.zh: 航空公司發表聲明，對乘客上週末遭遇的長時間延誤表示歉意。

sentences.en: The hotel manager called the guest personally to express regret for the noise from the construction next door.
sentences.zh: 飯店經理親自打電話給那位客人，對隔壁施工的噪音表示歉意。

sentences.en: We would like to express regret for any confusion caused by the error in our latest product catalog.
sentences.zh: 我們想對最新產品目錄中的錯誤所造成的任何困擾表示歉意。

sentences.en: The company will express regret for the data problem and offer affected customers a free service upgrade.
sentences.zh: 公司會對資料問題表示歉意，並提供受影響的顧客免費升級服務。

sentences.en: In his letter, the director wanted to express regret for missing the opening ceremony because of illness.
sentences.zh: 主任在信中想對自己因病錯過開幕典禮表示遺憾。

words.note: 語塊：express regret for（對……表示遺憾）、express sincere regret（表達誠摯的歉意）。express regret for 比 apologize for 更正式，常見於公司聲明；regret 本身也可當動詞「後悔、遺憾」。

sentences.en: Please accept our sincere apology for the delay in shipping your order during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 對於節慶期間延遲寄出您的訂單，請接受我們誠摯的道歉。

sentences.en: The CEO expressed her sincere thanks to all the volunteers who helped organize the charity event.
sentences.zh: 執行長向所有幫忙籌辦慈善活動的志工表達衷心的感謝。

sentences.en: We would like to express our sincere appreciation for your many years of loyal service to the company.
sentences.zh: 我們想對您多年來對公司的忠誠服務表達真誠的感激。

sentences.en: The restaurant sent a sincere apology and a gift card to the customer who had received the wrong meal.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳向拿到錯餐點的顧客送上誠摯的道歉和一張禮物卡。

sentences.en: Mr. Tanaka is known for his sincere and friendly manner, which makes clients feel comfortable working with him.
sentences.zh: 田中先生以真誠友善的態度出名，讓客戶跟他合作時覺得很自在。

words.note: 語塊：sincere apology（誠摯的道歉）、sincere thanks（衷心的感謝）、sincere appreciation（真誠的感激）。sincere 是「真心的」，副詞 sincerely 常用在書信結尾（Sincerely, ...）。

sentences.en: Employees must report an incident to their supervisor immediately if anyone is injured at work.
sentences.zh: 如果有人在工作中受傷，員工必須立刻向主管通報。

sentences.en: There was a minor incident in the parking lot this morning, but fortunately nobody was hurt.
sentences.zh: 今天早上停車場發生一起小事故，但幸好沒有人受傷。

sentences.en: The annual music festival ended without incident thanks to careful planning by the security team.
sentences.zh: 多虧保全團隊縝密的規劃，年度音樂節平安無事地落幕。

sentences.en: The airline is investigating an incident in which a passenger's luggage was sent to the wrong city.
sentences.zh: 航空公司正在調查一起乘客行李被送到錯誤城市的事件。

sentences.en: Please use the online form to report an incident involving damaged equipment in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 倉庫設備損壞的事件，請用線上表單通報。

words.note: 語塊：report an incident（通報事件）、a minor incident（小事故）、without incident（平安無事地）。incident 是「事件」；accident 是「意外事故」；incidence（發生率）拼法很像。

sentences.en: We are sorry for the late delivery, and we would like to make it up to you with a free month of service.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉延遲送達，我們想用免費一個月的服務來補償您。

sentences.en: The restaurant manager offered a free dessert to make it up to the guests who had waited a long time.
sentences.zh: 餐廳經理招待免費甜點，補償那些等了很久的客人。

sentences.en: I missed your presentation because of a meeting, but I will make it up to you by helping with the next one.
sentences.zh: 我因為開會錯過了你的簡報，但下次的簡報我會幫忙，算是補償你。

sentences.en: To make it up to its loyal customers, the hotel is offering a twenty percent discount on their next stay.
sentences.zh: 為了補償忠實顧客，飯店提供下次住宿打八折的優惠。

sentences.en: The airline promised to make it up to passengers on the canceled flight by giving them extra travel points.
sentences.zh: 航空公司承諾送給被取消航班的乘客額外的哩程點數作為補償。

words.note: 語塊：make it up to sb（補償某人）。make it up to sb 是口語的「彌補某人」；make up for sth 是「彌補某事」，後面接的東西不同。

sentences.en: Please send an invoice to our accounting department as soon as the project has been completed.
sentences.zh: 專案一完成，請把發票寄給我們的會計部。

sentences.en: The system will automatically send a reminder to customers two days before their scheduled appointment.
sentences.zh: 系統會在顧客預約時間的兩天前自動寄出提醒。

sentences.en: We plan to send out the invitations for the grand opening by the end of next week.
sentences.zh: 我們計畫在下週末前寄出盛大開幕的邀請函。

sentences.en: The company will send three engineers to the factory in Malaysia to help install the new equipment.
sentences.zh: 公司將派三名工程師到馬來西亞的工廠協助安裝新設備。

sentences.en: If you would like to receive our newsletter, please send an email with your name to the address below.
sentences.zh: 如果你想收到我們的電子報，請把你的名字寄到下方的電子信箱。

words.note: 語塊：send an invoice（寄發票）、send a reminder（寄提醒）、send out（寄出；發出）。send 是「寄、送出去」；deliver 偏「送達」到對方手上。

sentences.en: Our technicians can make a house call to repair your washing machine for an additional fee of thirty dollars.
sentences.zh: 我們的技師可以到府修理洗衣機，需另外支付三十美元。

sentences.en: Dr. Russo is one of the few doctors in the area who still makes a house call for elderly patients.
sentences.zh: Russo 醫師是這一帶少數仍會為年長病人出診的醫生之一。

sentences.en: The computer repair shop offers a house call service for customers who cannot bring their devices to the store.
sentences.zh: 那家電腦維修店為無法把裝置帶到店裡的顧客提供到府服務。

sentences.en: If you schedule a house call before noon, a technician will visit your home the same afternoon.
sentences.zh: 如果你在中午前預約到府服務，技師當天下午就會到你家。

sentences.en: Customers who purchase the premium warranty are entitled to one free house call every year.
sentences.zh: 購買高級保固的顧客每年可以享有一次免費到府服務。

words.note: 語塊：make a house call（到府服務；出診）、house call service（到府服務）、schedule a house call（預約到府服務）。house call 原本指醫生「出診」，現在也用在維修人員「到府服務」。

sentences.en: In response to customer feedback, the café has added more vegetarian options to its lunch menu.
sentences.zh: 為了回應顧客意見，咖啡廳在午餐菜單上增加了更多素食選擇。

sentences.en: We have not yet received a response from the supplier regarding the delayed shipment of parts.
sentences.zh: 關於零件延遲出貨的事，我們還沒收到供應商的回覆。

sentences.en: Thank you for your prompt response to our request for a price estimate on the office renovation.
sentences.zh: 謝謝您迅速回覆我們對辦公室翻修報價的請求。

sentences.en: The new product received a positive response from customers who tested it at the trade show in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 新產品在芝加哥商展上試用過的顧客那裡獲得正面的回應。

sentences.en: The city council made changes to the parking plan in response to complaints from local business owners.
sentences.zh: 市議會為了回應當地商家的抱怨，修改了停車計畫。

words.note: 語塊：in response to（回應……）、receive a response（收到回覆）、a prompt response（迅速的回應）。response 是名詞；respond 是動詞（respond to）；responsible（負責的）長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: The repair shop keeps a large supply of spare parts so that most machines can be fixed within a day.
sentences.zh: 修理店備有大量的備用零件，所以大部分機器一天內就能修好。

sentences.en: Many employees use their spare time to take online courses that help them develop new professional skills.
sentences.zh: 很多員工利用空閒時間上線上課程，培養新的專業技能。

sentences.en: The building manager keeps a spare key for every office in a locked cabinet near the front desk.
sentences.zh: 大樓管理員把每間辦公室的備用鑰匙鎖在櫃台附近的櫃子裡。

sentences.en: If you have any spare time this afternoon, could you help us prepare the materials for tomorrow's workshop?
sentences.zh: 如果你今天下午有空，可以幫我們準備明天工作坊的資料嗎？

sentences.en: The airline always carries spare parts for its aircraft in case of mechanical problems at smaller airports.
sentences.zh: 航空公司總是攜帶飛機的備用零件，以防在小機場遇到機械問題。

words.note: 語塊：spare parts（備用零件）、spare time（空閒時間）、spare key（備用鑰匙）。spare 當形容詞是「多出來、備用的」；當動詞可以表示「撥出（時間）」：Can you spare a few minutes?

sentences.en: Ms. Wang has been a regular customer of the bakery since it first opened on Elm Street ten years ago.
sentences.zh: 王小姐從那家麵包店十年前在 Elm 街開幕以來就一直是常客。

sentences.en: Every regular customer receives a free cup of coffee after collecting ten stamps on a loyalty card.
sentences.zh: 每位常客在集點卡上集滿十個章，就可以得到一杯免費咖啡。

sentences.en: The store plans to reward each regular customer with special discounts during its anniversary sale next month.
sentences.zh: 店家計畫在下個月的週年慶特賣期間，用特別折扣回饋每位常客。

sentences.en: The waiter remembered that the regular customer always orders the same soup and a glass of iced tea.
sentences.zh: 服務生記得那位常客總是點同一道湯和一杯冰紅茶。

sentences.en: Because Mr. Diaz is a regular customer of our hotel, he was upgraded to a suite at no extra charge.
sentences.zh: 因為 Diaz 先生是我們飯店的常客，他被免費升等到套房。

words.note: 語塊：a regular customer of（……的常客）、reward regular customers（回饋常客）。regular customer 和 loyal customer（忠實顧客）意思接近；regular 也可以單獨當名詞指「常客」。

sentences.en: The award recipient will be announced at the end of the annual dinner on Friday evening.
sentences.zh: 得獎者將在週五晚上年度晚宴的最後公布。

sentences.en: If this email has reached you by mistake, please delete it and notify the intended recipient immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果你誤收了這封郵件，請刪除並立刻通知原本的收件人。

sentences.en: Dr. Mendez was the recipient of a national prize for her research on clean energy last year.
sentences.zh: Mendez 博士去年因為她在潔淨能源的研究獲得一項全國性的獎項。

sentences.en: Each recipient of the scholarship must maintain good grades in order to keep receiving the funding.
sentences.zh: 每位獎學金得主必須維持好成績才能繼續拿到補助。

sentences.en: Packages that cannot be delivered will be returned to the sender if the recipient is not at home.
sentences.zh: 如果收件人不在家，無法投遞的包裹會退回給寄件人。

words.note: 語塊：award recipient（得獎者）、the intended recipient（預定的收件人）、recipient of（……的接受者）。recipient 是「收到東西的人」；receipt（收據）和 recipe（食譜）長得像，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: A famous food critic visited the new restaurant last week and praised its creative seafood dishes.
sentences.zh: 一位知名美食評論家上週造訪那家新餐廳，稱讚它創意十足的海鮮料理。

sentences.en: The movie received excellent reviews from almost every film critic who attended the festival in Venice.
sentences.zh: 那部電影獲得幾乎每位參加威尼斯影展的影評人的極佳評價。

sentences.en: The gallery invited an art critic to give a short talk about the paintings at the opening reception.
sentences.zh: 藝廊邀請一位藝評家在開幕酒會上簡短介紹這些畫作。

sentences.en: Even the toughest critic agreed that the new hotel offered excellent service at a reasonable price.
sentences.zh: 連最嚴格的評論家都同意，那家新飯店以合理的價格提供了優質服務。

sentences.en: The magazine hired a well-known food critic to write a monthly column about local restaurants.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌聘請一位知名美食評論家撰寫介紹在地餐廳的每月專欄。

words.note: 語塊：food critic（美食評論家）、film critic（影評人）、art critic（藝評家）。critic 是「人」（評論家）；criticism 是「批評」；critique 是「評論文章」；critical 是形容詞。

sentences.en: Please enclose a copy of your receipt when you return the damaged item to our service center.
sentences.zh: 把損壞的商品退回我們的服務中心時，請附上收據的副本。

sentences.en: Applicants should enclose a copy of their résumé and two letters of recommendation with the application form.
sentences.zh: 申請人應在申請表中附上履歷副本和兩封推薦信。

sentences.en: I will enclose a copy of the signed contract so that you can keep it for your records.
sentences.zh: 我會附上一份已簽好的合約副本，讓你留存。

sentences.en: We enclose a brochure that describes all of the services our firm offers to small businesses.
sentences.zh: 我們隨信附上一份手冊，介紹本公司為小企業提供的所有服務。

sentences.en: The landlord plans to enclose the backyard with a wooden fence to give tenants more privacy.
sentences.zh: 房東計畫用木頭圍欄圍住後院，讓房客有更多隱私。

words.note: 語塊：enclose a copy of（附上……的副本）、please find enclosed（隨信附上……）。enclose 常用在商業書信「隨信附上」；attach 用在電子郵件「附加檔案」。

sentences.en: The mayor will present an award to the volunteers who helped clean the city's parks this summer.
sentences.zh: 市長將頒獎給今年夏天幫忙清潔市內公園的志工。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed is scheduled to present a proposal for a new customer loyalty program at Monday's meeting.
sentences.zh: Ahmed 小姐預定在週一的會議上提出一個新的顧客忠誠計畫提案。

sentences.en: The research team will present findings from the two-year study at a conference in Boston next month.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊下個月會在波士頓的研討會上報告那項兩年研究的結果。

sentences.en: Visitors must present a valid photo ID at the front desk before they can enter the building.
sentences.zh: 訪客必須在櫃台出示有效的附照片證件才能進入大樓。

sentences.en: Each team will have fifteen minutes to present its marketing plan to the board of directors.
sentences.zh: 每一組會有十五分鐘向董事會報告行銷計畫。

words.note: 語塊：present an award（頒獎）、present a proposal（提出提案）、present findings（報告研究結果）。present 當動詞重音在後（pre-SENT），意思是「報告、頒發」；當名詞、形容詞重音在前（PRE-sent），是「禮物、現在的」。

sentences.en: The president of the association will make a brief remark before the first speaker takes the stage at nine.
sentences.zh: 協會理事長會在九點第一位講者上台前簡短致詞。

sentences.en: The manager made a remark about the importance of teamwork before announcing the sales results.
sentences.zh: 經理在宣布業績之前發表了一段關於團隊合作重要性的評論。

sentences.en: After a brief remark from the host, guests were invited to enjoy refreshments in the lobby outside the hall.
sentences.zh: 主持人簡短發言後，邀請來賓到會場外的大廳享用茶點。

sentences.en: The CEO apologized for a careless remark that she had made during an interview with a local newspaper.
sentences.zh: 執行長為她接受地方報紙採訪時一句不小心的言論道歉。

sentences.en: Please do not make a remark about the new product to reporters until the official announcement next week.
sentences.zh: 下週正式宣布之前，請不要對記者發表任何關於新產品的評論。

words.note: 語塊：make a remark（發表評論）、a brief remark（簡短的發言）、a careless remark（隨口的一句話）。remark 是「簡短的評論」，comment 意思接近；複數常見於 opening remarks（開場致詞）。remarkable 是形容詞「非凡的」。

sentences.en: New customers can open an account online in just a few minutes by entering their personal information.
sentences.zh: 新顧客只要輸入個人資料，幾分鐘內就能在網路上開戶。

sentences.en: Your salary will be deposited directly into your bank account on the last business day of each month.
sentences.zh: 你的薪水會在每個月最後一個工作天直接存入你的銀行帳戶。

sentences.en: When planning the budget, please take into account the rising cost of materials and shipping.
sentences.zh: 規劃預算時，請把材料和運費上漲列入考慮。

sentences.en: Ms. Bianchi manages the firm's largest account, a supermarket chain with stores in five countries.
sentences.zh: Bianchi 小姐負責公司最大的客戶，一家在五個國家都有門市的連鎖超市。

sentences.en: Customers who open an account before the end of June will receive a gift card worth fifty dollars.
sentences.zh: 六月底前開戶的顧客可以拿到價值五十美元的禮物卡。

words.note: 語塊：open an account（開戶）、bank account（銀行帳戶）、take into account（考慮到）。account 除了「帳戶」，也可以指「客戶」（a major account 大客戶）；take sth into account 是「把……列入考慮」。

sentences.en: Employees must not share confidential information about clients with anyone outside the company, including family members and friends.
sentences.zh: 員工不得把客戶的機密資訊分享給公司以外的任何人。

sentences.en: The details of the merger are strictly confidential until the official announcement at the press conference next Monday.
sentences.zh: 合併的細節在下週一正式宣布之前都是極機密。

sentences.en: All salary information will be kept confidential and stored in a secure database in the human resources office.
sentences.zh: 所有薪資資料都會保密，存放在人資部的安全資料庫裡。

sentences.en: Please shred any documents that contain confidential information before you throw them away at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 任何含有機密資訊的文件，丟掉之前請先用碎紙機銷毀。

sentences.en: The survey results will be kept confidential, so employees can share their honest opinions about management.
sentences.zh: 調查結果會保密，所以員工可以誠實分享對管理階層的看法。

words.note: 語塊：confidential information（機密資訊）、strictly confidential（極機密）、keep confidential（保密）。confidential 是「機密的」；confident（有信心的）少了 -ial，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: The marketing team will conduct a survey to find out what customers think about our new packaging.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊會進行一項調查，了解顧客對我們新包裝的看法。

sentences.en: Ms. Novak will conduct an interview with each of the five candidates for the accounting position next week.
sentences.zh: Novak 小姐下週會和會計職缺的五位候選人逐一面試。

sentences.en: The university received a government grant to conduct research on the effects of air pollution on children.
sentences.zh: 那所大學獲得政府補助，研究空氣污染對兒童的影響。

sentences.en: Inspectors will conduct a safety check of the entire factory before the new machines are put into use.
sentences.zh: 新機器啟用前，檢查員會對整座工廠進行安全檢查。

sentences.en: We plan to conduct a survey of hotel guests to learn how we can improve our breakfast service.
sentences.zh: 我們打算對飯店房客進行調查，了解如何改善早餐服務。

words.note: 語塊：conduct a survey（進行調查）、conduct an interview（進行面試）、conduct research（做研究）。conduct 當動詞是「進行（調查、面試、研究）」，比 do 正式；當名詞（CON-duct）是「行為」。

sentences.en: Despite her hectic schedule, the director always makes time to meet with new employees during their first week.
sentences.zh: 儘管行程很滿，主任總是會在新員工的第一週抽空和他們見面。

sentences.en: After a hectic day of meetings, Mr. Park decided to finish the report at home in the evening.
sentences.zh: 開了一整天會、忙亂的一天之後，Park 先生決定晚上在家把報告寫完。

sentences.en: The restaurant staff work at a hectic pace during the lunch hour, when hundreds of office workers come in.
sentences.zh: 午餐時間有數百名上班族湧入，餐廳員工以忙亂的步調工作。

sentences.en: The weeks before the product launch were hectic, but the team managed to finish everything on time.
sentences.zh: 產品發表前的那幾週很忙亂，但團隊還是設法準時完成所有工作。

sentences.en: Many employees find it hard to exercise regularly because of their hectic schedule during the busy season.
sentences.zh: 很多員工因為旺季行程繁忙，覺得很難規律運動。

words.note: 語塊：hectic schedule（繁忙的行程）、hectic day（忙碌的一天）、hectic pace（忙亂的步調）。hectic 是「忙到有點亂」；busy 只是「忙」，hectic 更強調匆忙混亂。

sentences.en: All department managers must submit a report on their quarterly expenses by the end of next week.
sentences.zh: 所有部門經理必須在下週結束前提交季度支出報告。

sentences.en: Candidates who wish to submit an application for the internship should do so through our website.
sentences.zh: 想申請實習的人，應該透過我們的網站遞交申請。

sentences.en: Please remember to submit your travel receipts by Friday so that the accounting team can process your refund.
sentences.zh: 請記得在週五前提交差旅收據，讓會計團隊處理你的退款。

sentences.en: Researchers who want to present at the conference must submit an abstract of their paper by March tenth.
sentences.zh: 想在研討會發表的研究人員，必須在三月十日前提交論文摘要。

sentences.en: The contractor was asked to submit a report explaining why the construction project was behind schedule.
sentences.zh: 承包商被要求提交一份報告，說明工程為什麼落後進度。

words.note: 語塊：submit a report（提交報告）、submit an application（遞交申請）、submit by（在……之前提交）。submit 是「交出去給上級或單位審核」；hand in 意思接近但比較口語。

sentences.en: The airline added a fuel surcharge to all international tickets because of the rising price of oil.
sentences.zh: 因為油價上漲，航空公司對所有國際機票加收燃油附加費。

sentences.en: Restaurants in the area impose a surcharge of ten percent on all bills during national holidays.
sentences.zh: 這一帶的餐廳在國定假日對所有帳單加收一成的附加費。

sentences.en: Customers who choose same-day delivery must pay a surcharge for the service in addition to the regular shipping fee.
sentences.zh: 選擇當日到貨的顧客，除了一般運費之外還要支付該服務的附加費。

sentences.en: The hotel does not charge a surcharge for early check-in if rooms are available before noon.
sentences.zh: 如果中午前有空房，飯店不會因為提早入住而收附加費。

sentences.en: The taxi company will impose a surcharge on rides that begin after midnight starting next month.
sentences.zh: 計程車公司從下個月起，會對午夜後開始的車程加收附加費。

words.note: 語塊：fuel surcharge（燃油附加費）、impose a surcharge（加收附加費）、a surcharge for（……的附加費）。surcharge 是「在原價之外另加的費用」；extra charge 意思相同但比較口語。

sentences.en: The cosmetics company will give away free samples of its new face cream at the shopping mall this weekend.
sentences.zh: 那家化妝品公司這個週末會在購物中心發送新面霜的免費樣品。

sentences.en: The radio station plans to give away prizes, including concert tickets, to listeners who call in on Friday.
sentences.zh: 電台打算在週五送出演唱會門票等獎品給打電話進來的聽眾。

sentences.en: The bookstore decided to give away its old magazines to the public library instead of throwing them out.
sentences.zh: 書店決定把舊雜誌送給公立圖書館，而不是丟掉。

sentences.en: To celebrate its tenth anniversary, the café will give away a free drink to the first fifty customers.
sentences.zh: 為了慶祝十週年，咖啡廳會送免費飲料給前五十位顧客。

sentences.en: Please do not give away any details about the new product before the official launch event in May.
sentences.zh: 在五月正式發表會之前，請不要洩露任何新產品的細節。

words.note: 語塊：give away free samples（發送免費樣品）、give away prizes（送出獎品）、give away a free（免費送出一個……）。give away 是「免費送出」；give out 是「分發」；give up 是「放棄」。

sentences.en: Technicians are still trying to locate the problem that caused the network to fail this morning.
sentences.zh: 技師們還在設法找出今天早上造成網路故障的問題。

sentences.en: Engineers used special cameras to locate the source of the water leak behind the walls of the lobby.
sentences.zh: 工程師用特殊攝影機找出大廳牆後漏水的來源。

sentences.en: Customers can use the map on our website to locate a store that carries the full range of our products.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以用我們網站上的地圖找到有販售全系列商品的門市。

sentences.en: If you cannot locate your reservation number, please contact our customer service team for assistance.
sentences.zh: 如果你找不到你的訂位代號，請聯絡我們的客服團隊協助。

sentences.en: The company decided to locate its new factory in a region where land and labor are less expensive.
sentences.zh: 公司決定把新工廠設在土地和勞工比較便宜的地區。

words.note: 語塊：locate the problem（找出問題）、locate the source of（找出……的來源）、locate a store（找到門市）。locate 本身是「找出位置」；be located in / at 是「位於」。

sentences.en: Please call the restaurant before six o'clock to confirm your reservation for Saturday evening's dinner.
sentences.zh: 請在六點前打電話給餐廳，確認您週六晚上的訂位。

sentences.en: The clinic will send a text message one day in advance to confirm your appointment with the doctor.
sentences.zh: 診所會在前一天傳簡訊確認您和醫生的約診。

sentences.en: Could you please reply to this email to confirm receipt of the documents that we sent yesterday?
sentences.zh: 可以請你回覆這封郵件，確認收到我們昨天寄出的文件嗎？

sentences.en: The supplier was unable to confirm the delivery date because the parts were still being manufactured.
sentences.zh: 供應商無法確認交貨日期，因為零件還在生產中。

sentences.en: Before booking your flight, please confirm the dates of the conference with the event organizers.
sentences.zh: 訂機票之前，請先向活動主辦單位確認研討會的日期。

words.note: 語塊：confirm a reservation（確認預約）、confirm an appointment（確認約診）、confirm receipt of（確認收到）。confirm 是「確認是真的或確定」；conform（遵守、符合）只差一個字母。

sentences.en: The building owner hopes that the renovated lobby will help attract a new tenant for the empty top floor.
sentences.zh: 大樓業主希望翻新的大廳能為空著的頂樓吸引一位新房客。

sentences.en: Each tenant is responsible for paying the electricity bill for his or her own apartment every month.
sentences.zh: 每位房客每個月都要自行支付自己公寓的電費。

sentences.en: The landlord must give every tenant at least thirty days' notice before increasing the monthly rent.
sentences.zh: 房東在調漲月租前，必須給每位房客至少三十天的通知。

sentences.en: A new tenant will move into the office space on the third floor at the beginning of next month.
sentences.zh: 下個月初會有一位新房客搬進三樓的辦公空間。

sentences.en: The largest tenant of the shopping center is a supermarket that has been there for more than fifteen years.
sentences.zh: 那座購物中心最大的承租人是一家已經在那裡十五年以上的超市。

words.note: 語塊：attract tenants（吸引房客）、a new tenant（新房客）、tenant of（……的承租人）。tenant 是「租房子的人」；landlord 是「房東」；tenet（信條）長得像。

sentences.en: We have decided to postpone the meeting with the investors until the financial report has been finalized.
sentences.zh: 我們決定把和投資人的會議延到財報定案之後。

sentences.en: The organizers had to postpone the outdoor concert until next Saturday because of the heavy rain forecast.
sentences.zh: 因為預報有大雨，主辦單位只好把戶外音樂會延到下週六。

sentences.en: The company may postpone the launch of its new smartphone if the supply of parts does not improve.
sentences.zh: 如果零件供應沒有改善，公司可能會延後新手機的上市。

sentences.en: Please let us know at least two days in advance if you need to postpone your appointment with the consultant.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要延後和顧問的約，請至少提前兩天告訴我們。

sentences.en: The city council voted to postpone the construction of the new library until more funding becomes available.
sentences.zh: 市議會投票決定把新圖書館的興建延到有更多經費時再進行。

words.note: 語塊：postpone a meeting（會議延期）、postpone until（延到……）、postpone the launch（延後上市）。postpone 是「延後到之後再做」；cancel 是「取消」；put off 是口語的同義詞。

sentences.en: The hotel plans to renovate the building's lobby and restaurant before the start of the tourist season.
sentences.zh: 飯店計畫在旅遊旺季開始前整修大樓的大廳和餐廳。

sentences.en: The owners of the café hired a local contractor to renovate the kitchen and install new ovens.
sentences.zh: 咖啡廳老闆請了當地的承包商翻修廚房並安裝新烤箱。

sentences.en: It will cost approximately two million dollars to renovate the old train station near the harbor.
sentences.zh: 整修港口附近的舊火車站大約要花兩百萬美元。

sentences.en: The museum will be closed for six months while workers renovate the building's roof and exhibition halls.
sentences.zh: 工人整修屋頂和展覽廳期間，博物館將休館六個月。

sentences.en: The landlord promised to renovate the bathrooms in every apartment before the new tenants move in.
sentences.zh: 房東承諾在新房客搬進來之前，翻修每間公寓的浴室。

words.note: 語塊：renovate the building（整修大樓）、renovate the kitchen（翻修廚房）、be renovated（被翻新）。renovate 是「把舊建築整修變新」；innovate（創新）長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: Construction of the shopping mall was stopped after workers found an archaeological site under the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 工人在停車場下面發現考古遺址後，購物中心的工程就停了下來。

sentences.en: The archaeological discovery attracted thousands of tourists to the small village during the summer months.
sentences.zh: 那項考古發現在夏季吸引了數千名觀光客到那個小村莊。

sentences.en: Our tour includes a visit to the national archaeological museum, which displays ancient tools and jewelry.
sentences.zh: 我們的行程包含參觀國立考古博物館，那裡展出古代的工具和珠寶。

sentences.en: The city hired experts to protect the archaeological site before the new subway line is built.
sentences.zh: 市政府在新捷運線興建之前，聘請專家保護那處考古遺址。

sentences.en: Visitors to the archaeological museum can watch a short film about how the ancient city was discovered.
sentences.zh: 參觀考古博物館的遊客可以看一部介紹那座古城如何被發現的短片。

words.note: 語塊：archaeological site（考古遺址）、archaeological discovery（考古發現）、archaeological museum（考古博物館）。archaeological 是形容詞；archaeology 是「考古學」；archaeologist 是「考古學家」。

sentences.en: The new online store is expected to generate revenue of more than one million dollars in its first year.
sentences.zh: 新的網路商店預計第一年會創造超過一百萬美元的營收。

sentences.en: The company hopes the television commercial will generate interest in its new line of sports drinks.
sentences.zh: 公司希望這支電視廣告能引起大家對新系列運動飲料的興趣。

sentences.en: The solar panels on the roof generate electricity for the entire office building during the daytime.
sentences.zh: 屋頂的太陽能板白天為整棟辦公大樓發電。

sentences.en: Hosting the international conference will generate revenue for many local hotels, restaurants, and taxi companies in the city.
sentences.zh: 舉辦國際研討會會替當地的飯店、餐廳和計程車公司帶來營收。

sentences.en: The marketing team organized a free tasting event to generate interest before the restaurant's official opening.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊在餐廳正式開幕前辦了一場免費試吃活動，引起大家的興趣。

words.note: 語塊：generate revenue（創造營收）、generate interest（引起興趣）、generate electricity（發電）。generate 常用在「產生營收、興趣、電力」；create 意思接近，但比較廣泛。

sentences.en: The government offers low-interest loans to help a small enterprise grow during its first few years.
sentences.zh: 政府提供低利貸款，幫助小企業在頭幾年成長。

sentences.en: Mr. Okafor left his job at a large bank to start his own enterprise selling organic coffee.
sentences.zh: Okafor 先生辭掉大銀行的工作，自己創業賣有機咖啡。

sentences.en: The railway was operated by a state-owned enterprise until it was sold to a private company last year.
sentences.zh: 那條鐵路原本由國營企業經營，直到去年賣給一家民營公司。

sentences.en: The conference will focus on how a private enterprise can work together with local governments.
sentences.zh: 研討會將聚焦在民營企業如何和地方政府合作。

sentences.en: Every small enterprise in the program receives free advice from experienced business consultants every month.
sentences.zh: 計畫裡的每家小企業都能得到資深企業顧問的免費建議。

words.note: 語塊：small enterprise（小企業）、private enterprise（民營企業）、state-owned enterprise（國營企業）。enterprise 是正式的「企業」；company、business 是一般說法；entrepreneur 是「創業家」。

sentences.en: The new CEO plans to simplify the organizational structure of the company by reducing the number of departments.
sentences.zh: 新執行長打算減少部門數量，簡化公司的組織架構。

sentences.en: The gym changed its pricing structure so that members can now choose monthly or yearly payment plans.
sentences.zh: 健身房改變了價格結構，會員現在可以選擇月繳或年繳方案。

sentences.en: A temporary structure will be built in the park to provide shade for visitors during the summer festival.
sentences.zh: 公園裡會搭建一個臨時建築，在夏季慶典期間替遊客遮陽。

sentences.en: Engineers inspected the structure of the bridge after the earthquake to make sure it was still safe.
sentences.zh: 地震後，工程師檢查了橋的結構，確定它仍然安全。

sentences.en: Employees were given a chart that explains the new organizational structure and lists each manager's responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 員工拿到一張圖表，說明新的組織架構並列出每位經理的職責。

words.note: 語塊：organizational structure（組織架構）、pricing structure（價格結構）、temporary structure（臨時建築）。structure 可以是「結構」，也可以指「建築物」；construction 是「建造（的過程）」。

sentences.en: Please print out the agenda and bring it with you to the meeting in the main conference room.
sentences.zh: 請把議程列印出來，帶到大會議室開會。

sentences.en: Could you print a copy of the contract for Mr. Silva so that he can review it on the train?
sentences.zh: 可以幫 Silva 先生印一份合約嗎？讓他在火車上看。

sentences.en: The publisher plans to print twenty thousand copies of the cookbook for its first edition.
sentences.zh: 出版社計畫第一版印兩萬本那本食譜。

sentences.en: To reduce paper waste, employees should print only the documents that they really need for their work.
sentences.zh: 為了減少紙張浪費，員工應該只列印真正需要的文件。

sentences.en: Visitors can print out their tickets at home or show the barcode on their phones at the entrance.
sentences.zh: 參觀者可以在家把票印出來，或在入口出示手機上的條碼。

words.note: 語塊：print out（列印出來）、print a copy（印一份）、in print（已出版；還在發行）。print 是「印出來」；sprint（衝刺）多一個 s，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: The newspaper had to issue a correction after it printed the wrong date for the city festival.
sentences.zh: 報紙把市立慶典的日期印錯後，只好發布更正。

sentences.en: Please make a correction to the sales figures on page three before the report is sent to the board.
sentences.zh: 報告寄給董事會之前，請修正第三頁的業績數字。

sentences.en: The editor found only one small correction that needed to be made to the final version of the brochure.
sentences.zh: 編輯在小冊子定稿中只找到一個需要修正的小地方。

sentences.en: If you notice any errors in your invoice, contact our billing department so that we can make a correction.
sentences.zh: 如果你發現發票有任何錯誤，請聯絡我們的帳務部，好讓我們更正。

sentences.en: The magazine will issue a correction in next month's edition regarding the price of the hotel's rooms.
sentences.zh: 雜誌會在下個月號針對那家飯店的房價發布更正。

words.note: 語塊：make a correction（更正）、issue a correction（發布更正）、corrections to（對……的修正）。correction 是名詞，correct 是動詞「改正」；collection（收藏）只差一個字母。

sentences.en: The manager called an emergency meeting to address an issue with the delivery schedule for next week.
sentences.zh: 經理召開緊急會議處理出貨時程的問題。

sentences.en: Rising rent has become a major issue for many small shops in the downtown area this year.
sentences.zh: 今年房租上漲已經成為市中心許多小店的重大問題。

sentences.en: The latest issue of the magazine includes an interview with the founder of a popular coffee chain.
sentences.zh: 最新一期的雜誌刊登了對一家熱門咖啡連鎖店創辦人的專訪。

sentences.en: If you have any issue with your account, please call our customer support line at any time.
sentences.zh: 如果你的帳戶有任何問題，請隨時撥打我們的客服專線。

sentences.en: The committee will address an issue raised by employees about the lack of parking spaces near the office.
sentences.zh: 委員會將處理員工提出的辦公室附近停車位不足的問題。

words.note: 語塊：address an issue（處理問題）、a major issue（重大問題）、the latest issue（最新一期）。issue 可以指「問題、議題」，也可以指雜誌的「一期」；當動詞是「發布、核發」。

sentences.en: Visitors must obtain permission from the security office before taking any photographs inside the factory.
sentences.zh: 訪客在工廠內拍照前，必須先取得保全室的許可。

sentences.en: The restaurant needs to obtain a permit from the city before it can serve food on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 餐廳在人行道上供餐前，需要先取得市政府的許可證。

sentences.en: Customers can obtain information about our products by visiting our website or calling our help desk.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以上我們的網站或打電話到服務台取得產品資訊。

sentences.en: It usually takes about two weeks to obtain a permit for building a new garage on your property.
sentences.zh: 在自己的土地上蓋新車庫，通常要大約兩週才能取得許可證。

sentences.en: Employees who wish to work from home must obtain permission from their direct supervisor first.
sentences.zh: 想在家工作的員工必須先取得直屬主管的許可。

words.note: 語塊：obtain permission（取得許可）、obtain a permit（取得許可證）、obtain information（取得資訊）。obtain 比 get 正式；名詞是 obtainment（較少用），一般用 acquisition。

sentences.en: The government offers tax breaks to help a fledgling company survive its first two years in business.
sentences.zh: 政府提供減稅，幫助新創公司撐過頭兩年的營運。

sentences.en: Ms. Choi invested her savings in a fledgling business that sells handmade soap at local markets.
sentences.zh: 崔小姐把積蓄投資在一個在當地市集賣手工肥皂、剛起步的事業。

sentences.en: The electric vehicle market was a fledgling industry ten years ago, but it is now growing rapidly.
sentences.zh: 電動車市場十年前還是新興產業，但現在正快速成長。

sentences.en: Mentors from large corporations volunteer to give advice to every fledgling company in the program.
sentences.zh: 來自大企業的導師自願給計畫裡每一家新創公司建議。

sentences.en: Running a fledgling business requires patience, because profits often take several years to appear in the accounts.
sentences.zh: 經營一個剛起步的事業需要耐心，因為往往要好幾年才會有獲利。

words.note: 語塊：fledgling company（新創公司）、fledgling business（剛起步的事業）、fledgling industry（新興產業）。fledgling 原指「剛學飛的小鳥」，引申為「剛起步、經驗不足的」；startup 是「新創公司」的一般說法。

sentences.en: The restaurant near the station is highly recommended by both local residents and food critics.
sentences.zh: 車站附近那家餐廳受到當地居民和美食評論家的極力推薦。

sentences.en: We are looking for a highly qualified engineer with at least ten years of experience in bridge design.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位非常合格、至少有十年橋樑設計經驗的工程師。

sentences.en: The smartphone market is highly competitive, so companies must release new and improved models every year.
sentences.zh: 手機市場競爭非常激烈，所以公司每年都必須推出新機型。

sentences.en: All of the candidates for the manager position were highly qualified, which made the final decision difficult.
sentences.zh: 經理職位的每位候選人都非常合格，讓最後的決定很難下。

sentences.en: This training course is highly recommended for new employees who will be working directly with customers.
sentences.zh: 這門訓練課程極力推薦給將會直接接觸顧客的新員工。

words.note: 語塊：highly recommended（極力推薦）、highly qualified（非常合格的）、highly competitive（競爭非常激烈的）。highly 是「非常」，不是「高高地」；表示實際高度要用 high（fly high）。

sentences.en: All restaurants in the city must meet strict sanitation standards and pass an inspection every year.
sentences.zh: 市內所有餐廳都必須符合嚴格的衛生標準，每年通過一次檢查。

sentences.en: The city has hired fifty additional sanitation workers to keep the streets clean during the festival.
sentences.zh: 市政府額外聘了五十名清潔人員，在慶典期間保持街道整潔。

sentences.en: Poor sanitation in the old factory led to several complaints from employees and a visit from inspectors.
sentences.zh: 舊工廠衛生條件差，引起好幾位員工抱怨，也招來檢查員到訪。

sentences.en: The hotel improved its sanitation standards after a guest posted a negative review about the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 一位房客發表了對浴室的負評後，飯店提高了衛生標準。

sentences.en: The charity raises money to provide clean water and better sanitation to villages in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體募款，為鄉村地區的村莊提供乾淨的水和更好的衛生設備。

words.note: 語塊：sanitation standards（衛生標準）、sanitation workers（清潔人員）、poor sanitation（衛生條件差）。sanitation 是「衛生（設施）」；sanity（理智）和 station（車站）長得像，意思不同。

words.meaning: 領固定薪水的；月薪制的

sentences.en: Every salaried employee at the firm is entitled to fifteen days of paid vacation each year.
sentences.zh: 公司每位月薪制員工每年都享有十五天的帶薪休假。

sentences.en: Ms. Rivera left her part-time job to accept a salaried position at a large insurance company.
sentences.zh: Rivera 小姐辭掉兼職工作，接受一家大型保險公司固定薪資的職位。

sentences.en: Unlike hourly workers, a salaried employee usually does not receive extra pay for working overtime.
sentences.zh: 和時薪人員不同，月薪制員工加班通常沒有額外的薪水。

sentences.en: The company plans to offer a salaried position to the interns who perform well this summer.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫提供固定薪資的職位給今年夏天表現好的實習生。

sentences.en: Benefits for each salaried employee include health insurance, a retirement plan, and a yearly bonus.
sentences.zh: 每位月薪制員工的福利包括健康保險、退休金計畫和年終獎金。

words.note: 語塊：salaried employee（月薪制員工）、salaried position（固定薪資的職位）。salaried 是「領固定月薪」；hourly（時薪的）是相對的概念；salary 是「薪水」。

words.meaning: 工資；薪資（多指時薪、週薪）

sentences.en: The government announced that the minimum wage will rise by five percent at the beginning of next year.
sentences.zh: 政府宣布明年初最低工資將調漲百分之五。

sentences.en: The coffee shop offers a competitive hourly wage and free meals to all of its part-time staff.
sentences.zh: 那家咖啡店提供所有兼職人員具競爭力的時薪和免費餐點。

sentences.en: Factory workers received a wage increase after the company reported record profits in the last quarter of the year.
sentences.zh: 公司上一季公布創紀錄的獲利後，工廠員工獲得加薪。

sentences.en: Many students choose jobs that pay more than the minimum wage so that they can save for tuition.
sentences.zh: 很多學生選擇薪水比最低工資高的工作，好存學費。

sentences.en: The union is negotiating a wage increase for employees who work night shifts at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 工會正在為醫院上夜班的員工爭取加薪。

words.note: 語塊：minimum wage（最低工資）、hourly wage（時薪）、wage increase（加薪）。wage 多指按時或按週領的「工資」；salary 是固定的「月薪、年薪」。

sentences.en: Passengers whose flights were canceled will receive compensation of up to six hundred euros each.
sentences.zh: 航班被取消的乘客每人最多可以獲得六百歐元的賠償。

sentences.en: The company offers a generous compensation package that includes stock options and a housing allowance.
sentences.zh: 公司提供優渥的薪酬方案，包括股票選擇權和住房津貼。

sentences.en: Customers may request compensation for any items that were damaged during delivery by filling out a simple online form.
sentences.zh: 顧客只要填寫簡單的線上表單，就可以要求賠償運送過程中損壞的任何商品。

sentences.en: Ms. Park accepted the job offer because the compensation package was much better than her current one.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐接受了那份工作，因為薪酬方案比她現在的好很多。

sentences.en: Workers who are injured on the job are entitled to receive compensation for their medical expenses.
sentences.zh: 在工作中受傷的員工有權獲得醫療費用的賠償。

words.note: 語塊：receive compensation（獲得賠償）、compensation package（薪酬方案）、compensation for（對……的賠償）。compensation 是「補償、賠償」，也可以指整體「薪酬」；名詞 compensation、動詞 compensate。

sentences.en: Many small farms rely on seasonal workers to help harvest their crops in the autumn.
sentences.zh: 很多小農場在秋天依靠季節性工人幫忙收割作物。

sentences.en: Our company has come to rely on its online store heavily, which accounts for most of our total sales.
sentences.zh: 我們公司非常依賴網路商店，那裡佔了大部分的總銷售額。

sentences.en: Customers rely on us for fast delivery, so we cannot accept delays at the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 顧客依賴我們快速送貨，所以我們不能接受倉庫有延誤。

sentences.en: Small businesses often rely on local banks for loans when they want to expand their operations.
sentences.zh: 小公司想擴大營運時，常常依賴當地銀行貸款。

sentences.en: The hotel does not rely on travel agencies anymore because most guests now book rooms directly online.
sentences.zh: 飯店不再依賴旅行社，因為大部分客人現在都直接在網路上訂房。

words.note: 語塊：rely on sb for sth（依靠某人提供某物）、rely heavily on（非常依賴）。rely on 和 depend on、count on 意思接近；形容詞是 reliable（可靠的）、reliant（依賴的）。

sentences.en: The main objective of the training program is to improve communication between managers and staff.
sentences.zh: 這個訓練計畫的主要目標是改善經理和員工之間的溝通。

sentences.en: The sales team worked overtime for several weeks in order to achieve an objective set by the director.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊連續好幾週加班，就為了達成主任設定的目標。

sentences.en: At the beginning of each year, every department must set an objective for sales and share it with senior management.
sentences.zh: 每年年初，每個部門都必須設定一個業績目標並向高階主管報告。

sentences.en: Reducing energy costs by ten percent is the main objective of the new environmental policy.
sentences.zh: 減少一成的能源成本是新環保政策的主要目標。

sentences.en: If we want to achieve an objective like this, we will need more staff and a larger budget.
sentences.zh: 如果我們想達成這樣的目標，就需要更多人手和更多預算。

words.note: 語塊：main objective（主要目標）、achieve an objective（達成目標）、set an objective（設定目標）。objective 當名詞是「目標」，和 goal、aim 意思接近；當形容詞是「客觀的」。

sentences.en: Managers will evaluate the performance of each employee at the end of the year before deciding on bonuses.
sentences.zh: 經理會在年底評估每位員工的績效，再決定獎金。

sentences.en: The research team needs more time to evaluate the results of the customer survey before writing its report.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊需要更多時間評估顧客調查的結果，再寫報告。

sentences.en: The committee will meet next Tuesday to evaluate a proposal for opening a branch office in Osaka.
sentences.zh: 委員會下週二會開會評估在大阪開設分公司的提案。

sentences.en: An outside consultant was hired to evaluate the efficiency of our shipping and delivery process.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位外部顧問來評估我們運送和配送流程的效率。

sentences.en: It is important to evaluate performance regularly so that employees know where they can improve.
sentences.zh: 定期評估績效很重要，這樣員工才知道哪裡可以改進。

words.note: 語塊：evaluate performance（評估績效）、evaluate the results（評估結果）、evaluate a proposal（評估提案）。evaluate 是「仔細評估價值或品質」；assess 意思接近；elevate（提高）長得像。

sentences.en: The prices listed on our website exclude tax and shipping, which will be added at checkout.
sentences.zh: 我們網站上列出的價格不含稅和運費，結帳時會另外加上。

sentences.en: Because of budget limits, we will exclude employees who joined after June from this year's bonus program.
sentences.zh: 因為預算有限，我們會把六月以後才進公司的員工排除在今年的獎金計畫之外。

sentences.en: The report does not exclude the possibility that sales may decline slightly in some regions next year.
sentences.zh: 報告並不排除明年銷售可能小幅下滑的可能性。

sentences.en: Please exclude any personal information from the files before you share them with the outside consultants.
sentences.zh: 在把檔案分享給外部顧問之前，請先排除任何個人資料。

sentences.en: The hotel's special package does exclude meals, so guests will need to pay for breakfast separately.
sentences.zh: 飯店的特別方案確實不含餐點，所以客人需要另外付早餐的費用。

words.note: 語塊：exclude from（把……排除在外）、exclude tax（不含稅）。exclude 是「不包括」；include（包括）是相反詞；excluding 常用來表示「不含……」。

sentences.en: Please attach all supporting documentation, such as receipts and invoices, to your monthly expense report.
sentences.zh: 請把收據和發票等所有證明文件附在你的支出報告上。

sentences.en: Applicants must provide documentation showing that they have worked in the industry for at least three years.
sentences.zh: 申請人必須提供證明自己在這個產業至少工作三年的文件。

sentences.en: Without proper documentation, the shipment cannot pass through customs and will be returned to the sender.
sentences.zh: 沒有適當的文件，貨物無法通關，會被退回給寄件人。

sentences.en: The software comes with detailed documentation that explains how to install and use each feature.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體附有詳細的說明文件，解釋如何安裝和使用每項功能。

sentences.en: Employees who request sick leave for more than three days must provide documentation from a doctor.
sentences.zh: 請病假超過三天的員工必須提供醫生的證明文件。

words.note: 語塊：supporting documentation（證明文件）、provide documentation（提供文件）、proper documentation（適當的文件）。documentation 是不可數名詞，指「一整套證明文件」；document 是可數的「一份文件」。

sentences.en: Lumen Electronics is a leading manufacturer of solar panels with factories in three different countries.
sentences.zh: Lumen 電子是一家領先的太陽能板製造商，在三個國家設有工廠。

sentences.en: If the product stops working within one year, please contact the manufacturer directly for a free repair.
sentences.zh: 如果產品在一年內故障，請直接聯絡廠商免費維修。

sentences.en: The car manufacturer announced that it will build a new production plant in the southern part of the country.
sentences.zh: 那家汽車製造商宣布，將在國內南部興建一座新的生產工廠。

sentences.en: Our company has worked with the same manufacturer of office furniture for more than fifteen years.
sentences.zh: 我們公司和同一家辦公家具製造商合作了十五年以上。

sentences.en: The manufacturer recommends that the air filters be replaced every six months for the best performance.
sentences.zh: 廠商建議每六個月更換一次空氣濾網，以獲得最佳效能。

words.note: 語塊：leading manufacturer（領先的製造商）、manufacturer of（……的製造商）、contact the manufacturer（聯絡廠商）。manufacturer 是「製造商」；manufacture 是動詞「製造」；retailer 是「零售商」。

sentences.en: Engineers hope to discover the problem before the factory reopens to workers on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 工程師希望在工廠週一早上重新開工前找出問題。

sentences.en: During the audit, the accountants may discover that some travel expenses were recorded twice by mistake.
sentences.zh: 在稽核過程中，會計師可能會發現有些支出被記錄了兩次。

sentences.en: Many visitors are surprised to discover how many restaurants are located in the old part of the city.
sentences.zh: 很多遊客驚訝地發現，老城區裡竟然有這麼多餐廳。

sentences.en: Customers who discover a problem with their order should contact us within seven days of delivery.
sentences.zh: 發現訂單有問題的顧客，應該在收到貨的七天內聯絡我們。

sentences.en: The research team was excited to discover that the new material was both lighter and stronger than steel.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊很興奮地發現，新材料比鋼更輕也更堅固。

words.note: 語塊：discover a problem（發現問題）、discover that（發現……）、be surprised to discover（驚訝地發現）。discover 是「發現本來就存在但不知道的事」；invent 是「發明新東西」。

sentences.en: Economists reported a sharp increase in consumer spending during the holiday season at the end of this year.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家報告，今年節慶期間消費支出大幅增加。

sentences.en: The government lowered taxes in order to boost consumer spending after the economy slowed down.
sentences.zh: 經濟放緩後，政府調降稅率以刺激消費。

sentences.en: Retailers are worried that higher interest rates could reduce consumer spending on cars and furniture.
sentences.zh: 零售商擔心利率上升可能會減少民眾在汽車和家具上的消費支出。

sentences.en: An increase in consumer spending usually helps restaurants, hotels, and many other service businesses grow.
sentences.zh: 消費支出增加通常會幫助餐廳、飯店和其他服務業成長。

sentences.en: The report shows that consumer spending on online entertainment has doubled over the past five years.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示，過去五年線上娛樂的消費支出成長了一倍。

words.note: 語塊：increase in consumer spending（消費支出增加）、boost consumer spending（刺激消費）。consumer spending 是經濟用語「民眾花錢消費的總額」；consumer 是「消費者」。

sentences.en: Please read each clause of the contract carefully before you sign it and return it to our office.
sentences.zh: 簽名並寄回我們辦公室之前，請仔細閱讀合約的每一條條款。

sentences.en: The lawyer suggested that we include a clause that allows us to end the agreement with thirty days' notice.
sentences.zh: 律師建議我們加入一條條款，允許我們提前三十天通知就能終止協議。

sentences.en: The rental agreement has a cancellation clause that requires tenants to pay a fee if they move out early.
sentences.zh: 租約有一條解約條款，規定房客提早搬走要付一筆費用。

sentences.en: According to the third clause, the supplier must deliver all parts within ten business days of each order.
sentences.zh: 根據第三條條款，供應商必須在每次下單後十個工作天內交付所有零件。

sentences.en: The two companies spent several weeks discussing a single contract clause about the sharing of profits.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司花了好幾週討論合約中一條關於利潤分配的條款。

words.note: 語塊：contract clause（合約條款）、include a clause（加入條款）、cancellation clause（解約條款）。clause 是合約上的「條款」；claws（爪子）發音一樣，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: Strict adherence to safety rules has helped the factory avoid serious accidents for over five years.
sentences.zh: 嚴格遵守安全規定讓工廠五年多來都沒有發生嚴重事故。

sentences.en: The airline is known for its adherence to schedules, and most of its flights arrive on time.
sentences.zh: 那家航空公司以遵守時刻表出名，大部分航班都準時抵達。

sentences.en: Inspectors will check each restaurant's adherence to the rules about food storage and kitchen cleanliness.
sentences.zh: 檢查員會檢查每家餐廳是否遵守食物保存和清潔的規定。

sentences.en: Managers emphasized that strict adherence to the dress code is expected when meeting with clients.
sentences.zh: 經理們強調，和客戶見面時應嚴格遵守服裝規定。

sentences.en: Our success is based on careful planning and adherence to the highest standards of quality.
sentences.zh: 我們的成功建立在仔細的規劃和遵守最高的品質標準上。

words.note: 語塊：strict adherence to（嚴格遵守）、adherence to the rules（遵守規則）。adherence 是名詞，動詞是 adhere to（遵守）；compliance with 意思接近。

sentences.en: Traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning because of an accident near the airport exit.
sentences.zh: 今天早上公路上的交通很塞，因為機場出口附近發生了事故。

sentences.en: Highway construction near the city center is expected to continue until the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 市中心附近的公路工程預計會持續到年底。

sentences.en: If you take the highway, you can reach the conference center in about forty minutes from downtown.
sentences.zh: 如果你走公路，從市中心大約四十分鐘就能到會議中心。

sentences.en: The new highway connecting the two cities will cut the travel time between them by almost half.
sentences.zh: 連接兩座城市的新公路將把兩地之間的車程縮短將近一半。

sentences.en: Drivers should use caution on the highway tonight because heavy rain is expected after nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 今晚開車上公路要小心，因為預計九點以後會下大雨。

words.note: 語塊：on the highway（在公路上）、highway construction（公路工程）、take the highway（走公路）。highway 是「主要幹道、公路」；freeway、expressway 多指「高速公路」。

sentences.en: Moving to a smaller office will help the company reduce operating expense by about twenty percent.
sentences.zh: 搬到比較小的辦公室可以幫助公司降低大約兩成的營運費用。

sentences.en: The annual operating expense of the museum is covered mostly by ticket sales and private donations.
sentences.zh: 博物館的年度營運費用大部分由門票收入和私人捐款支應。

sentences.en: Rent is the largest operating expense for most restaurants located in the downtown business district.
sentences.zh: 對市中心商業區的大部分餐廳來說，租金是最大的營運費用。

sentences.en: The new energy-saving lights are expected to reduce operating expense at all of our stores.
sentences.zh: 新的節能燈預計可以降低我們所有門市的營運費用。

sentences.en: The finance team prepared a chart that compares this year's annual operating expense with last year's.
sentences.zh: 財務團隊準備了一張圖表，比較今年和去年的年度營運費用。

words.note: 語塊：reduce operating expense（降低營運費用）、annual operating expense（年度營運費用）。operating expense 常寫成 operating expenses（複數）或 OPEX，指公司日常營運的花費，例如租金、水電、薪水。

sentences.en: Please fill out a form at the front desk before your first appointment with the doctor.
sentences.zh: 第一次看診前，請先在櫃台填一張表。

sentences.en: The application form for the scholarship must be submitted online by the end of this month.
sentences.zh: 獎學金申請表必須在這個月底前在線上提交。

sentences.en: Participants who want to attend the workshop should return the registration form by Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 想參加工作坊的人，應該在週五下午前交回報名表。

sentences.en: Customers who wish to return a product must fill out a form and include the original receipt.
sentences.zh: 想退貨的顧客必須填寫表格並附上原始收據。

sentences.en: The registration form asks for your name, email address, and the name of the company you work for.
sentences.zh: 報名表要填你的名字、電子信箱和你任職的公司名稱。

words.note: 語塊：fill out a form（填表）、application form（申請表）、registration form（報名表）。form 當名詞常指「表格」；fill out 和 fill in 都可以表示「填寫」。

sentences.en: The new tax policy will make it easier for small businesses to hire young workers.
sentences.zh: 新的稅收政策會讓小公司比較容易聘用年輕員工。

sentences.en: Many business owners are waiting to see whether the government will change tax policy after the election.
sentences.zh: 很多老闆都在觀望政府選後是否會改變稅收政策。

sentences.en: The finance minister explained the new tax policy at a press conference on Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 財政部長在週四下午的記者會上說明新的稅收政策。

sentences.en: Our accountants will hold a seminar to explain how the new tax policy affects our clients.
sentences.zh: 我們的會計師會舉辦講座，說明新的稅收政策如何影響我們的客戶。

sentences.en: Experts believe that a stable tax policy encourages foreign companies to invest in the country.
sentences.zh: 專家認為，穩定的稅收政策會鼓勵外國公司到國內投資。

words.note: 語塊：change tax policy（改變稅收政策）、new tax policy（新稅收政策）。tax policy 是政府的「稅務政策」；tax return 是「報稅單」；tax break 是「減稅優惠」。

sentences.en: Two large companies continue to dominate the market for home appliances in most Asian countries.
sentences.zh: 兩家大公司持續主導大多數亞洲國家的家電市場。

sentences.en: The startup hopes to dominate the industry within five years by offering cheaper and faster delivery.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司希望藉由更便宜、更快速的配送，在五年內稱霸產業。

sentences.en: The chairperson reminded everyone not to dominate the conversation so that all team members could share ideas.
sentences.zh: 主席提醒大家不要主導談話，讓所有組員都能分享想法。

sentences.en: Electric cars are expected to dominate the market for new vehicles in Europe by the year 2035.
sentences.zh: 電動車預計在 2035 年前主導歐洲的新車市場。

sentences.en: Discussions about the budget tend to dominate every board meeting at the end of the fiscal year.
sentences.zh: 在會計年度結束時，預算的討論往往主導每一場董事會。

words.note: 語塊：dominate the market（主導市場）、dominate the industry（稱霸產業）、dominate the conversation（主導談話）。dominate 是「佔據主導地位」；dominant 是形容詞「佔優勢的」。

sentences.en: The technology giant announced plans to acquire a small but successful software company based in Berlin.
sentences.zh: 那家科技巨頭宣布計畫收購一家總部在柏林的小型軟體公司。

sentences.en: Interns have the chance to acquire skills in marketing, accounting, and customer service during the summer.
sentences.zh: 實習生在夏天有機會學到行銷、會計和客服的技能。

sentences.en: Many young people take part-time jobs to acquire experience before they apply for full-time positions.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕人在申請全職工作前先做兼職，累積經驗。

sentences.en: The museum hopes to acquire several paintings by the famous artist with the help of private donors.
sentences.zh: 博物館希望在私人捐款者的幫助下，取得那位知名藝術家的幾幅畫作。

sentences.en: It took the company two years to acquire all of the land needed for the new shopping center.
sentences.zh: 公司花了兩年才取得興建新購物中心所需的全部土地。

words.note: 語塊：acquire a company（收購公司）、acquire skills（學到技能）、acquire experience（累積經驗）。acquire 比 get 正式；名詞 acquisition 是「收購」。require（需要）長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: Your coupon is invalid because it expired on the last day of September and cannot be used.
sentences.zh: 你的優惠券無效，因為它已經在九月最後一天過期了。

sentences.en: If you enter an invalid password three times, your account will be locked for thirty minutes.
sentences.zh: 如果你輸入無效密碼三次，你的帳號會被鎖住三十分鐘。

sentences.en: Passengers with an invalid ticket will be asked to purchase a new one before boarding the train.
sentences.zh: 持無效車票的乘客在上車前會被要求購買新票。

sentences.en: The contract will become invalid if either company fails to sign it before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 如果任何一方在月底前沒有簽約，合約就會失效。

sentences.en: The system displayed an error message saying that the credit card number was invalid and could not be processed.
sentences.zh: 系統顯示錯誤訊息，說信用卡號碼無效，無法處理。

words.note: 語塊：invalid ticket（無效的票）、invalid password（無效的密碼）、become invalid（失效）。invalid 是「無效的」（in-VAL-id）；唸成 IN-va-lid 時是名詞「病人、殘疾人」。valid 是「有效的」。

sentences.en: Please reply to this email as soon as possible so that we can confirm the number of guests.
sentences.zh: 請盡快回覆這封郵件，讓我們確認客人的人數。

sentences.en: If possible, we would like to schedule the meeting for Thursday morning instead of Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的話，我們想把會議排在週四早上而不是週五下午。

sentences.en: Employees are encouraged to take public transportation to work whenever possible to reduce air pollution in the city.
sentences.zh: 公司鼓勵員工只要有可能就搭大眾運輸上班，以減少污染。

sentences.en: The technician will try to repair the copier as soon as possible, but the parts may take a few days to arrive.
sentences.zh: 技師會盡快修好影印機，但零件可能要幾天才會到。

sentences.en: Our goal is to keep prices as low as possible without lowering the quality of our products.
sentences.zh: 我們的目標是在不降低產品品質的情況下，讓價格盡可能壓低。

words.note: 語塊：as soon as possible（盡快）、if possible（如果可以的話）、whenever possible（只要有可能）。possible 是「可能的」；probable（很可能的）可能性更高；feasible（可行的）偏「做得到」。

sentences.en: The television station will broadcast live the opening ceremony of the international film festival on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 電視台將現場直播國際影展的開幕典禮。

sentences.en: The radio program will broadcast an interview with the mayor about the new public transportation plan.
sentences.zh: 那個廣播節目將播出對市長談新大眾運輸計畫的訪問。

sentences.en: The company plans to broadcast its annual meeting online so that shareholders around the world can watch.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在網路上播出年度大會，讓全世界的股東都能收看。

sentences.en: The sports network has paid a large fee to broadcast nationwide every game of the championship series this year.
sentences.zh: 那家體育電視網付了一大筆費用，今年要全國播送冠軍系列賽的每一場比賽。

sentences.en: Local news stations broadcast weather warnings every hour while the typhoon was approaching the island.
sentences.zh: 颱風接近島嶼期間，地方新聞台每小時播出天氣警報。

words.note: 語塊：broadcast live（現場直播）、be broadcast on（在……播出）、broadcast nationwide（全國播送）。broadcast 過去式和過去分詞還是 broadcast；名詞也是 broadcast（節目、播送）。

sentences.en: The city council decided to go ahead with the construction of the new sports center despite some objections.
sentences.zh: 儘管有些反對，市議會還是決定進行新運動中心的興建。

sentences.en: If the weather is good on Saturday, we will go ahead with the company picnic at the lake as planned.
sentences.zh: 如果週六天氣好，我們會照計畫在湖邊辦公司野餐。

sentences.en: The director told the design team to go ahead and finish the new logo before the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 主任告訴設計團隊直接著手，在週末前完成新商標。

sentences.en: Once the budget is approved, the marketing department can go ahead with the advertising campaign.
sentences.zh: 預算一核准，行銷部就可以著手進行廣告活動。

sentences.en: The board of directors refused to go ahead with the merger after reviewing the financial reports.
sentences.zh: 看過財務報告後，董事會拒絕進行這次合併。

words.note: 語塊：go ahead with（著手進行）、give the go-ahead（批准）。go ahead with 是「照原計畫進行」；go on 是「繼續」。

sentences.en: The website removes any objectionable content that is posted in the comments section below each article.
sentences.zh: 網站會刪除每篇文章下方留言區張貼的任何令人反感的內容。

sentences.en: Several viewers complained about objectionable language in the television commercial that aired on Channel 5 last night.
sentences.zh: 好幾位觀眾抱怨昨晚播出的電視廣告裡有不雅的言語。

sentences.en: The magazine decided not to publish the photograph because many readers might find it objectionable.
sentences.zh: 雜誌決定不刊登那張照片，因為很多讀者可能會覺得反感。

sentences.en: Employees who use objectionable language with customers will receive a written warning from their manager.
sentences.zh: 對顧客使用不雅言語的員工會收到經理的書面警告。

sentences.en: Parents can use special settings to block objectionable content on the tablets that their children use.
sentences.zh: 家長可以用特殊設定，封鎖孩子使用的平板上令人反感的內容。

words.note: 語塊：objectionable content（令人反感的內容）、objectionable language（不雅的言語）。objectionable 是「令人反對、討厭的」；offensive 意思接近；objective（客觀的；目標）長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: The bright colors in the hotel lobby are suggestive of a tropical beach, which makes guests feel relaxed.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳明亮的顏色讓人聯想到熱帶海灘，讓客人覺得放鬆。
