sentences.en: Please wear clothing that is appropriate for a business meeting when you visit the client's office.
sentences.zh: 拜訪客戶辦公室時，請穿適合商務會議的服裝。

sentences.en: The manager will take appropriate action once she has reviewed all of the facts about the incident.
sentences.zh: 經理檢視完事件的所有事實後，會採取適當的行動。

sentences.en: This movie is not appropriate for young children because it contains some violent scenes and strong language.
sentences.zh: 這部電影不適合年幼的孩子，因為有一些暴力場面。

sentences.en: If appropriate, we will contact your previous employers to ask about your work experience and skills.
sentences.zh: 如果合適的話，我們會聯絡你以前的雇主，詢問你的工作經驗。

sentences.en: The training course is appropriate for both new employees and staff who want to review the basics.
sentences.zh: 這門訓練課程適合新員工，也適合想複習基礎的員工。

words.note: 語塊：appropriate for（適合……）、appropriate action（適當的行動）、if appropriate（如果合適的話）。appropriate 是「適當、合適」；proper 意思接近；當動詞（a-PRO-pri-ate）是「撥款；挪用」。

sentences.en: Please separate paper from plastic when you throw away your trash in the office kitchen.
sentences.zh: 在辦公室廚房丟垃圾時，請把紙和塑膠分開。

sentences.en: The trainer will separate the participants into small groups for the afternoon activity in the garden.
sentences.zh: 講師會把學員分成小組進行下午的活動。

sentences.en: It is important to separate personal expenses from business expenses when you prepare your tax return.
sentences.zh: 準備報稅時，把個人開支和營業開支分開很重要。

sentences.en: The factory uses machines to separate damaged products from good ones before they are packed.
sentences.zh: 工廠在包裝前用機器把損壞的產品和良品分開。

sentences.en: The hotel will separate the large conference hall into three smaller rooms for the workshops.
sentences.zh: 飯店會把大型會議廳分成三個小房間舉辦工作坊。

words.note: 語塊：separate A from B（把 A 和 B 分開）、separate into（分成）。separate 當動詞是「分開」，當形容詞是「分開的」；注意拼法是 sep-a-rate，不是 seperate。

sentences.en: Please rinse out the bottles and cans before you put them in the recycling bin.
sentences.zh: 把瓶子和罐子丟進回收桶之前，請先沖洗乾淨。

sentences.en: Employees are asked to rinse out their coffee cups and place them in the dishwasher after use.
sentences.zh: 員工被要求使用後把咖啡杯沖乾淨，放進洗碗機。

sentences.en: If the paint gets in your eyes, rinse out with water immediately and contact a doctor.
sentences.zh: 如果油漆跑進眼睛，請立刻用水沖洗並聯絡醫生。

sentences.en: Before returning the rental equipment, please rinse out the containers so that no food remains inside.
sentences.zh: 歸還租借設備之前，請把容器沖洗乾淨，裡面不要留有食物。

sentences.en: The instructions say to rinse out the coffee machine with clean water once a week to keep it working well.
sentences.zh: 說明書說每週要用清水沖洗咖啡機一次，讓它保持良好運作。

words.note: 語塊：rinse out the container（把容器沖乾淨）、rinse out with water（用水沖洗）。rinse out 是「用清水沖洗（裡面）」；wash 是一般「清洗」；rinse 通常是洗完之後「沖掉」。

sentences.en: Some cleaning products contain harmful chemicals, so please wear gloves and a mask when you use them.
sentences.zh: 有些清潔用品含有有害化學物質，所以使用時請戴手套。

sentences.en: Spending too many hours in front of a screen can be harmful to your eyes and your sleep.
sentences.zh: 花太多時間盯著螢幕可能對你的眼睛和睡眠有害。

sentences.en: The study examined the harmful effects of air pollution on children who live near busy roads.
sentences.zh: 那項研究探討空氣污染對住在交通繁忙道路旁兒童的有害影響。

sentences.en: The factory stopped using paints that contained harmful chemicals after several workers complained of headaches.
sentences.zh: 工人抱怨頭痛後，工廠停止使用含有有害化學物質的油漆。

sentences.en: Experts warn that plastic waste in the ocean is harmful to fish, birds, and other wildlife.
sentences.zh: 專家警告，海洋中的塑膠垃圾對魚類、鳥類和其他野生動物有害。

words.note: 語塊：harmful to（對……有害）、harmful chemicals（有害化學物質）、harmful effects（有害影響）。harmful 是「有害的」；harmless 是「無害的」；harm 是名詞或動詞「傷害」。

sentences.en: The festival was organized in cooperation with local businesses and the city's tourism office this year.
sentences.zh: 這個慶典是和當地商家及市政府觀光處合作舉辦的。

sentences.en: Thank you for your cooperation while we repair the elevators in the building this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末我們維修大樓電梯期間，謝謝你的配合。

sentences.en: Close cooperation between the design and sales teams helped us launch the product ahead of schedule.
sentences.zh: 設計和業務團隊的密切合作，幫助我們提前推出了產品。

sentences.en: The research was carried out in cooperation with three large universities in Europe and Asia.
sentences.zh: 這項研究是和歐洲及亞洲的三所大學合作進行的。

sentences.en: We appreciate your cooperation in keeping the office clean and quiet during regular working hours.
sentences.zh: 感謝你在上班時間配合保持辦公室整潔安靜。

words.note: 語塊：in cooperation with（與……合作）、thank you for your cooperation（謝謝配合）、close cooperation（密切合作）。cooperation 是名詞；cooperate 是動詞；corporation（公司）長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: The marketing team needs to come up with an idea for the new advertising campaign by Friday.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊需要在週五前想出新廣告活動的點子。

sentences.en: Engineers are working hard to come up with a solution to the problem with the factory's cooling system.
sentences.zh: 工程師正在努力想出解決工廠冷卻系統問題的辦法。

sentences.en: The committee will come up with a plan to reduce traffic in the city center during the festival.
sentences.zh: 委員會會擬出一個在慶典期間減少市中心交通的計畫。

sentences.en: Employees who come up with an idea that saves the company money will receive a special bonus.
sentences.zh: 想出能為公司省錢點子的員工會獲得一筆特別獎金。

sentences.en: It took the designers several weeks to come up with a solution that satisfied both the client and the budget.
sentences.zh: 設計師花了好幾週才想出一個讓客戶和預算都滿意的解決辦法。

words.note: 語塊：come up with an idea（想出點子）、come up with a solution（想出解決辦法）、come up with a plan（擬出計畫）。come up with 是「想出（點子、辦法）」；think of 意思接近。

sentences.en: Ms. Chung was chosen to lead a team of engineers that will design the company's new electric car.
sentences.zh: 鍾小姐被選為帶領一個工程師團隊，設計公司的新電動車。

sentences.en: Poor communication between departments can lead to mistakes, long delays, and many unhappy customers in the end.
sentences.zh: 部門之間溝通不良可能導致錯誤、延誤和不滿意的顧客。

sentences.en: Our company hopes to lead the way in developing environmentally friendly packaging for food products.
sentences.zh: 我們公司希望在開發食品環保包裝方面帶頭。

sentences.en: The new training program is expected to lead to higher sales and better customer service in all stores.
sentences.zh: 新的訓練計畫預計會讓所有門市的業績提高、客服更好。

sentences.en: Mr. Owens will lead the workshop on time management for new managers next Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: Owens 先生下週四下午會帶領新任經理的時間管理工作坊。

words.note: 語塊：lead a team（帶領團隊）、lead to（導致）、lead the way（帶頭）。lead to 是「導致某結果」；過去式是 led；lead 當名詞（唸 led）是「鉛」。

sentences.en: The bank's founder is well known for his philanthropic work, especially his support for public libraries.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行的創辦人以慈善工作聞名，尤其是對公立圖書館的支持。

sentences.en: The company donates five percent of its profits to a philanthropic organization that helps children in need.
sentences.zh: 公司把百分之五的利潤捐給一個幫助弱勢兒童的慈善組織。

sentences.en: Ms. Ford spends most of her free time on philanthropic work, raising money for hospitals and schools.
sentences.zh: Ford 小姐把大部分空閒時間花在慈善工作上，為醫院和學校募款。

sentences.en: The philanthropic organization provided funding to build a new community center in the small town.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善組織提供經費，在那個小鎮蓋了一座新的社區中心。

sentences.en: Many large corporations have philanthropic programs that encourage employees to volunteer in their local communities on weekends.
sentences.zh: 很多大企業都有慈善計畫，鼓勵員工在社區當志工。

words.note: 語塊：philanthropic organization（慈善組織）、philanthropic work（慈善工作）。philanthropic 比 charitable 正式；philanthropy 是「慈善事業」；philanthropist 是「慈善家」。

sentences.en: Only the finance director can authorize payment for expenses that are higher than five thousand dollars.
sentences.zh: 只有財務總監可以批准超過五千美元的支出。

sentences.en: The manager will authorize staff to work from home on days when the weather is very bad.
sentences.zh: 天氣很差的日子，經理會授權員工在家工作。

sentences.en: Please do not authorize any changes to the contract until the legal department has reviewed them.
sentences.zh: 在法務部審閱之前，請不要批准任何合約的修改。

sentences.en: The client must authorize the payment online before we can begin working on the project.
sentences.zh: 客戶必須先在線上批准付款，我們才能開始進行專案。

sentences.en: The director agreed to authorize a small increase in the budget for the company's holiday party.
sentences.zh: 總監同意批准公司節慶派對的預算小幅增加。

words.note: 語塊：authorize payment（批准付款）、authorize sb to do（授權某人做）、be authorized to（被授權……）。authorize 是「正式批准、授權」；authority 是名詞「權力；當局」；author 是「作者」。

sentences.en: The region was once a center for heavy industry such as steel production and shipbuilding.
sentences.zh: 那個地區曾經是鋼鐵生產和造船等重工業的中心。

sentences.en: The decline of heavy industry in the city led many workers to look for jobs in services and tourism.
sentences.zh: 城市重工業的衰退讓許多工人轉往服務業和觀光業找工作。

sentences.en: Heavy industry uses a large amount of energy, so the government is encouraging factories to use cleaner fuels.
sentences.zh: 重工業使用大量能源，所以政府鼓勵工廠使用比較乾淨的燃料。

sentences.en: The museum tells the story of heavy industry in the region and how it changed the lives of local families.
sentences.zh: 博物館講述了這個地區重工業的故事，以及它如何改變當地家庭的生活。

sentences.en: After the decline of heavy industry, the old factories were turned into apartments, offices, and art galleries.
sentences.zh: 重工業衰退後，舊工廠被改建成公寓、辦公室和藝廊。

words.note: 語塊：heavy industry such as（例如……的重工業）、decline of heavy industry（重工業衰退）。heavy industry 指鋼鐵、造船等大型工業；light industry 是「輕工業」（例如紡織）。

sentences.en: The new hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment for diagnosing and treating heart disease in patients of all ages.
sentences.zh: 新醫院配備最先進的心臟病診斷和治療設備。

sentences.en: Our factory uses state-of-the-art technology to produce high-quality parts quickly and at a low cost.
sentences.zh: 我們工廠用最新科技快速又低成本地生產高品質零件。

sentences.en: The university opened a state-of-the-art facility for research in clean energy, batteries, and electric vehicles.
sentences.zh: 那所大學啟用了一座最先進的潔淨能源和電動車研究設施。

sentences.en: Every room in the conference center has state-of-the-art equipment for video calls, online meetings, and presentations.
sentences.zh: 會議中心的每個房間都有最先進的視訊通話和簡報設備。

sentences.en: The gym installed state-of-the-art machines that track each member's progress through a free mobile app.
sentences.zh: 健身房裝了最先進的機器，透過 App 追蹤每位會員的進度。

words.note: 語塊：state-of-the-art equipment（最先進的設備）、state-of-the-art technology（最新科技）、state-of-the-art facility（最先進的設施）。state-of-the-art 放在名詞前要加連字號，意思是「目前最先進的」；cutting-edge 意思接近。

sentences.en: Mr. Hall decided to resign from his position at the bank in order to start his own business.
sentences.zh: Hall 先生決定辭去銀行的職位，自己創業。

sentences.en: The CEO announced that she will resign as head of the company at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 執行長宣布她會在年底辭去公司負責人的職位。

sentences.en: Employees who plan to resign must give their manager at least one month's notice in writing.
sentences.zh: 打算辭職的員工必須至少提前一個月以書面通知經理。

sentences.en: Several board members threatened to resign from the committee if the proposal was not changed.
sentences.zh: 幾位董事威脅說，如果提案不修改，他們就要退出委員會。

sentences.en: After working at the restaurant for ten years, the head chef chose to resign and open his own café.
sentences.zh: 在那家餐廳工作十年後，主廚選擇辭職，開了自己的咖啡館。

words.note: 語塊：resign from（從……辭職）、resign as（辭去……職位）。resign 是「主動辭職」；retire 是「退休」；名詞是 resignation（辭職；辭呈）。

sentences.en: The company plans to export its organic tea to Europe and North America starting next spring.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫從明年春天開始把有機茶出口到歐洲和北美。

sentences.en: Many farmers in the region export goods such as fruit and coffee to countries in Asia.
sentences.zh: 那個地區很多農民把水果和咖啡等商品出口到亞洲國家。

sentences.en: To export goods to other countries, businesses must fill out several customs documents and pay certain fees.
sentences.zh: 要把商品出口到其他國家，企業必須填寫好幾份海關文件。

sentences.en: The factory will export more than half of the cars it produces to markets in South America.
sentences.zh: 那座工廠會把生產的一半以上汽車出口到南美市場。

sentences.en: The government offers tax benefits to small businesses that export to new markets overseas for the first time.
sentences.zh: 政府為出口到海外新市場的小企業提供稅務優惠。

words.note: 語塊：export to（出口到）、export goods（出口商品）。export 是「出口」；import 是「進口」。當名詞時重音在前（EX-port）。

sentences.en: The city plans to reduce fossil fuel use by encouraging people to drive electric cars and ride bicycles.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫鼓勵民眾開電動車和騎腳踏車，減少化石燃料的使用。

sentences.en: Power plants that burn fossil fuel release large amounts of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 燃燒化石燃料的發電廠會把大量二氧化碳排放到大氣中。

sentences.en: The company aims to stop using fossil fuel energy at all of its factories within the next ten years.
sentences.zh: 公司的目標是在未來十年內讓所有工廠停止使用化石燃料能源。

sentences.en: Solar and wind power are becoming cheaper than fossil fuel energy in many parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 在世界很多地方，太陽能和風力發電正變得比化石燃料能源便宜。

sentences.en: Scientists say that we must reduce fossil fuel use quickly in order to slow down climate change.
sentences.zh: 科學家說我們必須快速減少化石燃料的使用，才能減緩氣候變遷。

words.note: 語塊：reduce fossil fuel use（減少化石燃料使用）、burn fossil fuel（燃燒化石燃料）、fossil fuel energy（化石燃料能源）。fossil fuel 指煤、石油、天然氣；常用複數 fossil fuels；renewable energy 是「再生能源」。

sentences.en: The television station hopes that the new comedy show will increase viewership among young adults.
sentences.zh: 電視台希望新的喜劇節目能增加年輕成人的收視人數。

sentences.en: Viewership numbers for the evening news have dropped as more people get their news from the internet.
sentences.zh: 隨著越來越多人從網路看新聞，晚間新聞的收視數字下滑了。

sentences.en: The championship game attracted the largest viewership in the fifty-year history of the sports network.
sentences.zh: 冠軍賽吸引了那家體育電視網史上最多的收視人數。

sentences.en: Advertisers pay more for commercials during programs with high viewership, such as major sports events.
sentences.zh: 在大型體育賽事等高收視節目期間，廣告商要為廣告付更多錢。

sentences.en: The streaming service released its viewership numbers, showing that its new drama was watched by millions.
sentences.zh: 那家串流平台公布收視數字，顯示新影集有數百萬人收看。

words.note: 語塊：increase viewership（增加收視率）、viewership numbers（收視數字）。viewership 是電視或網路節目的「觀眾數」；readership 是「讀者群」；audience 是一般的「觀眾」。

sentences.en: Prices at the new restaurant are slightly higher than at the café, but the portions are much larger.
sentences.zh: 新餐廳的價格比咖啡廳稍微高一點，但份量大很多。

sentences.en: The design of the new model is slightly different from the old one, with a larger screen and thinner body.
sentences.zh: 新機型的設計和舊款有點不同，螢幕比較大、機身比較薄。

sentences.en: Several boxes were slightly damaged during shipping, but fortunately the products inside were not affected.
sentences.zh: 好幾個箱子在運送過程中輕微損壞，但裡面的產品沒有受到影響。

sentences.en: Sales increased slightly in the second quarter after the company lowered the prices of its laptops.
sentences.zh: 公司調降筆電價格後，第二季的銷售稍微增加。

sentences.en: The meeting will start slightly later than planned because the director's flight was delayed this morning.
sentences.zh: 因為總監今天早上的班機延誤，會議會比原定時間稍微晚一點開始。

words.note: 語塊：slightly higher（稍微高一點）、slightly different（有點不同）、slightly damaged（輕微損壞）。slightly 和 somewhat、a little 意思接近；slight 是形容詞「輕微的」。

sentences.en: With the advent of online shopping, many traditional stores have had to change the way they do business.
sentences.zh: 隨著網路購物的出現，很多傳統商店不得不改變做生意的方式。

sentences.en: The advent of smartphones has completely changed how people read the news and communicate with friends.
sentences.zh: 智慧型手機的出現完全改變了人們看新聞和跟朋友溝通的方式。

sentences.en: Before the advent of email, most business letters were sent by mail or by fax machine.
sentences.zh: 在電子郵件出現之前，大部分商業信件都是用郵寄或傳真寄送的。

sentences.en: With the advent of electric cars, gas stations are starting to install charging stations for their customers.
sentences.zh: 隨著電動車的出現，加油站開始為顧客設置充電站。

sentences.en: The advent of video calls has allowed many companies to reduce the number of business trips they take.
sentences.zh: 視訊通話的出現讓很多公司得以減少出差的次數。

words.note: 語塊：the advent of（……的出現）、with the advent of（隨著……的出現）。advent 是「重要事物的到來或出現」，常用 the advent of；adventure 是「冒險」。

sentences.en: Opening the emergency exit door during the day will trigger an alarm in the security office downstairs.
sentences.zh: 白天打開緊急出口門會觸發樓下保全室的警報。

sentences.en: The sudden increase in prices could trigger a reaction from customers who may decide to shop elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 價格突然上漲可能會引起顧客的反應，他們可能會決定去別的地方購物。

sentences.en: The new law is expected to trigger a change in the way companies collect and store customer data.
sentences.zh: 新法律預計會引發企業收集和儲存顧客資料方式的改變。

sentences.en: Smoke from cooking in the break room can trigger an alarm, so please use the fan when you heat food.
sentences.zh: 在茶水間煮東西的煙可能會觸發警報，所以加熱食物時請開抽風扇。

sentences.en: Experts warn that a small problem at one factory could trigger a reaction that affects the entire supply chain.
sentences.zh: 專家警告，一間工廠的小問題可能會引發影響整個供應鏈的連鎖反應。

words.note: 語塊：trigger an alarm（觸發警報）、trigger a reaction（引起反應）、trigger a change（引發改變）。trigger 是「引發、觸發」；當名詞是槍的「扳機」或「誘因」。

sentences.en: The company will conduct an investigation to find out how the confidential documents were leaked.
sentences.zh: 公司會進行調查，找出機密文件是怎麼外洩的。

sentences.en: The cause of the fire at the warehouse is still under investigation by the local fire department.
sentences.zh: 倉庫火災的原因仍在當地消防局的調查中。

sentences.en: The government decided to launch an investigation after several customers complained about the bank's fees.
sentences.zh: 好幾位顧客抱怨那家銀行的手續費後，政府決定展開調查。

sentences.en: During the investigation, employees were asked not to discuss the matter with anyone outside the company.
sentences.zh: 調查期間，員工被要求不要和公司以外的任何人討論這件事。

sentences.en: The results of the investigation will be shared with all staff once the report has been completed.
sentences.zh: 報告完成後，調查結果會分享給所有員工。

words.note: 語塊：conduct an investigation（進行調查）、under investigation（調查中）、launch an investigation（展開調查）。investigation 是名詞；investigate 是動詞；investment（投資）長得像，意思不同。

words.meaning: 做法；慣例；練習；（醫師、律師）事務所

sentences.en: It is common practice for companies in this industry to give employees a bonus at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 這個產業的公司在年底給員工獎金是常見的做法。

sentences.en: It is standard practice to check every product twice before it leaves the factory and is shipped.
sentences.zh: 每項產品離開工廠前都檢查兩次是標準做法。

sentences.en: The managers hope to put into practice the ideas that they learned at the leadership workshop.
sentences.zh: 經理們希望把在領導力工作坊學到的想法付諸實行。

sentences.en: Dr. Lee opened her own dental practice in the city center after working at a large hospital for ten years.
sentences.zh: 李醫師在大醫院工作十年後，在市中心開了自己的牙醫診所。

sentences.en: Recycling all office paper has become standard practice at most companies in the business district.
sentences.zh: 回收所有辦公用紙已經成為商業區大部分公司的標準做法。

words.note: 語塊：common practice（常見做法）、standard practice（標準做法）、put into practice（付諸實行）。practice 可以是「做法、慣例」，也可以指醫生或律師的「診所、事務所」（a dental practice）。

sentences.en: The government will take measures to protect small businesses from the effects of rising energy prices.
sentences.zh: 政府將採取措施保護小企業免受能源價格上漲的影響。

sentences.en: The airport decided to take measures to reduce the long waiting times at its busy security checkpoints.
sentences.zh: 機場決定採取措施，減少繁忙安檢處的漫長等候時間。

sentences.en: Managers must take measures to make sure that all employees follow the new safety rules in the factory.
sentences.zh: 經理必須採取措施，確保所有員工遵守工廠的新安全規定。

sentences.en: The city plans to take measures to reduce air pollution, such as limiting the number of cars downtown.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫採取措施減少空氣污染，例如限制市中心的車輛數量。

sentences.en: Banks have started to take measures against criminals who try to steal personal information from customers online.
sentences.zh: 銀行已經開始採取措施，防範試圖在網路上竊取顧客個人資料的罪犯。

words.note: 語塊：take measures to（採取措施去……）、take measures against（採取措施防範……）。take measures 和 take steps、take action 意思接近；measure 單數是「測量；措施」。

sentences.en: The company had to curtail spending on travel and entertainment after its profits fell last year.
sentences.zh: 去年獲利下滑後，公司只好削減差旅和交際費的開支。

sentences.en: The factory will curtail production for two weeks because of a shortage of important parts.
sentences.zh: 因為重要零件短缺，工廠將縮減產量兩週。

sentences.en: The government plans to curtail spending on new roads in order to invest more money in public transportation.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫削減新道路的支出，把更多錢投資在大眾運輸上。

sentences.en: The storm forced several airlines to curtail their flights to the island for the entire weekend.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨迫使好幾家航空公司在整個週末縮減飛往那座島的航班。

sentences.en: To curtail spending, the office will now print documents only when it is absolutely necessary.
sentences.zh: 為了削減開支，辦公室現在只有在絕對必要時才列印文件。

words.note: 語塊：curtail spending（削減開支）、curtail production（縮減產量）。curtail 比 reduce、cut 正式；curtain（窗簾）長得像。

sentences.en: Please do not assume that the meeting has been canceled unless you receive an email from the manager.
sentences.zh: 除非收到經理的郵件，否則請不要以為會議已經取消了。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant will assume responsibility for the marketing department when the current director retires in May.
sentences.zh: 五月現任總監退休後，Grant 小姐將負責行銷部。

sentences.en: Mr. Patel will assume the role of project manager for the construction of the new office building.
sentences.zh: Patel 先生將擔任新辦公大樓工程的專案經理。

sentences.en: Many customers assume that organic products are always healthier, but that is not always true.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客認為有機產品一定比較健康，但並不總是如此。

sentences.en: The new owner of the hotel will assume responsibility for all of the debts of the previous company.
sentences.zh: 飯店的新主人將承擔前一家公司所有的債務。

words.note: 語塊：assume that（假設……）、assume responsibility for（承擔……責任）、assume the role of（擔任……角色）。assume 有「假設」和「承擔（職務）」兩個意思；resume 是「恢復；履歷」。

sentences.en: The warehouse hired extra workers to fulfill every order placed online during the holiday sale.
sentences.zh: 倉庫增聘工人，以完成節慶特賣期間的每一筆訂單。

sentences.en: The company was unable to fulfill its promise to deliver the furniture before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 公司無法履行在月底前交付家具的承諾。

sentences.en: Applicants must fulfill all of the requirements listed in the advertisement before they can be considered.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須符合廣告中列出的所有要求才會被考慮。

sentences.en: We always try to fulfill a promise that we make to our customers, even if it costs us extra money.
sentences.zh: 我們總是努力履行對顧客的承諾，即使要多花錢。

sentences.en: To fulfill the requirements for graduation, students must complete an internship of at least three months.
sentences.zh: 為了符合畢業要求，學生必須完成至少三個月的實習。

words.note: 語塊：fulfill an order（完成訂單）、fulfill a promise（履行承諾）、fulfill requirements（符合要求）。fulfill 是「完成承諾、責任或需求」；美式拼法 fulfill，英式拼法 fulfil。

sentences.en: The company continues to deny that it has any plans to close its factory in the northern region.
sentences.zh: 公司持續否認有任何關閉北部工廠的計畫。

sentences.en: The bank may deny a request for a loan if the applicant does not have a stable income.
sentences.zh: 如果申請人沒有穩定收入，銀行可能會拒絕貸款申請。

sentences.en: The security system will deny access to anyone who does not have a valid employee badge.
sentences.zh: 保全系統會拒絕任何沒有有效員工識別證的人進入。

sentences.en: The spokesperson refused to deny the reports that the two companies are discussing a possible merger.
sentences.zh: 發言人拒絕否認兩家公司正在討論合併的報導。

sentences.en: The landlord decided to deny the tenant's request to keep a large dog in the small apartment.
sentences.zh: 房東決定拒絕房客在小公寓裡養大型犬的要求。

words.note: 語塊：deny that（否認……）、deny a request（拒絕請求）、deny access（拒絕進入）。deny 是「否認」或「拒絕給予」；refuse 是「拒絕做」。名詞是 denial。

sentences.en: Mr. Brown recommended a former co-worker for the position because she has excellent design skills.
sentences.zh: Brown 先生推薦一位前同事擔任這個職位，因為她的設計能力非常好。

sentences.en: It is important to get along with a co-worker who sits next to you, especially in a small office.
sentences.zh: 和坐在你旁邊的同事相處融洽很重要，尤其是在小辦公室裡。

sentences.en: If you will be absent, please ask a co-worker to answer your phone and check your email while you are away.
sentences.zh: 如果你會缺席，請請一位同事在你不在時接電話和看信。

sentences.en: Ms. Ito learned how to use the new software from a co-worker who had attended the training session.
sentences.zh: 伊藤小姐從一位參加過訓練課程的同事那裡學會了使用新軟體。

sentences.en: A friendly co-worker showed the new employee around the office and introduced her to the team.
sentences.zh: 一位友善的同事帶新員工參觀辦公室，並把她介紹給團隊。

words.note: 語塊：a former co-worker（前同事）、get along with a co-worker（和同事相處融洽）、ask a co-worker（請同事幫忙）、from a co-worker（從同事那裡）。co-worker 和 colleague 都是「同事」；colleague 比較正式。也可以寫成 coworker。

sentences.en: Employees are encouraged to use public transportation to get to work in order to reduce traffic downtown.
sentences.zh: 公司鼓勵員工搭大眾運輸上班，以減少市中心的交通量。

sentences.en: Rising fuel prices have increased transportation costs for companies that ship products across the country.
sentences.zh: 油價上漲增加了在全國運送產品的公司的運輸成本。

sentences.en: Bicycles have become a popular means of transportation in the city since the new bike lanes were built.
sentences.zh: 自從新的自行車道建好後，腳踏車已經成為城裡受歡迎的交通工具。

sentences.en: The conference fee includes hotel rooms, meals, and transportation between the airport and the venue.
sentences.zh: 研討會費用包含飯店住宿、餐點，以及機場和會場之間的交通。

sentences.en: The government will spend more money on public transportation, including new subway lines and electric buses.
sentences.zh: 政府將在大眾運輸上投入更多資金，包括新捷運線和電動公車。

words.note: 語塊：public transportation（大眾運輸）、means of transportation（交通工具）、transportation costs（運輸成本）。transportation 是美式說法，英式多用 transport；commute 是「通勤」。

words.meaning: 專案小組；特別工作小組

sentences.en: The company decided to form a task force to find ways to reduce energy use in all of its buildings.
sentences.zh: 公司決定成立專案小組，找出降低所有建築物用電的方法。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim was invited to join a task force that will plan the opening of our first store in Europe.
sentences.zh: 金小姐受邀加入一個專案小組，規劃我們在歐洲第一家店的開幕。

sentences.en: The task force will present its recommendations to the board of directors at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 專案小組會在月底向董事會提出建議。

sentences.en: The city formed a task force of police officers and social workers to deal with problems in the downtown area.
sentences.zh: 市政府成立了一個由警察和社工組成的專案小組，處理市中心的問題。

sentences.en: Members of the task force meet every Monday morning to share their progress and discuss the next steps.
sentences.zh: 專案小組成員每週一早上開會，分享進度並討論下一步。

words.note: 語塊：form a task force（成立專案小組）、join a task force（加入專案小組）。task force 是「為了特定任務臨時組成的小組」；committee 是「委員會」，通常比較長期。

sentences.en: The architecture firm hired a talented designer who has won several international awards for her work.
sentences.zh: 那家建築事務所聘請了一位作品得過好幾個國際獎項的有才華設計師。

sentences.en: The music school offers scholarships to highly talented students who cannot afford to pay the full tuition.
sentences.zh: 那所音樂學校提供獎學金給付不起全額學費、非常有天分的學生。

sentences.en: The gallery is showing the paintings of several talented young artists from across the country this month.
sentences.zh: 藝廊這個月展出全國各地好幾位有才華的年輕藝術家的畫作。

sentences.en: Our company is looking for talented engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems and working in teams.
sentences.zh: 我們公司在找喜歡解決難題、喜歡團隊合作的有才華工程師。

sentences.en: The restaurant's success is largely due to its talented chef, who creates a new menu every season.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的成功主要歸功於它有才華的主廚，他每季都設計新菜單。

words.note: 語塊：talented designer（有才華的設計師）、highly talented（非常有天分的）、talented young（有才華的年輕……）。talented 是「有天分、有才能的」；gifted 意思接近；skilled 偏「技術熟練的」。

sentences.en: Our company is dedicated to providing high-quality products at prices that most families can afford.
sentences.zh: 我們公司致力於以大多數家庭負擔得起的價格提供高品質產品。

sentences.en: The hotel's success depends on its dedicated staff, who work hard to make every guest feel welcome.
sentences.zh: 飯店的成功靠的是敬業的員工，他們努力讓每位客人都覺得賓至如歸。

sentences.en: Customers with questions about their accounts can call our dedicated line, which is open twenty-four hours a day.
sentences.zh: 對帳戶有疑問的顧客可以撥打我們的專線，二十四小時都有人接聽。

sentences.en: The museum is dedicated to the history of the city's fishing industry and the families who worked in it.
sentences.zh: 那座博物館專門介紹城市漁業的歷史和從事漁業的家庭。

sentences.en: Ms. Lopez received an award for being one of the most dedicated employees in the company this year.
sentences.zh: Lopez 小姐因為是公司今年最敬業的員工之一而獲獎。

words.note: 語塊：dedicated to（致力於……）、dedicated staff（敬業的員工）、dedicated line（專線）。dedicated 是「投入、敬業的」，也可以表示「專門用途的」；devoted 意思接近。

sentences.en: The two airlines plan to announce a merger next week that will create the largest airline in the region.
sentences.zh: 兩家航空公司計畫下週宣布合併，將成為該地區最大的航空公司。

sentences.en: The merger with our main competitor will allow us to offer more products to customers around the world.
sentences.zh: 和我們主要競爭對手的合併，會讓我們能為世界各地的顧客提供更多產品。

sentences.en: Ms. Ward is a lawyer who specializes in merger and acquisition deals for technology companies.
sentences.zh: Ward 小姐是專門處理科技公司併購案的律師。

sentences.en: Many employees are worried that the merger will result in job losses at the company's headquarters.
sentences.zh: 很多員工擔心合併會導致公司總部有人失業。

sentences.en: After the merger, the new company will keep the name of the larger bank but move its offices downtown.
sentences.zh: 合併之後，新公司會保留較大那家銀行的名字，但把辦公室搬到市中心。

words.note: 語塊：announce a merger（宣布合併）、merger with（與……合併）、merger and acquisition（併購）。merger 是兩家公司「合併」；acquisition 是「收購」（大公司買下小公司）。

sentences.en: The company lowered its prices in order to increase market share in the competitive smartphone industry.
sentences.zh: 公司降價，以提高在競爭激烈的手機產業中的市佔率。

sentences.en: Our new line of electric bicycles has helped us gain market share in Europe over the past two years.
sentences.zh: 我們新系列的電動自行車在過去兩年幫助我們擴大了在歐洲的市佔率。

sentences.en: The old brand began to lose market share when younger customers started buying products online.
sentences.zh: 年輕顧客開始在網路上購物後，那個老品牌開始失去市佔率。

sentences.en: According to the report, the top three companies control about seventy percent of the market share.
sentences.zh: 根據報告，前三大公司掌握了大約百分之七十的市場佔有率。

sentences.en: The marketing director believes that the new advertising campaign will help us gain market share quickly.
sentences.zh: 行銷總監認為新的廣告活動能幫助我們快速擴大市佔率。

words.note: 語塊：increase market share（提高市佔率）、gain market share（擴大市佔率）、lose market share（失去市佔率）。market share 是「公司在市場上的銷售佔比」；market value 是「市值」。

sentences.en: Please read the user manual carefully before you use the new coffee machine for the first time.
sentences.zh: 第一次使用新咖啡機之前，請仔細閱讀使用手冊。

sentences.en: The instruction manual explains how to clean the filter and replace the batteries in the remote control.
sentences.zh: 說明書說明如何清潔濾網和更換遙控器的電池。

sentences.en: Every new employee receives a training manual that describes the company's rules, benefits, and procedures.
sentences.zh: 每位新員工都會拿到一本說明公司規定和流程的訓練手冊。

sentences.en: If you have lost the user manual, you can download a copy from the support page of our website.
sentences.zh: 如果你弄丟了使用手冊，可以從我們網站的支援頁面下載一份。

sentences.en: The technician followed the instructions in the manual to repair the machine without any help.
sentences.zh: 技師依照手冊上的說明，在沒有任何幫助的情況下修好了機器。

words.note: 語塊：user manual（使用手冊）、instruction manual（說明書）、training manual（訓練手冊）。manual 當名詞是「手冊」；當形容詞是「手動的」（manual labor 體力勞動）。

sentences.en: The chief editor of the magazine will decide which articles are included in the next issue.
sentences.zh: 雜誌的總編輯會決定下一期要收錄哪些文章。

sentences.en: Ms. Hart worked as a news editor at a national newspaper for fifteen years before becoming a professor.
sentences.zh: Hart 小姐在全國性報紙擔任新聞編輯十五年後才當上教授。

sentences.en: Please send your article to the editor by Friday so that there is enough time to check it before printing.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前把你的文章寄給編輯，讓印刷前有足夠的時間檢查。

sentences.en: The editor of the cookbook tested every recipe in her own kitchen before the book was published.
sentences.zh: 那本食譜的編輯在書出版前，在自己家廚房試做了每一道食譜。

sentences.en: The publishing company is hiring an experienced editor to work on its series of children's books.
sentences.zh: 那家出版社正在招聘一位有經驗的編輯，負責它的兒童書系列。

words.note: 語塊：chief editor（總編輯）、news editor（新聞編輯）、editor of（……的編輯）。editor 是「編輯（人）」；edition 是「版本；（刊物的）一期」；edit 是動詞「編輯」。

sentences.en: Let's go over the details of the contract one more time before we send it to the client.
sentences.zh: 把合約寄給客戶之前，我們再檢查一次細節吧。

sentences.en: The manager asked me to go over the report and correct any mistakes before the meeting tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 經理要我在明天開會前看過報告，把錯誤都改掉。

sentences.en: The team will meet on Monday to go over the plan for the product launch and assign tasks.
sentences.zh: 團隊週一會開會討論產品上市的計畫並分配工作。

sentences.en: Please go over the safety instructions with all new workers before they begin using the machines.
sentences.zh: 在新工人開始使用機器之前，請和他們一起看過安全說明。

sentences.en: Before signing the lease, it is a good idea to go over the details with a lawyer or a real estate agent.
sentences.zh: 簽租約之前，最好和律師或房仲一起檢查細節。

words.note: 語塊：go over the details（檢查細節）、go over the report（看過報告）、go over the plan（討論計畫）。go over 是「仔細看過、檢查」；review 意思接近；go through 也可以表示「仔細查看」。

sentences.en: All passengers must fill out a customs declaration form before they arrive at the international airport.
sentences.zh: 所有乘客都必須在抵達國際機場前填寫海關申報單。

sentences.en: Please list every item in your package on the customs declaration form, including its value.
sentences.zh: 請在海關申報單上列出包裹裡的每樣物品，包括價值。

sentences.en: The flight attendants will hand out the customs declaration form about one hour before landing.
sentences.zh: 空服員會在降落前大約一小時發海關申報單。

sentences.en: If you fill out a customs declaration form incorrectly, your package may be delayed or returned.
sentences.zh: 如果你海關申報單填錯，包裹可能會被延誤或退回。

sentences.en: Travelers who are carrying more than ten thousand dollars in cash must report it on the customs declaration form.
sentences.zh: 攜帶超過一萬美元現金的旅客必須在海關申報單上申報。

words.note: 語塊：fill out a customs declaration form（填寫海關申報單）、on the customs declaration form（在海關申報單上）。customs 是「海關」（要加 s）；custom（沒有 s）是「習俗」。declaration 是「申報；宣言」。

sentences.en: Applicants for the job must have at least three years of supervisory experience in a retail store.
sentences.zh: 應徵這份工作的人必須至少有三年零售店的管理經驗。

sentences.en: After five years at the factory, Mr. Ito was promoted to a supervisory position on the night shift.
sentences.zh: 在工廠工作五年後，伊藤先生被升到夜班的管理職。

sentences.en: In her supervisory role, Ms. Diaz is responsible for training new staff and checking the quality of their work.
sentences.zh: Diaz 小姐擔任監督角色，負責訓練新員工並檢查他們的工作品質。

sentences.en: Employees in a supervisory position must attend a leadership course during their first year in the role.
sentences.zh: 擔任管理職的員工必須在第一年參加一門領導力課程。

sentences.en: The company offers a workshop for staff who are interested in moving into a supervisory role in the future.
sentences.zh: 公司為未來有興趣轉任監督角色的員工開設工作坊。

words.note: 語塊：supervisory position（管理職）、supervisory role（監督角色）、supervisory experience（管理經驗）。supervisory 是形容詞；supervisor 是「主管」；supervision 是「監督」。

sentences.en: By the time the guests arrived, the staff had already prepared all of the food and decorations.
sentences.zh: 客人到的時候，員工已經準備好所有食物和裝飾了。

sentences.en: By the time you receive this email, the new software will have been installed on your computer.
sentences.zh: 你收到這封郵件的時候，新軟體已經安裝在你的電腦上了。

sentences.en: The tickets had sold out by the time Ms. Brooks tried to buy them online on Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: Brooks 小姐週五下午想上網買票的時候，票已經賣光了。

sentences.en: By the time the store opens on Saturday, all of the new products will be on the shelves.
sentences.zh: 週六店開門的時候，所有新產品都會上架了。

sentences.en: By the time the director returns from her business trip, we hope to have finished the report.
sentences.zh: 總監出差回來的時候，我們希望已經完成報告了。

words.note: 語塊：by the time + 子句（到……時）。by the time 表示「在某時間點之前，某事已經完成」，主要子句常用完成式（By the time we arrived, the meeting had started）。

sentences.en: The company reported a twofold increase in online sales after it launched its new mobile app.
sentences.zh: 公司推出新 App 後，網路銷售增加了一倍。

sentences.en: The purpose of the new program is twofold: to train new staff and to improve customer service.
sentences.zh: 新計畫的目的有兩個：訓練新員工和改善客服。

sentences.en: There has been a twofold increase in the number of tourists visiting the island since the new airport opened.
sentences.zh: 自從新機場啟用後，造訪那座島的遊客人數增加了一倍。

sentences.en: The benefit of moving the factory is twofold, as it will lower costs and reduce delivery times.
sentences.zh: 搬遷工廠的好處有兩個，因為它會降低成本並縮短交貨時間。

sentences.en: The workshop has a twofold purpose: to share new ideas and to help employees from different offices meet.
sentences.zh: 工作坊有雙重目的：分享新點子，以及讓不同辦公室的員工互相認識。

words.note: 語塊：a twofold increase（增加一倍）、twofold purpose（雙重目的）。twofold 是「兩倍、兩方面的」；threefold 是「三倍」；double 意思接近。

sentences.en: The city will conduct a feasibility study before deciding whether to build a new subway line.
sentences.zh: 市政府會先進行可行性研究，再決定是否興建新捷運線。

sentences.en: The results of the feasibility study showed that the new hotel would be profitable within five years.
sentences.zh: 可行性研究結果顯示，新飯店五年內就會獲利。

sentences.en: A consulting firm was hired to conduct a feasibility study on opening a factory in Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一家顧問公司，針對在越南設廠進行可行性研究。

sentences.en: The board will review the results of the feasibility study at its meeting next month.
sentences.zh: 董事會將在下個月的會議上審查可行性研究的結果。

sentences.en: The feasibility study took six months to complete because the researchers had to visit several possible locations.
sentences.zh: 可行性研究花了六個月才完成，因為研究人員必須去好幾個可能的地點考察。

words.note: 語塊：conduct a feasibility study（進行可行性研究）、the results of the feasibility study（可行性研究結果）。feasibility 是名詞「可行性」；形容詞 feasible 是「可行的」。

sentences.en: The new luxury hotel on the beach has a private pool and a spa for every guest room.
sentences.zh: 海邊新開的豪華飯店每間客房都有私人泳池和水療設施。

sentences.en: Sales of luxury goods such as watches and handbags have increased among young professionals in large cities.
sentences.zh: 手錶和手提包等奢侈品在年輕上班族之間的銷售增加了。

sentences.en: The cruise ship offers passengers the chance to travel in luxury while visiting several islands.
sentences.zh: 那艘郵輪讓乘客能在造訪好幾座島嶼的同時奢華旅行。

sentences.en: The company sells luxury goods to wealthy customers in Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.
sentences.zh: 那家公司把奢侈品賣給亞洲、歐洲和中東的富裕顧客。

sentences.en: Many business travelers prefer to stay at a luxury hotel near the airport when they have early flights.
sentences.zh: 很多商務旅客在搭早班機時，喜歡住機場附近的豪華飯店。

words.note: 語塊：luxury hotel（豪華飯店）、luxury goods（奢侈品）、in luxury（奢華地）。luxury 當名詞或放在名詞前當形容詞；luxurious 是形容詞「豪華的」。

sentences.en: Moving the entire company to a new building in only one weekend was a major undertaking.
sentences.zh: 在一個週末內把整個公司搬到新大樓是一項大工程。

sentences.en: Building the bridge across the river was a huge undertaking that took more than eight years to complete.
sentences.zh: 興建那座跨河大橋是一項艱鉅的任務，花了八年多才完成。

sentences.en: Organizing the international conference is a major undertaking, so we will need help from every department.
sentences.zh: 籌辦國際研討會是一項大工程，所以我們需要每個部門幫忙。

sentences.en: Opening restaurants in ten countries at the same time is a risky undertaking for any company.
sentences.zh: 同時在十個國家開餐廳，對任何公司來說都是有風險的事業。

sentences.en: The renovation of the old train station was a huge undertaking, but the result has been very popular with residents.
sentences.zh: 整修舊火車站是一項艱鉅的任務，但成果非常受居民歡迎。

words.note: 語塊：a major undertaking（大工程）、a huge undertaking（艱鉅的任務）。undertaking 是「承擔的大型任務或事業」；undertake 是動詞；undertaker 是「殯葬業者」。

sentences.en: The new trade agreement will be advantageous to companies that export products to Europe and North America.
sentences.zh: 新的貿易協定對出口產品到歐洲的公司有利。

sentences.en: The store's location near the train station puts it in an advantageous position for attracting commuters.
sentences.zh: 那家店位於火車站附近，在吸引通勤族上處於有利位置。

sentences.en: It would be advantageous to sign the contract now, before the supplier raises its prices next month.
sentences.zh: 在供應商下個月漲價之前，現在簽約會比較有利。

sentences.en: Speaking a second language is advantageous to anyone who wants to work for a multinational company.
sentences.zh: 會說第二語言對任何想在跨國公司工作的人都很有利。

sentences.en: The company is in an advantageous position because it has very little debt and a large amount of cash.
sentences.zh: 公司處於有利位置，因為它負債很少，又有大量現金。

words.note: 語塊：advantageous to（對……有利）、advantageous position（有利的位置）。advantageous 是 advantage（優勢）的形容詞，比 beneficial 更強調「帶來優勢」。

words.meaning: 預定的；計畫中的；針對……的

sentences.en: This training program is intended for employees who have just been promoted to management positions.
sentences.zh: 這個訓練計畫是為剛升任管理職的員工設計的。

sentences.en: Please use the equipment only for its intended use and follow the instructions in the manual.
sentences.zh: 請只依照預定用途使用設備，並遵守手冊上的說明。

sentences.en: The advertisement did not reach its intended audience because it was shown late at night.
sentences.zh: 那支廣告沒有觸及目標觀眾，因為它是在深夜播出的。

sentences.en: The new park is intended for families with young children, so it has many playgrounds and picnic areas.
sentences.zh: 新公園是為有幼童的家庭設計的，所以有很多遊樂場和野餐區。

sentences.en: The book is intended for readers who have no experience with investing and want to learn the basics.
sentences.zh: 這本書是寫給沒有投資經驗、想學基礎知識的讀者。

words.note: 語塊：be intended for（是為……設計的）、intended use（預定用途）、intended audience（目標觀眾）。be intended for 是「專門給……的」；intentional 是「故意的」。

sentences.en: Small businesses will be the main beneficiary of the new tax policy announced by the government.
sentences.zh: 小企業會是政府宣布的新稅收政策的主要受益者。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee named her daughter as the beneficiary of her life insurance policy when she signed it last year.
sentences.zh: 李小姐去年簽壽險保單時，把女兒指定為受益人。

sentences.en: The local hospital was the beneficiary of a large donation from a wealthy businessman last year.
sentences.zh: 那家地方醫院去年得到一位富商的一大筆捐款。

sentences.en: Tourism is expected to be the main beneficiary of the new high-speed train between the two cities.
sentences.zh: 觀光業預計會是兩座城市之間新高鐵的主要受惠者。

sentences.en: Each beneficiary of the scholarship program must write a short report about their studies every year.
sentences.zh: 獎學金計畫的每位受惠者每年都必須寫一份關於學業的簡短報告。

words.note: 語塊：the main beneficiary（主要受益者）、beneficiary of（……的受益人）。beneficiary 是「得到好處的人」，在保險、遺囑中指「受益人」；benefit 是「好處」。

sentences.en: Sales for the third quarter were in line with expectations, so the company did not change its forecast.
sentences.zh: 第三季的銷售符合預期，所以公司沒有修改預測。

sentences.en: All expenses must be in line with the policy described in the employee handbook and on the website.
sentences.zh: 所有支出都必須符合員工手冊中描述的政策。

sentences.en: The price increase is in line with what other companies in the industry have done this year.
sentences.zh: 這次漲價和業界其他公司今年的做法一致。

sentences.en: The new design is in line with the company's goal of making products that are easy to recycle.
sentences.zh: 新設計符合公司製造易回收產品的目標。

sentences.en: Salaries at our company are in line with the average for similar positions in the city.
sentences.zh: 我們公司的薪水和城市裡類似職位的平均水準一致。

words.note: 語塊：in line with expectations（符合預期）、in line with the policy（符合政策）、in line with the average（和平均水準一致）、in line with the company's goal（符合公司目標）。be in line with 是「和……一致」；in line 也可以是「排隊」（wait in line）。

sentences.en: The main aim of the workshop is to help small business owners understand the new tax rules.
sentences.zh: 工作坊的主要目標是幫助小企業老闆了解新的稅務規定。

sentences.en: The company opened a research center in Seoul with the aim of developing new products for Asian customers.
sentences.zh: 公司在首爾設立研究中心，目標是為亞洲顧客開發新產品。

sentences.en: The aim of the survey is to find out how satisfied customers are with our delivery service.
sentences.zh: 這份調查的目的是了解顧客對我們配送服務的滿意程度。

sentences.en: Our main aim this year is to increase online sales while keeping our costs as low as possible.
sentences.zh: 我們今年的主要目標是增加網路銷售，同時盡量壓低成本。

sentences.en: The city started the program with the aim of reducing traffic and improving air quality downtown.
sentences.zh: 市政府推動這個計畫，目的是減少市中心的交通量並改善空氣品質。

words.note: 語塊：the aim of（……的目的）、main aim（主要目標）、with the aim of（以……為目標）。aim 當名詞是「目標」，當動詞是 aim to do（打算）或 aim at（瞄準）。goal、objective 意思接近。

sentences.en: The purpose of this meeting is to discuss the budget for next year's marketing campaign.
sentences.zh: 這次會議的目的是討論明年行銷活動的預算。

sentences.en: The information you provide will be used only for the purpose of processing your order.
sentences.zh: 你提供的資料只會用於處理你的訂單。

sentences.en: The manager believes that the mistake was not made on purpose, so no one will be punished.
sentences.zh: 經理認為那個錯誤不是故意的，所以不會有人受罰。

sentences.en: Please explain the purpose of your visit when you sign in at the security desk in the lobby.
sentences.zh: 在大廳保全櫃台登記時，請說明你來訪的目的。

sentences.en: The new building will be used for the purpose of training staff from all of our branches in the region.
sentences.zh: 新大樓將用來訓練我們在該地區所有分公司的員工。

words.note: 語塊：the purpose of（……的目的）、for the purpose of（為了……）、on purpose（故意地）。purpose 是「目的」；on purpose 是「故意」；propose（提議）長得像。

words.meaning: 藝術品；美術作品（不可數）

sentences.en: The hotel lobby displays original artwork by local painters, and all of the pieces are for sale.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳展示在地畫家的原創作品，所有作品都可以購買。

sentences.en: The new office will display artwork created by employees' children in the hallway near the cafeteria.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室會在員工餐廳附近的走廊展示員工孩子的作品。

sentences.en: Each piece of artwork in the gallery is carefully protected by glass and special lighting.
sentences.zh: 藝廊的每一件藝術品都用玻璃和特殊燈光小心保護著。

sentences.en: The museum received a donation of valuable artwork from a famous collector who lived in Paris.
sentences.zh: 博物館收到一位住在巴黎的知名收藏家捐贈的珍貴藝術品。

sentences.en: Customers can order prints of the original artwork from our website and have them delivered to their homes.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在我們網站上訂購原創作品的複製畫，宅配到府。

words.note: 語塊：original artwork（原創作品）、display artwork（展示藝術品）、piece of artwork（一件藝術品）。artwork 通常不可數；要說「一件」用 a piece of artwork；work of art 是可數的「藝術作品」。

sentences.en: The hardware store sells a wide range of gardening tools, seeds, and plants for the spring season.
sentences.zh: 那家五金行販售各式各樣春季用的園藝工具、種子和植物。

sentences.en: Many employees enjoy gardening, so the company created a small vegetable garden on the roof.
sentences.zh: 很多員工喜歡園藝，所以公司在屋頂上弄了一個小菜園。

sentences.en: The community center has a gardening club that meets every Saturday morning to plant flowers in the park.
sentences.zh: 社區中心有個園藝社，每週六早上聚會到公園種花。

sentences.en: Gardening has become a popular hobby among young people who live in apartments in the city.
sentences.zh: 園藝已經成為住在城市公寓裡的年輕人之間受歡迎的嗜好。

sentences.en: The magazine publishes a monthly column about gardening that gives readers tips for growing vegetables at home.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌每月刊登一篇園藝專欄，提供讀者在家種菜的祕訣。

words.note: 語塊：gardening tools（園藝工具）、gardening club（園藝社）、enjoy gardening（喜歡園藝）。gardening 是「種花種菜的活動」；gardener 是「園丁」。

sentences.en: The marketing team will meet on Tuesday to brainstorm ideas for the new advertising campaign.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊週二會開會，為新廣告活動集思廣益想點子。

sentences.en: Managers asked employees to brainstorm ways to reduce waste and save energy in the office.
sentences.zh: 經理要員工腦力激盪，想出減少浪費和節省能源的辦法。

sentences.en: It is helpful to brainstorm ideas in small groups so that everyone has a chance to speak.
sentences.zh: 分成小組集思廣益很有幫助，這樣每個人都有機會發言。

sentences.en: The designers spent the morning trying to brainstorm ways to make the product easier to use.
sentences.zh: 設計師花了一個早上腦力激盪，想辦法讓產品更容易使用。

sentences.en: Before writing the proposal, we should brainstorm ideas with the sales team to understand what customers want.
sentences.zh: 寫提案之前，我們應該和業務團隊一起集思廣益，了解顧客要什麼。

words.note: 語塊：brainstorm ideas（集思廣益想點子）、brainstorm ways to（腦力激盪想辦法）。brainstorm 可以當動詞或名詞；brainstorming session 是「腦力激盪會議」。

sentences.en: Workers will shut off the power to the building on Saturday morning to repair the electrical system.
sentences.zh: 工人週六早上會切斷大樓的電源，修理電力系統。

sentences.en: The city will shut off the water on Main Street for several hours while the old pipes are replaced.
sentences.zh: 更換舊水管期間，市政府會在 Main 街停水幾個小時。

sentences.en: The new heater is designed to shut off automatically if it gets too hot or falls over.
sentences.zh: 新的電暖器設計成太熱或倒下時會自動關閉。

sentences.en: Please remember to shut off the lights and air conditioner in the meeting room when you leave.
sentences.zh: 離開會議室時，請記得關掉燈和冷氣。

sentences.en: In case of a gas leak, staff should shut off the main valve and leave the building immediately.
sentences.zh: 萬一瓦斯外洩，員工應該關掉總開關並立刻離開大樓。

words.note: 語塊：shut off the power（切斷電源）、shut off the water（關水）、shut off automatically（自動關閉）。shut off 是「關掉供應（水電瓦斯）」；turn off 是一般的「關掉」；shut down 是「停止運作、關閉（工廠、系統）」。

sentences.en: Outdoor workers were told to take frequent breaks because of the extreme heat this week.
sentences.zh: 因為這週酷熱，戶外工作者被告知要經常休息。

sentences.en: If you feel cold in the office, please ask the building manager to turn up the heat.
sentences.zh: 如果你在辦公室覺得冷，請請大樓管理員把暖氣開大。

sentences.en: The heat wave caused a sharp increase in sales of fans, air conditioners, and cold drinks.
sentences.zh: 熱浪讓電風扇、冷氣和冷飲的銷售大幅增加。

sentences.en: These gloves protect workers' hands from heat when they are handling hot metal in the factory.
sentences.zh: 這種手套可以在工人處理工廠裡的熱金屬時，保護他們的手不被燙傷。

sentences.en: During the heat wave, the city opened cooling centers for elderly residents who do not have air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 熱浪期間，市政府為家裡沒冷氣的年長居民開放了避暑中心。

words.note: 語塊：extreme heat（酷熱）、turn up the heat（把暖氣開大）、heat wave（熱浪）。heat 是「熱度」；heating 是「暖氣系統」；heater 是「暖氣機」。

sentences.en: Companies that fail to meet the safety standards will have to pay a large fine to the government.
sentences.zh: 未能達到安全標準的公司必須向政府繳一大筆罰款。

sentences.en: If the shipment should fail to arrive by Friday, please contact our customer service department.
sentences.zh: 如果貨物週五前沒有送達，請聯絡我們的客服部。

sentences.en: Many drivers fail to notice the new speed limit signs that were placed near the school last month.
sentences.zh: 很多駕駛沒注意到上個月在學校附近設置的新速限標誌。

sentences.en: Projects often fail to finish on time when the team does not have clear goals from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 當團隊從一開始就沒有明確目標時，專案常常無法準時完成。

sentences.en: The store will offer a full refund if our products fail to meet your expectations in any way.
sentences.zh: 如果我們的產品在任何方面未能達到您的期望，商店會全額退款。

words.note: 語塊：fail to meet（未能達到）、fail to arrive（沒有抵達）、fail to notice（沒注意到）。fail to do 是「沒做到」；never fail to 是「總是會」。名詞是 failure。

sentences.en: The company hires an external auditor every year to check its financial records and accounts.
sentences.zh: 公司每年聘請一位外部稽核員檢查財務紀錄和帳目。

sentences.en: Please save a copy of your files on an external hard drive before the computer is repaired.
sentences.zh: 電腦送修前，請把檔案存一份到外接硬碟。

sentences.en: This cream is for external use only and should not be applied near the eyes or mouth.
sentences.zh: 這款乳霜僅供外用，不應該塗在眼睛或嘴巴附近。

sentences.en: The museum's external walls were cleaned and painted as part of the renovation project last summer.
sentences.zh: 博物館的外牆在去年夏天的整修工程中清洗並重新粉刷了。

sentences.en: The board invited an external expert to review the company's plans for expanding into new markets.
sentences.zh: 董事會邀請一位外部專家審查公司進軍新市場的計畫。

words.note: 語塊：external auditor（外部稽核員）、external hard drive（外接硬碟）、external use（外用）。external 是「外部的」；internal 是「內部的」；eternal（永恆的）長得像。

sentences.en: The external auditor found several errors in the company's accounts and asked for them to be corrected.
sentences.zh: 外部稽核員在公司的帳目中發現了幾個錯誤，要求更正。

sentences.en: Ms. Kaur works as an internal auditor and checks that every department follows the company's rules.
sentences.zh: Kaur 小姐擔任內部稽核員，檢查每個部門是否遵守公司規定。

sentences.en: The auditor will visit our office next week, so please make sure all receipts are organized by date.
sentences.zh: 稽核員下週會來我們辦公室，所以請確認所有收據都按日期整理好。

sentences.en: An independent auditor reviewed the charity's finances to make sure that donations were used properly.
sentences.zh: 一位獨立的稽核員審查了慈善團體的財務，確保捐款被妥善使用。

sentences.en: The internal auditor recommended several changes to improve the way the company tracks its expenses.
sentences.zh: 內部稽核員建議了幾項改變，改善公司追蹤開支的方式。

words.note: 語塊：external auditor（外部稽核員）、internal auditor（內部稽核員）。auditor 是檢查公司帳目的「稽核員」；audit 是名詞或動詞「稽核」；audience 是「觀眾」。

sentences.en: The IT department will upgrade the computer network this weekend, so the internet may be slow on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 資訊部這個週末會升級電腦網路，所以週六網路可能會比較慢。

sentences.en: Joining a professional association is a good way to build a business network in a new city.
sentences.zh: 加入專業協會是在新城市建立商業人脈的好方法。

sentences.en: The company has a network of more than five hundred stores across Europe and North America.
sentences.zh: 公司在歐洲和北美有五百多家門市組成的網絡。

sentences.en: Ms. Okafor used her business network to find investors for her new restaurant in the city center.
sentences.zh: Okafor 小姐利用她的商業人脈，為她在市中心的新餐廳找到投資人。

sentences.en: The city is building a network of bicycle paths that will connect all of the major parks.
sentences.zh: 市政府正在建造一個連接所有主要公園的自行車道網絡。

words.note: 語塊：computer network（電腦網路）、business network（商業人脈）、a network of（……的網絡）。network 可以指電腦「網路」、「人脈」，或電視「聯播網」；networking 是「建立人脈」。

sentences.en: The city plans to widen the road between the airport and the city center to reduce traffic jams.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫拓寬機場到市中心的道路，以減少塞車。

sentences.en: The store will widen the range of products it sells by adding furniture and home decorations.
sentences.zh: 那家店會增加家具和居家裝飾，擴大販售產品的範圍。

sentences.en: Experts warn that rising housing prices could widen the gap between rich and poor families.
sentences.zh: 專家警告，房價上漲可能會拉大富裕和貧窮家庭之間的差距。

sentences.en: The company hopes to widen its customer base by opening stores in smaller towns and villages.
sentences.zh: 公司希望到較小的城鎮和村莊開店，擴大顧客群。

sentences.en: Construction workers will widen the road near the school during the summer holiday when there are no students.
sentences.zh: 施工人員會在沒有學生的暑假期間拓寬學校附近的道路。

words.note: 語塊：widen the road（拓寬道路）、widen the gap（拉大差距）、widen the range of（擴大……的範圍）。widen 是「變寬、擴大」；wide 是形容詞；width 是名詞「寬度」。

sentences.en: Please notify the front desk in advance if you plan to check out of the hotel later than noon.
sentences.zh: 如果你打算中午以後才退房，請事先通知櫃台。

sentences.en: The company will notify all customers of the price changes by email at least one month before they take effect.
sentences.zh: 公司會在價格調整生效前至少一個月，用電子郵件通知所有顧客。

sentences.en: Successful applicants will be notified by phone, and the company will notify the others by email.
sentences.zh: 錄取者會接到電話通知，公司會用電子郵件通知其他人。

sentences.en: Employees must notify their supervisor of any absence as soon as possible, preferably before nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 員工有任何缺勤都必須盡快通知主管，最好在九點以前。

sentences.en: The bank will notify you of any unusual activity on your account by sending a text message to your phone.
sentences.zh: 銀行會傳簡訊到你的手機，通知你帳戶上的任何異常活動。

words.note: 語塊：notify sb of sth（通知某人某事）、notify in advance（事先通知）、be notified by（由……通知）。notify 比 tell、inform 正式；名詞是 notification（通知）。

sentences.en: All residents must file a tax return by the end of May every year, even if they have a low income.
sentences.zh: 所有居民每年都必須在五月底前報稅，即使收入很低也一樣。

sentences.en: Our accountants can prepare a tax return for you quickly and make sure that you receive every possible deduction.
sentences.zh: 我們的會計師可以很快幫你準備報稅資料，確保你得到所有可能的扣除額。

sentences.en: Many people now file a tax return online because it is faster and easier than sending forms by mail.
sentences.zh: 現在很多人上網報稅，因為比郵寄表格更快、更簡單。

sentences.en: Please keep all of your receipts so that you can prepare a tax return accurately at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 請保留所有收據，讓你年底可以正確地準備報稅資料。

sentences.en: The deadline to file a tax return has been extended by one month because of problems with the government website.
sentences.zh: 因為政府網站出問題，報稅截止日延長了一個月。

words.note: 語塊：file a tax return（報稅）、prepare a tax return（準備報稅資料）。tax return 是「報稅（的表格）」，不是「退稅」；tax refund 才是「退稅」。

sentences.en: Students who are having trouble with math can attend a tutoring session at the library every Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 數學有困難的學生可以每週三到圖書館參加輔導課。

sentences.en: The community center offers a free tutoring session for children whose parents work late in the evening.
sentences.zh: 社區中心為父母晚上工作到很晚的孩子提供免費輔導課。

sentences.en: Each tutoring session lasts one hour and focuses on reading, writing, or basic science for young students.
sentences.zh: 每堂輔導課一小時，重點放在閱讀、寫作或基礎科學。

sentences.en: Please book a tutoring session at least two days in advance through the school's online system.
sentences.zh: 請至少提前兩天透過學校的線上系統預約輔導課。

sentences.en: After attending a tutoring session every week for three months, Kevin's test scores improved greatly.
sentences.zh: 每週參加一堂輔導課持續三個月後，Kevin 的考試成績進步很多。

words.note: 語塊：attend a tutoring session（參加輔導課）、free tutoring session（免費輔導課）。tutoring 是「個別輔導、家教」；tutor 是「家教老師」；tutorial 是「教學（影片、課程）」。

sentences.en: All new employees must have a medical examination before they begin working at the factory.
sentences.zh: 所有新員工在工廠開始工作前都必須做健康檢查。

sentences.en: Accountants must pass an examination before they can receive their professional license from the national association.
sentences.zh: 會計師必須通過考試才能拿到專業執照。

sentences.en: After a careful examination of the damaged machine, the technician decided to replace the motor.
sentences.zh: 仔細檢查受損的機器後，技師決定更換馬達。

sentences.en: The doctor recommended a medical examination every year for employees who are over forty years old.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議四十歲以上的員工每年做一次健康檢查。

sentences.en: Students who pass an examination in English can skip the first level of the language course.
sentences.zh: 通過英文考試的學生可以跳過語言課程的第一級。

words.note: 語塊：medical examination（健康檢查）、pass an examination（通過考試）、careful examination（仔細檢查）。examination 比 exam 正式；可以是「考試」，也可以是「檢查」；examiner 是「考官」。

sentences.en: Please consult with your manager before making any changes to the project schedule or budget.
sentences.zh: 修改專案時程之前，請先和你的經理商量。

sentences.en: If the pain continues for more than a week, you should consult a doctor as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果疼痛持續超過一週，你應該盡快看醫生。

sentences.en: If the machine stops working, consult the manual first before calling a technician for help.
sentences.zh: 如果機器停止運作，打電話找技師之前先查閱手冊。

sentences.en: The company will consult with local residents before building the new factory near the river.
sentences.zh: 公司在河邊蓋新工廠之前，會先和當地居民商量。

sentences.en: Before signing any contract, it is wise to consult a lawyer who understands the industry well.
sentences.zh: 簽任何合約之前，請教一位熟悉這個產業的律師是明智的。

words.note: 語塊：consult with（和……商量）、consult a doctor（看醫生）、consult the manual（查閱手冊）。consult 是「向專家請教」或「查閱資料」；consultant 是「顧問」。

sentences.en: Ms. Gray works in quality assurance and checks that every product meets our high standards.
sentences.zh: Gray 小姐在品管部工作，檢查每項產品是否符合我們的高標準。

sentences.en: The manager gave assurance to the staff that no jobs would be lost because of the merger.
sentences.zh: 經理向員工保證，不會有人因為合併而失去工作。

sentences.en: The quality assurance team tests each phone for several hours before it is packed and shipped.
sentences.zh: 品質保證團隊在每支手機包裝出貨前會測試好幾個小時。

sentences.en: Customers want assurance that their personal information will be protected when they shop online with their credit cards.
sentences.zh: 顧客希望得到保證，網路購物時他們的個人資料會受到保護。

sentences.en: The supplier gave assurance that the missing parts would arrive at our factory by Thursday at the latest.
sentences.zh: 供應商保證缺少的零件最晚週四會送到我們工廠。

words.note: 語塊：quality assurance（品質保證）、give assurance（給予保證）、with assurance（有把握地）。assurance 是「保證、讓人放心的話」；insurance（保險）長得像，意思不同；assure 是動詞。

sentences.en: The factory installed a new monitoring system that warns workers when the machines become too hot.
sentences.zh: 工廠安裝了新的監控系統，在機器過熱時警告工人。

sentences.en: Environmental monitoring of the river showed that the water quality has improved over the past year.
sentences.zh: 河川的環境監測顯示，過去一年水質有所改善。

sentences.en: Patients in the intensive care unit receive constant monitoring by doctors and nurses day and night.
sentences.zh: 加護病房的病人日夜都受到醫生和護士的持續監控。

sentences.en: The bank uses a monitoring system to detect unusual payments that might be made by criminals.
sentences.zh: 銀行用監控系統偵測可能是罪犯所為的異常付款。

sentences.en: The city spends a large amount of money on air quality monitoring in neighborhoods near the highway.
sentences.zh: 市政府花了很多錢在高速公路附近社區的空氣品質監測上。

words.note: 語塊：monitoring system（監控系統）、environmental monitoring（環境監測）、constant monitoring（持續監控）。monitoring 是名詞「監控」；monitor 可以是動詞「監控」或名詞「螢幕」。

sentences.en: The new menu has been very popular, and the seafood pasta in particular has received many good reviews.
sentences.zh: 新菜單很受歡迎，尤其是海鮮義大利麵得到很多好評。

sentences.en: Please let us know if there is a particular day next week when you are not available for a meeting.
sentences.zh: 如果下週有哪一天你不方便開會，請告訴我們。

sentences.en: The client is very particular about the colors used in the design, so please follow her instructions carefully.
sentences.zh: 客戶對設計使用的顏色很講究，所以請仔細照她的指示做。

sentences.en: Sales of winter clothing increased in many regions, but in the north in particular, sales doubled.
sentences.zh: 冬季服飾的銷售在很多地區都增加了，尤其是北部，銷售翻了一倍。

sentences.en: The hotel can prepare special meals for guests who are particular about what they eat.
sentences.zh: 飯店可以為對飲食很講究的客人準備特別餐點。

words.note: 語塊：in particular（尤其；特別是）、a particular day（某一天）、be particular about（對……很挑剔）。in particular 是「尤其、特別」；be particular about 是「對……很講究」。

sentences.en: Several investors called to express interest in the new technology that our company presented at the fair.
sentences.zh: 好幾位投資人打電話來，表示對我們公司在展覽上發表的新技術有興趣。

sentences.en: Residents attended the meeting to express concern about the noise from the new construction site.
sentences.zh: 居民參加會議，表達對新工地噪音的擔憂。

sentences.en: The CEO wrote a letter to all employees to express thanks for their hard work during the busy season.
sentences.zh: 執行長寫信給全體員工，感謝他們在旺季的辛勤工作。

sentences.en: Customers who would like to express concern about our service can fill out the form on our website.
sentences.zh: 想對我們的服務表達意見的顧客，可以填寫網站上的表格。

sentences.en: If you would like to express interest in the position, please send your résumé to the human resources office.
sentences.zh: 如果你想表達對這個職位的興趣，請把履歷寄到人資室。

words.note: 語塊：express interest in（表示有興趣）、express concern about（表達擔憂）、express thanks（表達感謝）。express 當動詞是「表達」；當形容詞是「快速的」（express delivery 快遞）。expression 是名詞。

sentences.en: Electric bicycles have continued to gain popularity among commuters who want to avoid traffic jams.
sentences.zh: 電動自行車在想避開塞車的通勤族之間越來越受歡迎。

sentences.en: The growing popularity of online shopping has forced many stores to offer faster delivery services.
sentences.zh: 網路購物日益普及，迫使很多商店提供更快的配送服務。

sentences.en: The popularity of the new coffee shop surprised the owners, who had to hire more staff after only one month.
sentences.zh: 那家新咖啡店受歡迎的程度讓老闆很意外，才一個月就得增聘人手。

sentences.en: The restaurant's popularity grew quickly after a famous food blogger posted a video about its dumplings.
sentences.zh: 一位知名美食部落客發了一支介紹那家餐廳水餃的影片後，餐廳很快就爆紅了。

sentences.en: Because of the growing popularity of yoga, the gym will add three new classes every week starting in May.
sentences.zh: 因為瑜伽越來越受歡迎，健身房從五月開始每週會增加三堂新課。

words.note: 語塊：gain popularity（越來越受歡迎）、growing popularity（日益普及）、the popularity of（……的受歡迎程度）。popularity 是名詞；popular 是形容詞「受歡迎的」；population（人口）長得像。

sentences.en: I am writing with regard to the job opening for a sales manager that was posted on your website.
sentences.zh: 我來信是關於貴公司網站上刊登的業務經理職缺。

sentences.en: With regard to your question about shipping, all orders will be sent within three business days.
sentences.zh: 關於您對運送的問題，所有訂單都會在三個工作天內寄出。

sentences.en: Please contact Ms. Ramos with regard to any changes to the schedule for next week's conference.
sentences.zh: 下週研討會的時程如有任何變動，請聯絡 Ramos 小姐。

sentences.en: The company has made several improvements with regard to safety in the warehouse this year.
sentences.zh: 公司今年在倉庫安全方面做了好幾項改善。

sentences.en: With regard to the budget, the director has asked each department to reduce its spending by ten percent.
sentences.zh: 關於預算，總監已要求每個部門減少百分之十的支出。

words.note: 語塊：with regard to（關於……）。with regard to 和 regarding、concerning、about 意思相同，比較正式；注意 regard 不加 s。

sentences.en: The company will appoint a regional director to manage its new offices in Southeast Asia next year.
sentences.zh: 公司明年將任命一位區域總監，管理在東南亞的新辦公室。

sentences.en: Ms. Ng was promoted to regional director of sales for the northern part of the country.
sentences.zh: 吳小姐被升為國內北部的業務區域總監。

sentences.en: The regional director visits each of the twenty stores in her area at least twice a year.
sentences.zh: 區域總監每年至少拜訪她轄區內的二十家門市各兩次。

sentences.en: All store managers must send their monthly reports to the regional director by the fifth of each month.
sentences.zh: 所有店長都必須在每月五日前把月報交給區域總監。

sentences.en: After ten years as a store manager, Mr. Diaz became the regional director of the company's European operations.
sentences.zh: 當了十年店長之後，Diaz 先生成為公司歐洲業務的區域總監。

words.note: 語塊：appoint a regional director（任命區域總監）、regional director of（……的區域總監）。regional 是「區域的」；regional director 負責一個地區的多個分店或辦公室。

sentences.en: The sales team holds a weekly meeting every Monday morning to review the results of the previous week.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊每週一早上開週會，檢討前一週的成果。

sentences.en: Each project manager must submit a weekly report that describes the progress of his or her team.
sentences.zh: 每位專案經理都必須提交一份描述團隊進度的週報。

sentences.en: The office is cleaned on a weekly basis, but the kitchen is cleaned every evening after work.
sentences.zh: 辦公室每週清潔一次，但廚房每天下班後都會清潔。

sentences.en: Employees receive a weekly newsletter by email with updates about company events and new policies.
sentences.zh: 員工每週會收到一封電子報，內容是公司活動和新政策的最新消息。

sentences.en: The weekly meeting has been moved to Tuesday this week because Monday is a national holiday.
sentences.zh: 這週的週會改到週二，因為週一是國定假日。

words.note: 語塊：weekly meeting（週會）、weekly report（週報）、on a weekly basis（每週）。weekly 可以當形容詞或副詞；daily 是「每天的」，monthly 是「每月的」。

sentences.en: Please sign out of your computer before you leave the office so that no one else can use your account.
sentences.zh: 離開辦公室前請登出電腦，以免別人使用你的帳號。

sentences.en: Visitors must sign out at the front desk and return their badges when they leave the building.
sentences.zh: 訪客離開大樓時必須在櫃台簽退並歸還識別證。

sentences.en: Employees who need a laptop for a business trip can sign out equipment from the IT department.
sentences.zh: 出差需要筆電的員工可以向資訊部登記借出設備。

sentences.en: If you use a shared computer, always remember to sign out of your email account after checking your messages.
sentences.zh: 如果你用共用電腦，看完信後一定要記得登出電子郵件帳號。

sentences.en: Staff must sign out equipment such as cameras and projectors and return them within three days.
sentences.zh: 員工必須登記借出相機和投影機等設備，並在三天內歸還。

words.note: 語塊：sign out of（登出……）、sign out equipment（登記借出設備）。sign out 可以是「登出帳號」、「簽名離開」或「登記借出物品」；sign in 是「登入、簽到」。

sentences.en: The company hired a famous actor to promote its new line of sports shoes on social media.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位知名演員在社群媒體上推廣新系列運動鞋。

sentences.en: The manager plans to promote Ms. Rivera to assistant director because of her excellent work this year.
sentences.zh: 因為 Rivera 小姐今年表現優秀，經理打算把她升為副主任。

sentences.en: The city is running a campaign to promote awareness of the importance of recycling at home.
sentences.zh: 市政府正在推行一項活動，提升民眾對在家回收重要性的認識。

sentences.en: The tourism office uses videos and festivals to promote the island as a destination for families.
sentences.zh: 觀光處用影片和節慶把那座島推廣為適合家庭旅遊的地點。

sentences.en: To promote the new product, the store will give away free samples to customers this weekend.
sentences.zh: 為了推廣新產品，店家這個週末會免費送試用品給顧客。

words.note: 語塊：promote a product（推廣產品）、be promoted to（被升為）、promote awareness（提升意識）。promote 有「升職」和「推廣」兩個意思；promotion 是名詞「升遷；促銷」。

sentences.en: Please check all of the figures carefully to ensure that the report does not contain any errors.
sentences.zh: 請仔細檢查所有數字，確保報告沒有任何錯誤。

sentences.en: The factory tests every product several times to ensure quality before it is sent to stores.
sentences.zh: 工廠在產品送到門市前會測試好幾次，以確保品質。

sentences.en: Security guards are on duty twenty-four hours a day to ensure safety in the building and the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 保全二十四小時值班，確保大樓和停車場的安全。

sentences.en: To ensure that your package arrives on time, please place your order before noon on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 為了確保包裹準時送達，請在週四中午前下訂單。

sentences.en: The manager will meet with each team every week to ensure that the project stays on schedule.
sentences.zh: 經理每週會和每個團隊開會，確保專案按進度進行。

words.note: 語塊：ensure that（確保……）、ensure safety（確保安全）、ensure quality（確保品質）。ensure 是「確保」；insure 是「投保」；assure 是「向人保證」。

sentences.en: If you have any questions about your bill, please call and speak to a customer representative.
sentences.zh: 如果你對帳單有任何問題，請打電話和客服代表通話。

sentences.en: The company is hiring for a customer representative position that requires good communication skills and patience.
sentences.zh: 公司正在招募一個需要良好溝通能力的客服代表職位。

sentences.en: A customer representative will contact you within twenty-four hours to help you with your request.
sentences.zh: 客服代表會在二十四小時內聯絡您，協助處理您的需求。

sentences.en: Each customer representative receives two weeks of training before answering calls from customers on their own.
sentences.zh: 每位客服代表在接聽顧客電話前都會接受兩週的訓練。

sentences.en: The online chat allows customers to speak to a customer representative without waiting on the phone.
sentences.zh: 線上客服讓顧客不用在電話上等候，就能和客服代表交談。

words.note: 語塊：speak to a customer representative（和客服代表通話）、customer representative position（客服代表職位）。customer representative 也常叫 customer service representative；representative 是「代表」。

sentences.en: The hotel will train staff from all of its locations to use the new booking system next month.
sentences.zh: 飯店下個月會培訓所有分館的員工使用新的訂房系統。

sentences.en: The service center will train technicians to repair both old and new models of washing machines.
sentences.zh: 服務中心會訓練技師維修新舊款的洗衣機。

sentences.en: Experienced employees often help to train new workers during their first few weeks at the factory.
sentences.zh: 資深員工常常在新工人到工廠的頭幾週協助訓練他們。

sentences.en: The airline will train pilots to fly the new aircraft at its training center in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 航空公司會在新加坡的訓練中心訓練飛行員駕駛新機型。

sentences.en: It takes about three months to train a new customer service representative to handle every type of call.
sentences.zh: 訓練一位新客服代表處理各種來電大約需要三個月。

words.note: 語塊：train staff（培訓員工）、train technicians（訓練技師）、train new workers（訓練新人）。train 當動詞是「訓練」；trainee 是「受訓者」；trainer 是「訓練員」。

sentences.en: Please check your email regularly while you are traveling so that you do not miss any important messages.
sentences.zh: 出差期間請定期查看電子郵件，以免錯過任何重要訊息。

sentences.en: The information on our website is regularly updated to include the latest prices and product details.
sentences.zh: 我們網站上的資訊會定期更新，包含最新的價格和產品細節。

sentences.en: The members of the committee meet regularly to discuss the progress of the city's new transportation plan.
sentences.zh: 委員會成員定期開會，討論城市新交通計畫的進度。

sentences.en: Customers who regularly shop at our store can join the loyalty program and receive special discounts.
sentences.zh: 經常在我們店購物的顧客可以加入忠誠計畫，享有特別折扣。

sentences.en: The machines in the factory must be checked regularly to prevent accidents and expensive repairs.
sentences.zh: 工廠的機器必須定期檢查，以防止意外和昂貴的維修。

words.note: 語塊：check regularly（定期檢查）、regularly updated（定期更新）、meet regularly（定期開會）。regularly 是「規律地、定期地」；frequently 偏「頻繁地」。

sentences.en: If you are not satisfied with your purchase, you can return it within thirty days for a full refund.
sentences.zh: 如果您對購買的商品不滿意，可以在三十天內退貨並獲得全額退款。

sentences.en: Most guests said that they were satisfied with the service at the hotel but not with the breakfast.
sentences.zh: 大部分客人說他們對飯店的服務滿意，但對早餐不滿意。

sentences.en: The manager was fully satisfied with the results of the training program and plans to repeat it next year.
sentences.zh: 經理對訓練計畫的成果完全滿意，打算明年再辦一次。

sentences.en: The client was not satisfied with the first design, so the team created three new versions for her to choose from.
sentences.zh: 客戶對第一版設計不滿意，所以團隊做了三個新版本讓她挑選。

sentences.en: We want to make sure that every customer is fully satisfied with our products and our delivery service.
sentences.zh: 我們想確保每位顧客對我們的產品和配送服務都完全滿意。

words.note: 語塊：be satisfied with（對……滿意）、fully satisfied with（完全滿意）。be satisfied with 是「感到滿意」；satisfying 是「令人滿意的」；satisfactory 是「令人滿意的、合格的」。

words.meaning: 公用事業公司（水電瓦斯公司）

sentences.en: Please contact the utility company if the electricity in your apartment goes off for more than an hour.
sentences.zh: 如果你公寓停電超過一小時，請聯絡電力公司。

sentences.en: The local utility company will replace the old water pipes on our street during the next two weeks.
sentences.zh: 當地的公用事業公司在接下來兩週會更換我們街上的舊水管。

sentences.en: Customers can now pay their bills to the utility company online or through a mobile app.
sentences.zh: 顧客現在可以在網路上或用 App 繳交水電公司的帳單。

sentences.en: The utility company announced that electricity prices will increase by five percent starting in January.
sentences.zh: 電力公司宣布從一月起電價將調漲百分之五。

sentences.en: Before moving into your new home, remember to contact the utility company to set up an account.
sentences.zh: 搬進新家之前，記得聯絡水電公司開戶。

words.note: 語塊：contact the utility company（聯絡水電公司）、local utility company（當地公用事業公司）。utility 是「水電瓦斯等公用事業」；utilities 也可以指「水電費」。

sentences.en: All workers must follow the safety regulations and wear helmets while they are on the construction site.
sentences.zh: 所有工人在工地都必須遵守安全規定並戴安全帽。

sentences.en: For safety reasons, the elevator will be closed while technicians carry out repairs on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 為了安全起見，技師週六維修期間電梯會關閉。

sentences.en: The factory spent a large amount of money on new safety equipment after the inspection last year.
sentences.zh: 去年檢查之後，工廠花了很多錢購買新的安全裝備。

sentences.en: Visitors to the laboratory must put on safety equipment such as glasses and gloves before entering.
sentences.zh: 參觀實驗室的訪客進入前必須戴上護目鏡和手套等安全裝備。

sentences.en: For safety reasons, children under the age of twelve must be with an adult when they use the pool.
sentences.zh: 為了安全，十二歲以下的孩子使用泳池時必須有大人陪同。

words.note: 語塊：safety regulations（安全規定）、for safety reasons（為了安全）、safety equipment（安全裝備）。safety 是名詞「安全」；safe 是形容詞「安全的」或名詞「保險箱」。

sentences.en: The new art museum will be open to the public every day except Mondays and national holidays.
sentences.zh: 新美術館除了週一和國定假日以外，每天都對外開放。

sentences.en: Public opinion about the new airport has changed since the government promised to reduce noise.
sentences.zh: 政府承諾降低噪音之後，民眾對新機場的看法改變了。

sentences.en: Many employees use public transportation to get to work because parking downtown is very expensive.
sentences.zh: 很多員工搭大眾運輸上班，因為市中心停車很貴。

sentences.en: The city will hold a public meeting on Thursday evening to discuss plans for the new park.
sentences.zh: 市政府週四晚上會舉行公開會議，討論新公園的計畫。

sentences.en: The garden behind the old palace is now open to the public after being closed for twenty years.
sentences.zh: 舊皇宮後面的花園在關閉二十年後，現在對外開放了。

words.note: 語塊：public transportation（大眾運輸）、public opinion（輿論）、open to the public（對外開放）。public 是「公共的、公開的」；the public 是「大眾」；publicity 是「宣傳」。

sentences.en: Customers reacted well to the new design, and we expect the market to react to it positively too.
sentences.zh: 顧客對新設計反應很好，我們也預期市場會正面回應。

sentences.en: It is important for companies to react quickly when customers complain about them on social media.
sentences.zh: 顧客在社群媒體上抱怨時，公司迅速反應很重要。

sentences.en: The stock market is expected to react to the news of the merger when it opens on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 股市預計會在週一早上開盤時，對合併的消息做出反應。

sentences.en: Staff are trained to react calmly and follow the emergency plan if the fire alarm goes off.
sentences.zh: 員工受過訓練，火警警報響起時要冷靜反應並遵循緊急計畫。

sentences.en: We need to react to the changes in the market before our competitors take our customers.
sentences.zh: 我們需要在競爭對手搶走我們的顧客之前，對市場變化做出反應。

words.note: 語塊：react to（對……做出反應）、react quickly（迅速反應）。react 是「對某事做出反應」；respond 意思接近；reaction 是名詞。

sentences.en: The company has kept the secret formula for its famous soft drink locked in a safe for over one hundred years.
sentences.zh: 那家公司把著名汽水的秘密配方鎖在保險箱裡超過一百年。

sentences.en: The shampoo now has a new formula that is gentler on the skin and better for the environment.
sentences.zh: 那款洗髮精現在有新配方，對皮膚更溫和，對環境也更好。

sentences.en: There is no simple formula for success, but hard work and good planning certainly help.
sentences.zh: 成功沒有簡單的方法，但努力工作和良好的規劃一定有幫助。

sentences.en: The scientists spent three years developing a new formula for paint that dries in only ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 科學家花了三年開發一種只要十分鐘就會乾的新油漆配方。

sentences.en: The restaurant's formula for success is fresh local ingredients, friendly service, and very reasonable prices.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的成功方法是新鮮的食材、親切的服務和合理的價格。

words.note: 語塊：secret formula（秘密配方）、new formula（新配方）、a formula for（……的方法）。formula 可以是化學「配方」、數學「公式」，也可以比喻「成功的方法」；複數 formulas 或 formulae。

sentences.en: It will remain to be seen whether the new store can attract enough customers in such a quiet area.
sentences.zh: 新店在這麼安靜的地區能否吸引足夠的顧客，還有待觀察。

sentences.en: Whether the price increase will affect sales will remain to be seen until the end of the quarter.
sentences.zh: 漲價是否會影響銷售，要到季末才知道。

sentences.en: The new law sounds helpful, but its effect on small businesses will remain to be seen for some time.
sentences.zh: 新法律聽起來有幫助，但它對小企業的影響還需要一段時間觀察。

sentences.en: It may remain to be seen whether the merger will create more jobs or lead to job losses.
sentences.zh: 合併會創造更多工作還是導致失業，可能還有待觀察。

sentences.en: How customers will react to the new design will remain to be seen until it is launched next month.
sentences.zh: 顧客會對新設計有什麼反應，要等下個月推出後才知道。

words.note: 語塊：it will remain to be seen（是否……還有待觀察）。remain to be seen 是「現在還不知道，要等之後才知道」；常用 It remains to be seen whether...。

sentences.en: Residents wrote letters to their local congressperson asking for more government funding for public schools.
sentences.zh: 居民寫信給當地的國會議員，要求增加公立學校的經費。

sentences.en: The congressperson visited the factory to learn more about the challenges facing manufacturers in the region.
sentences.zh: 那位國會議員參觀了工廠，進一步了解地區製造業面臨的挑戰。

sentences.en: If you have concerns about the new tax policy, you can contact your congressperson by phone or email.
sentences.zh: 如果你對新稅收政策有疑慮，可以打電話或寫電子郵件聯絡你的國會議員。

sentences.en: Our local congressperson will speak at the opening ceremony of the new hospital on Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 我們當地的國會議員週六早上會在新醫院的開幕典禮上致詞。

sentences.en: The business association invited a congressperson to discuss how the new trade agreement will affect exports.
sentences.zh: 商業協會邀請一位國會議員討論新貿易協定會如何影響出口。

words.note: 語塊：local congressperson（當地國會議員）、contact your congressperson（聯絡你的國會議員）。congressperson 是不分性別的「國會議員」；也可以用 congressman、congresswoman，或 representative。

sentences.en: Please show your membership card to the cashier when you pay to receive your discount.
sentences.zh: 付款時請向收銀員出示會員卡，以享有折扣。

sentences.en: If you have a coupon, please give it to the cashier before your items are scanned.
sentences.zh: 如果你有優惠券，請在商品掃描前交給收銀員。

sentences.en: The supermarket is hiring a part-time cashier who can work on weekends and holiday evenings.
sentences.zh: 超市正在招聘一位可以在週末和假日晚上上班的兼職收銀員。

sentences.en: Customers can pay the cashier with cash, credit cards, or mobile payment apps at every register.
sentences.zh: 顧客在每個收銀台都可以用現金、信用卡或行動支付 App 向收銀員付款。

sentences.en: If you would like a gift receipt, please ask the cashier when you are paying for your purchase.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要禮物收據，請在付款時詢問收銀員。

words.note: 語塊：ask the cashier（詢問收銀員）、pay the cashier（向收銀員付款）、cashier's desk（收銀台）。cashier 是「收銀員」；cash register 是「收銀機」；cashew 是「腰果」。

sentences.en: The small town experienced an influx of tourists after it appeared in a popular television drama.
sentences.zh: 那個小鎮出現在熱門電視劇後，湧入了大量觀光客。

sentences.en: Hotels in the city are preparing for an influx of visitors during the international film festival.
sentences.zh: 城裡的飯店正在為國際影展期間湧入的大量訪客做準備。

sentences.en: A sudden influx of orders during the holiday sale caused delays at the company's warehouse.
sentences.zh: 節慶特賣期間突然湧入大量訂單，造成公司倉庫延誤。

sentences.en: The new factory has led to an influx of workers from other regions looking for well-paid jobs.
sentences.zh: 新工廠吸引了大量從其他地區來找高薪工作的工人。

sentences.en: To handle the sudden influx of customers, the restaurant hired several temporary staff for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 為了應付突然湧入的顧客，那家餐廳週末臨時聘了幾位員工。

words.note: 語塊：an influx of（大量湧入的……）、a sudden influx（突然湧入）。influx 是「大量的人或東西湧入」；influence（影響）長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: The website offers a comprehensive guide to all of the restaurants, museums, and hotels in the city.
sentences.zh: 網站提供城裡所有餐廳、博物館和飯店的完整指南。

sentences.en: We recommend purchasing comprehensive insurance for your car, especially if you drive long distances often.
sentences.zh: 我們建議為你的車買全險，尤其是如果你常常開長途。

sentences.en: The company will conduct a comprehensive review of its spending before preparing next year's budget.
sentences.zh: 公司在準備明年預算之前，會全面檢討開支。

sentences.en: New employees receive comprehensive training that covers everything from workplace safety to customer service skills.
sentences.zh: 新員工會接受全面的訓練，內容從安全到客服都有。

sentences.en: The report provides a comprehensive review of the changes in the housing market over the past ten years.
sentences.zh: 報告全面回顧了過去十年房市的變化。

words.note: 語塊：comprehensive guide（完整指南）、comprehensive insurance（全險）、comprehensive review（全面檢討）。comprehensive 是「全面、包含一切的」；comprehensible 是「可以理解的」。
