sentences.en: The manager told the team to keep up the good work after they finished the project ahead of schedule.
sentences.zh: 團隊提前完成專案後，經理要他們繼續保持好表現。

sentences.en: It is difficult for small companies to keep up with the latest changes in technology.
sentences.zh: 小公司很難跟上科技的最新變化。

sentences.en: The factory hired more workers to keep up with the growing demand for its electric bicycles.
sentences.zh: 工廠增聘工人，以跟上電動自行車日益成長的需求。

sentences.en: Please read the weekly newsletter to keep up to date with news and events at the company.
sentences.zh: 請閱讀每週電子報，掌握公司的最新消息和活動。

sentences.en: Our sales are strong this year, and we hope to keep up this level of growth in the coming months.
sentences.zh: 我們今年業績很好，希望接下來幾個月能維持這樣的成長。

words.note: 語塊：keep up with（跟上）、keep up the good work（繼續保持好表現）、keep up to date（保持最新）。keep up with 是「跟上（速度、潮流）」；keep up the good work 是主管常說的鼓勵話。

words.meaning: 有說服力的；令人信服的

sentences.en: Ms. Park gave a convincing argument for moving the company's headquarters to a larger building.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐提出了一個有說服力的論點，支持把公司總部搬到更大的大樓。

sentences.en: There is convincing evidence that regular exercise improves both health and productivity at work for most people.
sentences.zh: 有令人信服的證據顯示，規律運動能改善健康和工作效率。

sentences.en: The sales team needs a more convincing presentation if it wants to win the contract with the hotel.
sentences.zh: 如果業務團隊想拿下和飯店的合約，需要一場更有說服力的簡報。

sentences.en: The lawyer did not find the evidence convincing enough to take the case to court.
sentences.zh: 律師覺得證據不夠有說服力，不足以把案子告上法院。

sentences.en: Our team won a convincing victory in the regional business competition, beating twenty other companies.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊在區域商業競賽中以壓倒性的優勢獲勝，擊敗了其他二十家公司。

words.note: 語塊：convincing argument（有說服力的論點）、convincing evidence（令人信服的證據）、a convincing win（壓倒性的勝利）。convincing 是「讓人相信的（事物）」；convinced 是「（人）確信的」。

sentences.en: Retirement savings accounts offer a tax advantage because you do not pay tax on the money until later.
sentences.zh: 退休儲蓄帳戶提供節稅好處，因為錢要到以後才需要繳稅。

sentences.en: One tax advantage of buying an electric car is that owners can receive money back from the government.
sentences.zh: 買電動車的一個稅務優勢是車主可以從政府那裡拿回一些錢。

sentences.en: The financial advisor explained the tax advantage of investing in government bonds to his clients.
sentences.zh: 理財顧問向客戶說明投資政府債券的稅務優勢。

sentences.en: Many companies move their offices to the region because of the tax advantage it offers to new businesses.
sentences.zh: 很多公司把辦公室搬到那個地區，因為它對新企業提供稅務優勢。

sentences.en: Donating to charity can offer a tax advantage, so please keep your receipts for your tax return.
sentences.zh: 捐款給慈善機構可以帶來節稅好處，所以請保留收據以便報稅。

words.note: 語塊：offer a tax advantage（提供節稅好處）、tax advantage of（……的稅務優勢）。tax advantage 指「能少繳稅的好處」；tax break、tax benefit 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please refrain from using your mobile phone during the performance so that you do not disturb others.
sentences.zh: 演出期間請勿使用手機，以免打擾其他人。

sentences.en: Visitors are asked to kindly refrain from touching the paintings and sculptures in the museum.
sentences.zh: 參觀者請勿觸摸博物館裡的畫作和雕塑。

sentences.en: Employees should refrain from discussing confidential information in public places such as restaurants, trains, and elevators.
sentences.zh: 員工應避免在餐廳等公共場所討論機密資訊。

sentences.en: Passengers must refrain from smoking anywhere on the train or the platform, including in the bathrooms.
sentences.zh: 乘客在火車上任何地方都不可以抽菸，包括廁所。

sentences.en: Please refrain from eating or drinking in the computer room in order to protect the expensive equipment.
sentences.zh: 為了保護設備，為了保護昂貴的設備，請勿在電腦室飲食。

words.note: 語塊：please refrain from（請勿……）、refrain from using（避免使用）、refrain from smoking（禁止吸菸）、refrain from eating（勿飲食）。refrain from 是正式的「請不要」，常見於公告；avoid 意思接近。

words.meaning: 捕捉；拍下；吸引（注意）；奪取

sentences.en: The bright colors of the advertisement are designed to capture the attention of young shoppers.
sentences.zh: 廣告鮮豔的顏色是為了吸引年輕購物者的注意。

sentences.en: The photographer used a special camera to capture the moment when the new bridge was opened.
sentences.zh: 攝影師用一台特殊相機捕捉新橋啟用的那一刻。

sentences.en: The company hopes to capture market share from its competitors by offering lower prices and faster delivery.
sentences.zh: 公司希望藉由提供更低的價格，從競爭對手那裡奪取市佔率。

sentences.en: The security cameras capture images of everyone who enters or leaves the building at night.
sentences.zh: 監視器會拍下晚上進出大樓的每一個人。

sentences.en: The opening scene of the movie was able to capture attention immediately, and critics loved it.
sentences.zh: 電影的開場一下子就吸引了注意，評論家很喜歡。

words.note: 語塊：capture attention（吸引注意）、capture the moment（捕捉瞬間）、capture market share（奪取市佔率）。capture 可以是「抓住」、「拍攝下來」或「奪得（市場）」；captive 是「被俘虜的」。

sentences.en: Please specify the date and time that you would like to receive your delivery when you place the order.
sentences.zh: 下訂單時，請指定你希望收到貨的日期和時間。

sentences.en: If you have any food allergies, please specify them on the form so that the chef can prepare a safe meal.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何食物過敏，請在表格上註明，讓主廚準備安全的餐點。

sentences.en: The contract should specify that the supplier must replace any damaged items at no extra cost.
sentences.zh: 合約應該明確說明，供應商必須免費更換任何損壞的物品。

sentences.en: When you request a meeting room, please specify the number of people who will attend.
sentences.zh: 申請會議室時，請具體說明出席的人數。

sentences.en: The client did not specify the color of the brochure, so the designer sent several options.
sentences.zh: 客戶沒有指定小冊子的顏色，所以設計師寄了幾個選項。

words.note: 語塊：specify the date（指定日期）、specify the number of（說明……的數量）、specify that（明確說明……）。specify 是「講清楚細節」；specific 是形容詞「具體的」；specification 是「規格」。

sentences.en: New employees must complete the paperwork for their health insurance during their first week at the company.
sentences.zh: 新員工必須在第一週完成健康保險的文件。

sentences.en: The new online system will reduce paperwork and allow staff to spend more time with customers.
sentences.zh: 新的線上系統會減少文書工作，讓員工有更多時間陪顧客。

sentences.en: Doctors often complain that they spend too much time on paperwork instead of treating patients.
sentences.zh: 醫生常抱怨他們花太多時間在文書工作上，而不是治療病人。

sentences.en: Please bring a copy of your passport so that we can complete the paperwork for your visa.
sentences.zh: 請帶一份護照影本，讓我們可以完成你的簽證文件。

sentences.en: Buying a house involves a lot of paperwork, so many people ask a lawyer to help them.
sentences.zh: 買房子牽涉很多文書工作，所以很多人會請律師幫忙。

words.note: 語塊：complete the paperwork（完成文件）、reduce paperwork（減少文書工作）。paperwork 是不可數名詞，指「填表、整理文件等文書作業」。

sentences.en: The team worked late every night for two weeks to accomplish its goal of launching the website on time.
sentences.zh: 團隊連續兩週每晚加班，達成了準時推出網站的目標。

sentences.en: With the right tools and training, our staff can accomplish the task in half the usual time.
sentences.zh: 有了合適的工具和訓練，我們的員工能以平常一半的時間完成任務。

sentences.en: It is easier to accomplish a goal when you divide it into smaller steps with clear deadlines.
sentences.zh: 把目標拆成有明確期限的小步驟，比較容易達成。

sentences.en: The company was able to accomplish a great deal in its first year, including opening three new stores.
sentences.zh: 公司第一年就完成了很多事，包括開了三家新店。

sentences.en: Managers should give clear instructions so that employees know exactly how to accomplish a task.
sentences.zh: 經理應該給出清楚的指示，讓員工確切知道如何完成任務。

words.note: 語塊：accomplish a goal（達成目標）、accomplish a task（完成任務）。accomplish 和 achieve 意思接近；accomplished 是形容詞「有成就的、熟練的」。

sentences.en: A recent study found that employees who take short breaks are more productive in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 最近一項研究發現，休息片刻的員工下午的工作效率更高。

sentences.en: The university will conduct a study on how air pollution affects the health of children in the city.
sentences.zh: 那所大學將進行一項研究，探討空氣污染如何影響城市兒童的健康。

sentences.en: According to a study by the tourism office, most visitors stay in the city for about three days.
sentences.zh: 根據觀光處的一項研究，大部分遊客在這座城市停留大約三天。

sentences.en: The company paid for a study to find out why customers prefer its competitor's products.
sentences.zh: 公司出錢做了一項研究，找出顧客為什麼比較喜歡競爭對手的產品。

sentences.en: The results of the study will be published in a medical journal early next year.
sentences.zh: 這項研究的結果將在明年初刊登於醫學期刊上。

words.note: 語塊：conduct a study（進行研究）、a recent study（最近的研究）、according to a study（根據一項研究）。study 當名詞是「一項研究」（可數）；research 通常不可數。

sentences.en: The company opened a new distribution center near the highway to deliver products to stores more quickly.
sentences.zh: 公司在公路附近開了一座新的物流中心，更快地把產品送到門市。

sentences.en: The distribution of the new uniforms to all employees will take place next Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 新制服將在下週一早上發放給所有員工。

sentences.en: Our distribution network now includes more than three hundred stores and online shops across the country.
sentences.zh: 我們的配銷網路現在包含全國三百多家門市。

sentences.en: The manager is responsible for the fair distribution of work among the members of her team.
sentences.zh: 經理負責在組員之間公平分配工作。

sentences.en: The publisher signed a contract with a large distribution company to sell its books in Europe.
sentences.zh: 出版社和一家大型配銷公司簽約，在歐洲販售它的書。

words.note: 語塊：distribution center（物流中心）、distribution of（……的分配）、distribution network（配銷網路）。distribution 是名詞；distribute 是動詞「分發、配銷」；distributor 是「經銷商」。

sentences.en: We look forward to working with you on the new project and hope it will be a great success.
sentences.zh: 我們期待和您合作新專案，希望它非常成功。

sentences.en: Thank you for your application, and we look forward to hearing from you about the interview date.
sentences.zh: 謝謝您的申請，我們期待您回覆面試日期。

sentences.en: Many employees look forward to the company picnic, which is held every summer at the lake.
sentences.zh: 很多員工都很期待每年夏天在湖邊舉辦的公司野餐。

sentences.en: The hotel staff look forward to welcoming you and making your stay as comfortable as possible.
sentences.zh: 飯店員工期待歡迎您，讓您的住宿盡可能舒適。

sentences.en: I look forward to meeting the new members of the team at next week's welcome lunch.
sentences.zh: 我很期待在下週的迎新午餐見到團隊的新成員。

words.note: 語塊：look forward to + 名詞／動名詞（期待……）、look forward to hearing from you（期待您的回音）。look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing（look forward to meeting you），不接原形動詞。

sentences.en: The engineers had to modify the design of the engine after several problems were found during testing.
sentences.zh: 測試中發現幾個問題後，工程師只好修改引擎的設計。

sentences.en: We may need to modify the plan if the weather is bad on the day of the outdoor event.
sentences.zh: 如果戶外活動當天天氣不好，我們可能需要調整計畫。

sentences.en: The restaurant will slightly modify its menu in the summer to include more salads and cold dishes.
sentences.zh: 餐廳夏天會稍微修改菜單，增加更多沙拉和冷盤。

sentences.en: Customers can modify their orders online up to two hours before the scheduled delivery time.
sentences.zh: 顧客最晚可以在送貨時間前兩小時在線上修改訂單。

sentences.en: The company decided to modify the plan for the new office after employees asked for more meeting rooms.
sentences.zh: 員工要求更多會議室後，公司決定調整新辦公室的規劃。

words.note: 語塊：modify the design（修改設計）、modify the plan（調整計畫）、slightly modify（稍微修改）。modify 是「做一點修改」；change 是一般的「改變」；名詞是 modification。

sentences.en: Many residents object to the plan to build a large shopping center next to the quiet park.
sentences.zh: 很多居民反對在安靜的公園旁邊蓋大型購物中心的計畫。

sentences.en: Several employees strongly object to working on weekends and holidays without receiving any extra pay from the company.
sentences.zh: 好幾位員工強烈反對週末上班卻沒有額外的薪水。

sentences.en: The union may object to the new schedule because it requires workers to start earlier in the morning.
sentences.zh: 工會可能會反對新的班表，因為它要求工人早上更早上班。

sentences.en: If you object to any part of the contract, please tell us before Friday so that we can discuss it.
sentences.zh: 如果你反對合約的任何部分，請在週五前告訴我們，讓我們討論。

sentences.en: Some customers strongly object to the new fees, so the bank is reviewing its pricing policy.
sentences.zh: 有些顧客強烈反對新的手續費，所以銀行正在檢討收費政策。

words.note: 語塊：object to + 名詞／動名詞（反對……）、strongly object to（強烈反對）。object to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing；objection 是名詞「反對」。

sentences.en: The restaurant was understaffed on Saturday night, so many customers had to wait an hour for their food.
sentences.zh: 餐廳週六晚上人手不足，所以很多顧客要等一小時才拿到餐點。

sentences.en: The hospital is seriously understaffed and is trying to hire more nurses as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 醫院嚴重缺人，正在努力盡快招募更多護士。

sentences.en: Because the office is understaffed this week, some of your requests may take longer than usual.
sentences.zh: 因為這週辦公室人手不足，你的一些請求可能會比平常花更久的時間。

sentences.en: The store has been understaffed since three employees left, so the manager has been working extra hours.
sentences.zh: 自從三名員工離職後，那家店就一直人手不足，所以店長一直在加班。

sentences.en: Schools in rural areas are often understaffed because it is difficult to attract teachers to small towns.
sentences.zh: 鄉村地區的學校常常人手不足，因為很難吸引老師到小鎮。

words.note: 語塊：be understaffed（人手不足）、seriously understaffed（嚴重缺人）。understaffed 是「員工太少」；overstaffed 是「人手過多」；shorthanded 意思接近。

sentences.en: The company plans to discontinue the old model of its tablet when the new version is released.
sentences.zh: 新版本推出時，公司打算停產舊款平板。

sentences.en: The airline will discontinue service to the small island because there are not enough passengers.
sentences.zh: 因為乘客不夠多，航空公司將停止飛往那座小島的航班。

sentences.en: If you discontinue your membership, you will no longer receive special discounts on any of our products.
sentences.zh: 如果你停止會員資格，就不再享有我們產品的折扣。

sentences.en: The store decided to discontinue the product after several customers complained about its poor quality.
sentences.zh: 好幾位顧客抱怨品質之後，店家決定停賣那項產品。

sentences.en: The magazine will discontinue its printed edition next year and will be available only online.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌明年將停止發行紙本，只在網路上提供。

words.note: 語塊：discontinue a product（停產某產品）、discontinue service（停止服務）、be discontinued（被停產）。discontinue 是「不再繼續（生產或提供）」；continue 是「繼續」。

sentences.en: Our company is committed to providing high-quality products that are safe for both people and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我們公司致力於提供對環境安全的高品質產品。

sentences.en: The new CEO said that she is fully committed to improving working conditions for all employees.
sentences.zh: 新執行長表示，她會全心投入改善所有員工的工作條件。

sentences.en: The hotel is committed to making every guest feel comfortable and welcome during their stay.
sentences.zh: 飯店致力於讓每位客人在住宿期間都感到舒適和受歡迎。

sentences.en: The city is committed to reducing traffic and air pollution by investing in public transportation.
sentences.zh: 市政府致力於投資大眾運輸，減少交通量和空氣污染。

sentences.en: All of our staff are committed to answering customer questions quickly, clearly, and politely every day.
sentences.zh: 我們所有員工都致力於快速且有禮貌地回答顧客的問題。

words.note: 語塊：be committed to（致力於……）、fully committed to（全心投入）。be committed to 後面接名詞或 V-ing（committed to providing），to 是介系詞；commitment 是名詞。

sentences.en: The company refused to disclose the price that it paid for the small software firm.
sentences.zh: 公司拒絕透露它收購那家小軟體公司的價格。

sentences.en: Employees must not disclose information about customers to anyone outside the company, including friends and family members.
sentences.zh: 員工不得向公司以外的任何人透露顧客資訊。

sentences.en: The two companies will disclose details of the agreement at a press conference next Monday.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司將在下週一的記者會上公開協議的細節。

sentences.en: The hospital cannot disclose information about patients without their written permission or a request from a court.
sentences.zh: 沒有病人的書面同意，醫院不能透露病人的資訊。

sentences.en: The director refused to disclose the names of the candidates who are being considered for the position.
sentences.zh: 總監拒絕透露正在考慮擔任該職位的候選人名字。

words.note: 語塊：disclose information（透露資訊）、refuse to disclose（拒絕透露）、disclose details（公開細節）。disclose 是「公開原本隱藏的資訊」；reveal 意思接近；名詞是 disclosure。

sentences.en: The company has no intention of closing its factory, despite the rumors in the local newspaper.
sentences.zh: 儘管地方報紙有謠言，公司無意關閉工廠。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim announced his intention to retire at the end of the year after thirty years at the bank.
sentences.zh: 金先生在銀行工作三十年後，宣布打算在年底退休。

sentences.en: She moved to the city with the intention of starting her own small design business near the university.
sentences.zh: 她搬到這座城市，打算在大學附近自己開一家小設計公司。

sentences.en: The airline announced its intention to add more flights to Asia and Australia starting next spring.
sentences.zh: 航空公司宣布打算從明年春天開始增加飛往亞洲的航班。

sentences.en: We have no intention of raising our prices this year, as we want to keep our loyal customers happy.
sentences.zh: 我們今年無意漲價，因為我們想讓忠實顧客滿意。

words.note: 語塊：have no intention of（無意……）、announce one's intention to（宣布打算……）、with the intention of（打算……）。intention 是「打算、意圖」；intend 是動詞；attention（注意）長得像。

sentences.en: Small bookstores find it difficult to compete with large online retailers that offer lower prices.
sentences.zh: 小書店發現很難和提供更低價格的大型網路零售商競爭。

sentences.en: More than two hundred applicants will compete for only five positions in the company's training program.
sentences.zh: 兩百多位應徵者將爭取公司訓練計畫中僅有的五個名額。

sentences.en: Our team will compete in the national business plan competition in Tokyo next month against twenty other universities.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊下個月將在東京參加全國商業計畫比賽。

sentences.en: To compete with the new coffee shop across the street, the café started offering free pastries in the morning.
sentences.zh: 為了和對街新開的咖啡店競爭，那家咖啡館開始在早上提供免費糕點。

sentences.en: Local farmers compete for space at the popular weekend market, which has room for only forty stalls.
sentences.zh: 當地農民爭搶熱門週末市集的位置，那裡只有四十個攤位。

words.note: 語塊：compete with（和……競爭）、compete for（爭取……）、compete in（參加……比賽）。compete 是動詞；competition 是「競爭；比賽」；competitive 是「有競爭力的」。

sentences.en: The shop on Elm Street sells secondhand books and magazines at very low prices every day of the week.
sentences.zh: Elm 街那家店以非常低的價格販售二手書和雜誌。

sentences.en: More young people are buying secondhand clothing because it is cheaper and better for the environment.
sentences.zh: 越來越多年輕人買二手衣，因為比較便宜，對環境也比較好。

sentences.en: The company saved a lot of money by purchasing secondhand furniture for its new office.
sentences.zh: 公司為新辦公室購買二手家具，省了很多錢。

sentences.en: Before you buy secondhand electronics, make sure that the seller offers some kind of warranty.
sentences.zh: 在買二手電子產品之前，要確定賣家有提供某種保固。

sentences.en: The charity collects secondhand clothing and gives it to families who need help during the winter.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體收集二手衣，在冬天送給需要幫助的家庭。

words.note: 語塊：secondhand books（二手書）、secondhand clothing（二手衣）、buy secondhand（買二手的）。secondhand 也可以寫成 second-hand；used 意思相同；brand-new 是「全新的」。

sentences.en: Our customers are willing to pay more because our products are known for their high quality.
sentences.zh: 顧客願意多付錢，因為我們的產品以高品質著稱。

sentences.en: The quality control team checks a sample of products from every shipment before it leaves the factory.
sentences.zh: 品管團隊在每批貨出廠前都會抽查樣品。

sentences.en: The new training program is designed to improve the quality of service at all of our hotels.
sentences.zh: 新的訓練計畫是為了提升我們所有飯店的服務品質。

sentences.en: Using fresh ingredients from local farms helps the restaurant maintain the high quality of its dishes.
sentences.zh: 使用在地農場的新鮮食材，幫助餐廳維持料理的高品質。

sentences.en: The manager praised the quality of the report, which was clear, detailed, and easy to read.
sentences.zh: 經理稱讚那份報告的品質，內容清楚、詳細又容易閱讀。

words.note: 語塊：high quality（高品質）、quality control（品質管理）、improve the quality of（提升……的品質）。quality 是「品質」；quantity 是「數量」，兩個字很容易搞混。

sentences.en: The sales team prepared a detailed presentation in order to impress the clients from the hotel chain.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊準備了一份詳細的簡報，想讓連鎖飯店的客戶印象深刻。

sentences.en: The new office design is sure to impress visitors with its large windows and modern furniture.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室的設計有大窗戶和現代家具，一定會讓訪客印象深刻。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee tried to impress the interviewers by explaining how she had increased sales at her previous job.
sentences.zh: 李小姐說明她在前一份工作如何提升業績，試圖讓面試官印象深刻。

sentences.en: The chef hopes to impress the food critics who will visit the restaurant on its opening night.
sentences.zh: 主廚希望讓開幕當晚來訪的美食評論家印象深刻。

sentences.en: The quality of the product did not impress the buyers, so they decided to look for another supplier.
sentences.zh: 產品品質沒有讓買家滿意，所以他們決定找別的供應商。

words.note: 語塊：impress the clients（讓客戶印象深刻）、be impressed by（對……印象深刻）、try to impress（試圖讓人印象深刻）。impress 是「讓人覺得很厲害」；impressive 是「令人印象深刻的」；impression 是名詞。

sentences.en: The company plans to cut costs by moving to a smaller office and using less paper.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫搬到比較小的辦公室並減少用紙，以削減成本。

sentences.en: The store decided to cut prices on all winter clothing in order to make room for new products.
sentences.zh: 那家店決定把所有冬季服飾降價，騰出空間放新產品。

sentences.en: Many families decide to cut back on eating out at restaurants when food prices rise quickly.
sentences.zh: 食物價格快速上漲時，很多家庭會決定減少上餐廳吃飯。

sentences.en: The government will cut taxes for small businesses that hire young workers or interns next year.
sentences.zh: 政府明年會為聘用年輕員工的小企業減稅。

sentences.en: To cut costs, the airline stopped offering free meals on flights shorter than three hours.
sentences.zh: 為了削減成本，航空公司停止在三小時以內的航班提供免費餐點。

words.note: 語塊：cut costs（削減成本）、cut prices（降價）、cut back on（減少……）。cut 的過去式和過去分詞都是 cut；cut back on 是「減少使用」。

sentences.en: The city council approved a budget appropriation of two million dollars for repairing the old bridge.
sentences.zh: 市議會核准了兩百萬美元的預算撥款，用來修理舊橋。

sentences.en: The appropriation of funds for the new library was delayed because of a disagreement among council members.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館的資金撥款因為議員之間意見不合而延後。

sentences.en: The school received a special appropriation from the government to buy new computers for its classrooms.
sentences.zh: 學校獲得政府的特別撥款，為教室購買新電腦。

sentences.en: The committee will review each budget appropriation request carefully before making a final decision in May.
sentences.zh: 委員會在做決定之前，會仔細審查每一筆預算撥款申請。

sentences.en: An investigation found that the appropriation of funds by the manager had not been approved by the board.
sentences.zh: 一項調查發現，那位經理挪用資金並沒有經過董事會的核准。

words.note: 語塊：budget appropriation（預算撥款）、appropriation of funds（資金撥款）。appropriation 是「（政府、組織）撥出一筆錢做特定用途」；也有「挪用、盜用」的意思。

sentences.en: The new advertising campaign is aimed at young people who use social media every day.
sentences.zh: 新的廣告活動是針對每天使用社群媒體的年輕人。

sentences.en: The government introduced several programs aimed at reducing unemployment among young people in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 政府推出了幾項旨在減少鄉村地區失業的計畫。

sentences.en: This workshop is aimed at small business owners who want to learn about online marketing.
sentences.zh: 這個工作坊是針對想學習網路行銷的小企業老闆。

sentences.en: The company's new policy is aimed at reducing the amount of paper used in its offices.
sentences.zh: 公司的新政策旨在減少辦公室的用紙量。

sentences.en: The magazine is aimed at readers who enjoy cooking and want to try recipes from different countries.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌是針對喜歡做菜、想嘗試各國食譜的讀者。

words.note: 語塊：be aimed at（針對……）、aimed at reducing（旨在減少）。be aimed at 後面接名詞或 V-ing；target 意思接近。

sentences.en: The government plans to reduce the budget deficit by cutting spending and raising some taxes.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫藉由削減支出和調高部分稅收來減少預算赤字。

sentences.en: The country's trade deficit grew last year because it imported more goods than it exported.
sentences.zh: 該國去年的貿易逆差擴大了，因為進口的商品比出口多。

sentences.en: The museum has operated at a deficit for three years, so it is looking for new sponsors.
sentences.zh: 博物館已經連續三年虧損，所以正在尋找新的贊助者。

sentences.en: Economists warn that a large budget deficit could cause interest rates to rise in the future.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家警告，龐大的預算赤字未來可能導致利率上升。

sentences.en: The new mayor promised to reduce the deficit without closing any public schools or libraries.
sentences.zh: 新市長承諾在不關閉任何公立學校或圖書館的情況下減少赤字。

words.note: 語塊：budget deficit（預算赤字）、trade deficit（貿易逆差）、reduce the deficit（減少赤字）。deficit 是「支出大於收入的差額」；surplus 是相反詞「盈餘」。

sentences.en: The board passed a resolution to invest in renewable energy at all of the company's factories.
sentences.zh: 董事會通過一項決議，在公司所有工廠投資再生能源。

sentences.en: The new camera takes high resolution photos that are perfect for printing large posters and signs.
sentences.zh: 新相機能拍高解析度的照片，非常適合印大型海報。

sentences.en: Both companies hope for a quick resolution of the dispute so that they can continue working together.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司都希望糾紛能盡快解決，好繼續合作。

sentences.en: The training course covers conflict resolution and other skills that are important for new managers.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程涵蓋衝突解決和其他對經理很重要的技能。

sentences.en: After hours of discussion, the members of the committee were finally able to pass a resolution.
sentences.zh: 經過幾個小時的討論，委員會成員終於通過了一項決議。

words.note: 語塊：conflict resolution（衝突解決）、pass a resolution（通過決議）、high resolution（高解析度）。resolution 可以是「解決（問題）」、「決議」，也可以指螢幕、照片的「解析度」。

sentences.en: Both companies believe that the partnership will be mutually beneficial and help them grow in new markets.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司都認為這次合作會互惠互利，幫助雙方成長。

sentences.en: The meeting will take place at a mutually agreed time and location sometime next week.
sentences.zh: 會議將在下週雙方同意的時間和地點舉行。

sentences.en: We hope to build a mutually beneficial relationship with our suppliers that lasts for many years.
sentences.zh: 我們希望和供應商建立維持多年的互惠關係。

sentences.en: The contract can be changed only if both sides have mutually agreed to the new terms in writing.
sentences.zh: 只有雙方以書面同意新條款，合約才能修改。

sentences.en: The exchange program is mutually beneficial for students, who learn new languages and cultures abroad.
sentences.zh: 交換計畫對學生來說是互惠的，他們能學習新的語言和文化。

words.note: 語塊：mutually beneficial（互惠的）、mutually agreed（雙方同意的）。mutually 是「雙方都……」；mutual 是形容詞「互相的」。

sentences.en: The two companies hope to settle the dispute without going to court, which would be expensive for both.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司希望不上法院就解決糾紛，因為打官司對雙方都很花錢。

sentences.en: Guests can settle the bill at the front desk or pay online before they check out of the hotel.
sentences.zh: 客人可以在櫃台結帳，或在退房前上網付款。

sentences.en: It usually takes new employees a few weeks to settle in and learn how everything works in the office.
sentences.zh: 新員工通常需要幾週才能安頓下來，了解辦公室的運作方式。

sentences.en: Please settle your account by the end of the month to avoid paying a late fee.
sentences.zh: 請在月底前結清帳款，以免支付滯納金。

sentences.en: The manager met with both employees to settle the disagreement about who would lead the project.
sentences.zh: 經理和兩位員工見面，解決誰來帶領專案的意見分歧。

words.note: 語塊：settle a dispute（解決糾紛）、settle the bill（結帳）、settle in（安頓下來）。settle 可以是「解決（糾紛）」、「付清（帳單）」或「安頓、定居」；settlement 是名詞「和解；定居地」。

sentences.en: There are only ten remaining seats for the concert, so please book your tickets as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 演唱會只剩十個座位，所以請盡快訂票。

sentences.en: Customers must pay a deposit of twenty percent and pay the remaining balance when the furniture is delivered.
sentences.zh: 顧客必須先付兩成訂金，家具送到時再付剩餘的款項。

sentences.en: All remaining items from the summer collection will be sold at half price starting this weekend.
sentences.zh: 夏季系列剩下的所有商品從這個週末開始半價出售。

sentences.en: The remaining members of the team will finish the project after Ms. Lee leaves the company.
sentences.zh: 李小姐離開公司後，團隊其餘成員會完成這個專案。

sentences.en: Please return the remaining copies of the brochure to the marketing department after the trade show.
sentences.zh: 商展結束後，請把剩下的小冊子交回行銷部。

words.note: 語塊：remaining seats（剩餘座位）、the remaining balance（剩餘餘額）、remaining items（剩下的品項）。remaining 是「剩下的」；remainder 是名詞「剩餘部分」。

sentences.en: At the beginning of the year, each manager must set a goal for his or her department and share it with the team.
sentences.zh: 每年年初，每位經理都必須為部門設定目標，並和團隊分享。

sentences.en: The two companies will meet next week to set a date for signing the final contract.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司下週會見面，訂出簽署正式合約的日期。

sentences.en: The technician will set up the projector in the conference room before the meeting begins at nine.
sentences.zh: 技師會在九點開會前，在會議室架好投影機。

sentences.en: It is important to set a goal that is challenging but realistic for new employees.
sentences.zh: 為新員工設定有挑戰性但實際的目標很重要。

sentences.en: The company plans to set up a new office in Singapore to manage its business in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在新加坡設立新辦公室，管理東南亞的業務。

words.note: 語塊：set a goal（設定目標）、set a date（訂日期）、set up（設立）。set 的過去式和過去分詞都是 set；set up 是「設立、架設」。

sentences.en: Engineers are working to identify the problem that caused the factory's machines to stop suddenly.
sentences.zh: 工程師正在努力找出造成工廠機器突然停止的問題。

sentences.en: The investigation will try to identify the cause of the fire that damaged the warehouse last week.
sentences.zh: 調查將設法找出上週損壞倉庫那場火災的原因。

sentences.en: Please identify yourself to the security guard when you arrive at the building after business hours.
sentences.zh: 下班時間抵達大樓時，請向保全表明身分。

sentences.en: The survey helped us identify the products that customers want to buy most during the holidays.
sentences.zh: 調查幫助我們找出顧客在節慶期間最想買的產品。

sentences.en: It took the IT team several hours to identify the problem with the company's email system.
sentences.zh: 資訊團隊花了好幾個小時才找出公司電子郵件系統的問題。

words.note: 語塊：identify the problem（找出問題）、identify the cause（找出原因）、identify oneself（表明身分）。identify 是「認出、找出」；identity 是名詞「身分」；identification 是「身分證明」。

sentences.en: The new system will eliminate the need for paper forms, saving the company a lot of money each year.
sentences.zh: 新系統將不再需要紙本表格，每年替公司省下很多錢。

sentences.en: The factory has introduced several changes to eliminate waste and reduce the cost of production.
sentences.zh: 工廠推行了幾項改變，以消除浪費並降低生產成本。

sentences.en: The new rules will eliminate the need for drivers to show their tickets when they leave the parking garage.
sentences.zh: 新規定讓駕駛離開停車場時不再需要出示票卡。

sentences.en: Using online payments will eliminate the need for customers to wait in line at the cashier.
sentences.zh: 使用線上付款將讓顧客不再需要在收銀台排隊。

sentences.en: The new design will eliminate most of the noise that the old machine made while it was running.
sentences.zh: 新設計將消除舊機器運轉時發出的大部分噪音。

words.note: 語塊：eliminate waste（消除浪費）、eliminate the need for（不再需要……）。eliminate 是「完全去除」；reduce 是「減少」；elimination 是名詞。

sentences.en: The bank announced that it will raise the interest rate on home loans starting next month.
sentences.zh: 銀行宣布從下個月起調高房貸利率。

sentences.en: Travelers should check the exchange rate before they change money at the airport or a local bank.
sentences.zh: 旅客在機場換錢之前，應該先查一下匯率。

sentences.en: The company is growing at a rate of about fifteen percent every year, which is faster than its competitors.
sentences.zh: 公司以每年大約百分之十五的速度成長，比競爭對手還快。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a special rate for guests who stay for more than five nights during the winter.
sentences.zh: 飯店為冬天住五晚以上的客人提供特別優惠價。

sentences.en: The unemployment rate in the region has fallen since the new factory opened two years ago.
sentences.zh: 自從新工廠兩年前開工後，那個地區的失業率下降了。

words.note: 語塊：interest rate（利率）、exchange rate（匯率）、at a rate of（以……的速度）。rate 可以是「比率」、「費用」或「速度」；rating 是「評分」。

sentences.en: The opening of the new store will coincide with the start of the summer sale in June.
sentences.zh: 新店開幕剛好碰上六月夏季特賣的開始。

sentences.en: The conference was planned to coincide with the city's annual film festival so that visitors could enjoy both.
sentences.zh: 研討會被安排和城市年度影展同時舉行，讓訪客兩個都能參加。

sentences.en: The release of the new phone will coincide with the holiday season, when sales are usually highest.
sentences.zh: 新手機的上市會和節慶季同時，那時銷售通常最高。

sentences.en: The increase in sales seems to coincide with the start of our new television advertising campaign.
sentences.zh: 銷售增加似乎剛好和我們新的電視廣告活動開始的時間一致。

sentences.en: My vacation will coincide with the trade show, so Ms. Wu will attend the event in my place.
sentences.zh: 我的假期剛好碰上商展，所以吳小姐會代替我參加活動。

words.note: 語塊：coincide with（和……同時發生）。coincide with 是「時間剛好重疊」；coincidence 是名詞「巧合」。

sentences.en: Employees who are ill can take up to ten days of paid sick leave each year.
sentences.zh: 生病的員工每年最多可以請十天有薪病假。

sentences.en: Ms. Rossi will be on maternity leave for six months starting in March, so Mr. Kim will handle her clients.
sentences.zh: Rossi 小姐從三月開始休六個月產假，所以金先生會負責她的客戶。

sentences.en: The manager is on leave this week, so please send any urgent questions to his assistant.
sentences.zh: 經理這週休假，所以有任何緊急問題請寄給他的助理。

sentences.en: Please submit your request for annual leave at least two weeks before the dates you plan to be away.
sentences.zh: 請在預計休假日期的至少兩週前提出年假申請。

sentences.en: The company recently increased the length of paid maternity leave from three months to six months.
sentences.zh: 公司最近把有薪產假從三個月延長到六個月。

words.note: 語塊：sick leave（病假）、maternity leave（產假）、on leave（休假中）。leave 當名詞是「休假」；holiday、vacation 也是「假期」，但 leave 常指「請假」。

sentences.en: Applicants should include a letter of reference from a previous employer with their online application.
sentences.zh: 應徵者應在申請資料中附上前雇主的推薦信。

sentences.en: Please keep a copy of this receipt for future reference in case you need to return the item.
sentences.zh: 請保留這張收據的副本供日後參考，以防你需要退貨。

sentences.en: The speaker made reference to several recent studies about the benefits of working from home.
sentences.zh: 講者提到了幾項關於在家工作好處的最新研究。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant agreed to be a reference for her former assistant, who is applying for a job at a bank.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐同意當她前助理的推薦人，那位助理正在應徵銀行的工作。

sentences.en: Save the instruction manual for future reference, as it explains how to clean and repair the machine.
sentences.zh: 請保留使用手冊供日後參考，裡面說明了如何清潔和修理機器。

words.note: 語塊：letter of reference（推薦信）、for future reference（供日後參考）、make reference to（提到）。reference 可以指「推薦人、推薦信」，也可以是「參考」；refer 是動詞。

sentences.en: Good communication plays a crucial role in the success of any team, especially when people work remotely.
sentences.zh: 良好的溝通對任何團隊的成功都扮演關鍵角色，尤其是遠距工作的時候。

sentences.en: Customer feedback is crucial to improving our products and making sure that people continue to buy them.
sentences.zh: 顧客意見對改善我們的產品、確保大家持續購買至關重要。

sentences.en: The board will make a crucial decision next week about whether to open a factory in South America.
sentences.zh: 董事會下週將對是否在南美設廠做出重大決定。

sentences.en: It is crucial to back up your files regularly so that you do not lose important work.
sentences.zh: 定期備份檔案非常重要，這樣才不會遺失重要的工作。

sentences.en: Volunteers played a crucial role in organizing the city marathon, which attracted more than ten thousand runners.
sentences.zh: 志工在籌辦城市馬拉松中扮演了關鍵角色，那場比賽吸引了一萬多名跑者。

words.note: 語塊：crucial role（關鍵角色）、crucial to（對……至關重要）、crucial decision（重大決定）。crucial 比 important 更強烈，表示「非常關鍵」；essential、vital 意思接近。

sentences.en: Many rare birds inhabit the wetlands near the river, so the area is protected by law.
sentences.zh: 很多稀有鳥類棲息在河邊的濕地，所以那個地區受法律保護。

sentences.en: Only a few fishing families continued to inhabit the island until the new bridge was built in 2010.
sentences.zh: 在 2010 年新橋建好之前，只有幾戶漁家繼續住在那座島上。

sentences.en: Scientists are studying the animals that inhabit the forest to understand how climate change affects them.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究棲息在森林裡的動物，了解氣候變遷如何影響牠們。

sentences.en: More than two million people inhabit the city, which has grown quickly over the past twenty years.
sentences.zh: 這座城市有兩百多萬人居住，過去二十年快速成長。

sentences.en: The park's guides will explain which kinds of fish inhabit the lake and how visitors can help protect them.
sentences.zh: 公園導覽員會說明湖裡住著哪些魚，以及遊客可以怎麼幫忙保護牠們。

words.note: 語塊：inhabit an area（居住在某地區）、inhabit the island（住在島上）、inhabit the forest（棲息在森林）、inhabit the city（住在城市）。inhabit 是及物動詞，後面直接接地點（inhabit the forest）；inhabitant 是「居民」。

sentences.en: The new factory must follow strict rules to protect the ecosystem of the nearby river and forest.
sentences.zh: 新工廠必須遵守嚴格規定，保護附近河川和森林的生態系統。

sentences.en: Plastic waste can seriously damage the local ecosystem, so the town has banned plastic bags.
sentences.zh: 塑膠垃圾可能嚴重破壞當地的生態系，所以小鎮禁止使用塑膠袋。

sentences.en: Visitors are asked to stay on the paths because the mountain has a fragile ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 遊客被要求待在步道上，因為那座山的生態系很脆弱。

sentences.en: The company has built an ecosystem of apps and devices that work smoothly together for its customers.
sentences.zh: 那家公司建立了一個彼此能順暢配合的 App 和裝置體系。

sentences.en: Scientists warn that warmer ocean temperatures could destroy the fragile ecosystem of the coral reef.
sentences.zh: 科學家警告，海水溫度升高可能會摧毀珊瑚礁脆弱的生態系。

words.note: 語塊：protect the ecosystem（保護生態系統）、local ecosystem（當地生態系）、fragile ecosystem（脆弱的生態系）。ecosystem 原指自然的「生態系」，商業上也比喻「產品與服務構成的體系」。

sentences.en: We will dispatch your order within twenty-four hours, and you will receive a tracking number by email.
sentences.zh: 我們會在二十四小時內出貨，您會收到電子郵件寄來的追蹤號碼。

sentences.en: The company will dispatch a technician to your home to repair the air conditioner tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 公司明天早上會派技師到你家修冷氣。

sentences.en: Our warehouse staff will dispatch an order on the same day if it is placed before two o'clock.
sentences.zh: 如果在兩點前下單，倉庫員工會在當天出貨。

sentences.en: The city decided to dispatch extra buses to the stadium because thousands of fans are expected at the game.
sentences.zh: 市政府決定加派公車到體育場，因為預計會有數千名球迷觀賽。

sentences.en: The hotel will dispatch a car to pick you up at the airport if you send us your flight details.
sentences.zh: 如果你把航班資訊寄給我們，飯店會派車到機場接你。

words.note: 語塊：dispatch an order（出貨）、dispatch a technician（派技師）、dispatch extra buses（加派公車）。dispatch 比 send 正式，常用在「出貨」或「派人」；名詞 dispatch 是「發送」。

sentences.en: If you encounter problems while using the software, please contact our technical support team by phone or email.
sentences.zh: 使用軟體時如果遇到問題，請聯絡我們的技術支援團隊。

sentences.en: Many small businesses encounter difficulties when they try to get loans from large banks in the city.
sentences.zh: 很多小企業在向大銀行貸款時都會遇到困難。

sentences.en: Travelers may encounter delays at the airport this weekend because of the heavy snow in the north.
sentences.zh: 因為大雪，旅客這個週末在機場可能會遇到延誤。

sentences.en: New employees often encounter difficulties during their first month, so we assign each one a mentor.
sentences.zh: 新員工在第一個月常會遇到困難，所以我們為每個人安排一位導師。

sentences.en: The engineers did not expect to encounter problems with the bridge, but they found cracks in the concrete.
sentences.zh: 工程師沒料到橋會出問題，但他們在混凝土上發現了裂縫。

words.note: 語塊：encounter problems（遇到問題）、encounter difficulties（遇到困難）、encounter delays（遇到延誤）。encounter 比 meet、face 正式，常用在「遇到問題」；當名詞是「相遇」。

sentences.en: The position will involve traveling to Asia several times a year to meet with suppliers.
sentences.zh: 這個職位需要一年出差到亞洲好幾次和供應商見面。

sentences.en: The manager tries to involve every member of the team in important decisions about the project.
sentences.zh: 經理努力讓每位組員都參與專案的重要決策。

sentences.en: The renovation will involve replacing all of the windows and painting the walls of the building.
sentences.zh: 翻修工程包括更換大樓所有的窗戶並粉刷牆面。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen's new role will involve managing several large projects for clients in Japan and Korea.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐的新職務將包括管理日本和韓國客戶的好幾個大型專案。

sentences.en: The new job does not involve much travel, so it is a good choice for people with young children.
sentences.zh: 這份新工作不太需要出差，所以對有小孩的人來說是好選擇。

words.note: 語塊：involve sb in（讓某人參與）、be involved in（參與……）、involve traveling（需要出差）。involve 是「牽涉、包含」；be involved in 是「參與其中」；involvement 是名詞。

sentences.en: It usually takes new employees a few weeks to adapt to the fast pace of work in our office.
sentences.zh: 新員工通常需要幾週才能適應我們辦公室的快速工作步調。

sentences.en: Companies must adapt to changes in the market if they want to continue to grow.
sentences.zh: 公司如果想持續成長，就必須適應市場的變化。

sentences.en: The popular novel will be adapted for television, and the director plans to adapt it into a ten-part series.
sentences.zh: 那本熱門小說將被改編成電視劇，導演打算把它改編成十集的影集。

sentences.en: The restaurant had to adapt its menu for customers who prefer vegetarian and healthy dishes.
sentences.zh: 餐廳只好為偏好素食和健康料理的顧客調整菜單。

sentences.en: Our trainers help staff adapt to the new software by offering short lessons every morning.
sentences.zh: 我們的訓練人員每天早上提供簡短的課程，幫助員工適應新軟體。

words.note: 語塊：adapt to（適應……）、adapt for（為……改編）、be adapted from（改編自）。adapt 是「適應、改編」；adopt 是「採用、收養」，只差一個字母，意思不同。

sentences.en: Please open the attachment to see the full schedule for next week's conference in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 請打開附件查看下週首爾研討會的完整行程。

sentences.en: I will send the contract as an attachment so that you can review it before our meeting.
sentences.zh: 我會把合約當附件寄出，讓你在我們開會前先看。

sentences.en: For security reasons, do not open an email attachment from someone that you do not know.
sentences.zh: 為了安全起見，不要打開陌生人寄來的電子郵件附件。

sentences.en: The vacuum cleaner comes with a special attachment for cleaning sofas, curtains, and car seats.
sentences.zh: 那台吸塵器附有一個專門清潔沙發和汽車座椅的配件。

sentences.en: Please check that the attachment is not too large before you send it to the client by email.
sentences.zh: 用電子郵件寄給客戶前，請確認附件不會太大。

words.note: 語塊：open the attachment（打開附件）、send as an attachment（以附件寄出）、email attachment（電子郵件附件）。attachment 是電子郵件的「附件」；attach 是動詞「附加」。

sentences.en: Many of the old factories in the area no longer exist and have been replaced by apartment buildings.
sentences.zh: 這一帶很多舊工廠已經不存在了，被公寓大樓取代。

sentences.en: Problems with the old software still exist, so the IT team is planning to install a new system.
sentences.zh: 舊軟體的問題仍然存在，所以資訊團隊打算安裝新系統。

sentences.en: The company that made this camera does not exist anymore, so it is difficult to find spare parts.
sentences.zh: 製造這台相機的公司已經不存在了，所以很難找到備用零件。

sentences.en: Small family-owned shops still exist in the old part of the city, where they sell traditional food.
sentences.zh: 老城區仍有家族經營的小店，在那裡賣傳統食物。

sentences.en: Opportunities for growth exist in many developing countries, especially in the technology and energy sectors.
sentences.zh: 很多開發中國家都存在成長機會，尤其是在科技業。

words.note: 語塊：still exist（仍然存在）、no longer exist（已不存在）。exist 是不及物動詞；existing 是形容詞「現有的」；existence 是名詞「存在」。

sentences.en: Many businesses closed during the economic depression, and thousands of people in the region lost their jobs.
sentences.zh: 經濟蕭條期間，很多公司倒閉，數千人失業。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibit shows how families lived during the Great Depression in the 1930s.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽展示了 1930 年代經濟大恐慌時期家庭的生活樣貌。

sentences.en: A tropical depression is expected to bring heavy rain to the southern coast this weekend.
sentences.zh: 一個熱帶性低氣壓預計這個週末會為南部海岸帶來大雨。

sentences.en: The company offers free counseling for employees who are dealing with stress or depression at work or at home.
sentences.zh: 公司為正在面對壓力或憂鬱的員工提供免費諮商。

sentences.en: Economists do not expect another economic depression, but they warn that growth may slow next year.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家不認為會再出現經濟蕭條，但警告明年成長可能放緩。

words.note: 語塊：economic depression（經濟蕭條）、the Great Depression（經濟大恐慌）、tropical depression（熱帶性低氣壓）。depression 可以是經濟「蕭條」、心理「憂鬱」，或天氣「低氣壓」；recession 是程度較輕的「衰退」。

sentences.en: The new devices can transmit data to the main computer every few seconds without using any cables.
sentences.zh: 新裝置每隔幾秒就能把資料傳輸到主電腦，不需要任何線路。

sentences.en: Please do not transmit confidential information by email unless the file is protected with a password.
sentences.zh: 除非檔案有密碼保護，否則請不要用電子郵件傳送機密資訊。

sentences.en: The satellite will transmit a signal back to Earth so that scientists can track its position.
sentences.zh: 衛星會把訊號傳回地球，讓科學家追蹤它的位置。

sentences.en: Hospitals use secure systems to transmit information about patients between different departments and other hospitals in the area.
sentences.zh: 醫院使用安全的系統在不同科別之間傳遞病人資訊。

sentences.en: Washing your hands often is one of the best ways to avoid helping to transmit illness to others.
sentences.zh: 常洗手是避免把疾病傳染給別人最好的方法之一。

words.note: 語塊：transmit data（傳輸資料）、transmit information（傳遞資訊）、transmit a signal（發送訊號）。transmit 是「傳送（訊號、資料、疾病）」；名詞是 transmission。

sentences.en: Guests are advised to keep valuables in the safe in their rooms rather than leaving them on the desk.
sentences.zh: 建議客人把貴重物品放在房間的保險箱裡，而不是放在桌上。

sentences.en: Please do not leave valuables in your car when you park in the public parking lot downtown.
sentences.zh: 把車停在市中心的公共停車場時，請不要把貴重物品留在車上。

sentences.en: The museum has lockers near the entrance where visitors can store valuables while they look at the exhibits.
sentences.zh: 博物館入口附近有置物櫃，參觀者看展時可以存放貴重物品。

sentences.en: The hotel is not responsible for any valuables that are lost or stolen from guest rooms.
sentences.zh: 飯店對客房內遺失或被竊的任何貴重物品概不負責。

sentences.en: Before the renovation begins, residents should remove all valuables from their apartments or store them in a safe place.
sentences.zh: 翻修開始前，住戶應該把所有貴重物品從公寓裡搬走。

words.note: 語塊：keep valuables（保管貴重物品）、leave valuables（留下貴重物品）、store valuables（存放貴重物品）。valuables 一定用複數，指「珠寶、現金等貴重物品」；valuable 是形容詞「貴重的」。

sentences.en: This special cover will protect your laptop from water and dust when you work outdoors.
sentences.zh: 這個特殊保護套可以在你戶外工作時，保護筆電不受水和灰塵影響。

sentences.en: The company uses recycled materials in its packaging to protect the environment and reduce waste.
sentences.zh: 公司在包裝上使用回收材料，保護環境並減少浪費。

sentences.en: We take several steps to protect privacy, such as storing all customer data on secure servers.
sentences.zh: 我們採取幾項措施保護隱私，例如把所有顧客資料存在安全的伺服器上。

sentences.en: Workers must wear gloves to protect their hands from the chemicals used in the cleaning process.
sentences.zh: 工人必須戴手套，保護雙手不受清潔過程使用的化學品傷害。

sentences.en: New laws have been introduced to protect the environment around the lake from pollution caused by nearby factories.
sentences.zh: 政府推出新法律，保護湖泊周遭的環境不受污染。

words.note: 語塊：protect sth from（保護……免於）、protect the environment（保護環境）、protect privacy（保護隱私）。protect A from B 是「保護 A 不受 B 傷害」；prevent 是「防止（發生）」。

sentences.en: Either company can terminate the contract by giving written notice at least sixty days in advance.
sentences.zh: 任何一方公司只要提前至少六十天書面通知，就可以終止合約。

sentences.en: The landlord has the right to terminate the agreement if the tenant does not pay the rent for two months.
sentences.zh: 如果房客兩個月沒付房租，房東有權終止協議。

sentences.en: The company may terminate employment if a worker repeatedly breaks the safety rules in the factory.
sentences.zh: 如果工人一再違反工廠的安全規定，公司可以解僱他。

sentences.en: We decided to terminate the contract with the cleaning company because the service was poor.
sentences.zh: 我們決定終止和清潔公司的合約，因為服務很差。

sentences.en: Customers who wish to terminate their membership should contact the front desk or send us an email.
sentences.zh: 想終止會員資格的顧客，請聯絡櫃台或寄電子郵件給我們。

words.note: 語塊：terminate a contract（終止合約）、terminate an agreement（終止協議）、terminate employment（解僱）。terminate 比 end 正式，常用在合約、合作關係；terminal 是「航廈；終點站」。

sentences.en: The meeting was hastily arranged after the company received news that its main supplier had closed.
sentences.zh: 公司得知主要供應商倒閉後，匆忙安排了這次會議。

sentences.en: The report was hastily written and contained many errors, so the manager asked for a new version.
sentences.zh: 那份報告寫得很匆忙，錯誤很多，所以經理要求重寫。

sentences.en: It is important not to act hastily when making decisions that affect the entire company.
sentences.zh: 在做影響全公司的決定時，不要草率行事很重要。

sentences.en: The hastily arranged press conference took place in the hotel lobby because no rooms were available.
sentences.zh: 那場匆忙安排的記者會在飯店大廳舉行，因為沒有空的房間。

sentences.en: The director warned the board not to act hastily and to wait for the results of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 總監警告董事會不要草率行事，要等調查結果出來。

words.note: 語塊：hastily arranged（匆忙安排的）、hastily written（匆忙寫成的）、act hastily（草率行事）。hastily 是「匆忙、沒想清楚」；quickly 只是「快」，hastily 常帶「太倉促」的意思。

sentences.en: Please verify all of the information on the form before you submit your application online.
sentences.zh: 在線上提交申請之前，請核對表格上的所有資訊。

sentences.en: For security reasons, the bank will ask you several questions to verify your identity over the phone.
sentences.zh: 為了安全，銀行會在電話中問你幾個問題來驗證你的身分。

sentences.en: The accountant will verify that all of the receipts match the expenses listed in the report.
sentences.zh: 會計師會確認所有收據都和報告中列出的支出相符。

sentences.en: Before publishing the article, the editor called several experts to verify the information it contained.
sentences.zh: 文章刊出前，編輯打電話給幾位專家核實其中的資訊。

sentences.en: Customers must verify their email address by clicking the link that we send after they sign up.
sentences.zh: 顧客註冊後必須點擊我們寄出的連結，驗證電子郵件地址。

words.note: 語塊：verify information（核實資訊）、verify one's identity（驗證身分）、verify that（確認……）。verify 是「確認是不是真的」；confirm 意思接近；verification 是名詞。

sentences.en: The new menu is designed to be appealing to families with young children as well as to students.
sentences.zh: 新菜單的設計是要吸引有幼童的家庭和學生。

sentences.en: The website should be visually appealing and easy to use so that customers stay longer.
sentences.zh: 網站應該在視覺上吸引人又容易使用，讓顧客停留更久。

sentences.en: The job offered an appealing salary, but Ms. Ward decided to stay at her current company.
sentences.zh: 那份工作提供誘人的薪水，但 Ward 小姐決定留在現在的公司。

sentences.en: Free delivery and a two-year warranty make the offer especially appealing to online shoppers who live outside the city.
sentences.zh: 免運費和兩年保固讓這個方案對網購族特別有吸引力。

sentences.en: The designer chose bright colors to make the packaging more appealing to young customers in their twenties.
sentences.zh: 設計師選了鮮豔的顏色，讓包裝對年輕顧客更有吸引力。

words.note: 語塊：appealing to（吸引……的）、visually appealing（外觀吸引人的）、an appealing offer（誘人的方案）。appealing 是「有吸引力的」；attractive 意思接近；appeal 當動詞是「吸引；上訴」。

sentences.en: The company is moving its headquarters to a new building in the downtown area next spring.
sentences.zh: 公司明年春天要把總部搬到市中心區的一棟新大樓。

sentences.en: Many people take the subway to go downtown because parking there is difficult and very expensive.
sentences.zh: 很多人搭捷運去市中心，因為停車又難又貴。

sentences.en: The hotel is located in downtown Chicago, within walking distance of several museums and theaters.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店位於芝加哥市中心，走路就能到好幾間博物館和劇院。

sentences.en: Traffic in the downtown area is heavy during rush hour, so please leave early for your appointment.
sentences.zh: 尖峰時段市中心區的交通很擁擠，所以請提早出門赴約。

sentences.en: The city plans to build more bicycle lanes downtown to reduce the number of cars on the roads.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫在市中心增建自行車道，以減少路上的車輛。

words.note: 語塊：in downtown（在市中心）、downtown area（市中心區）、go downtown（去市中心）。downtown 可當名詞、形容詞或副詞（go downtown）；city center 是英式說法。

sentences.en: The old clock tower is a famous landmark that appears on many postcards of the city.
sentences.zh: 那座舊鐘樓是著名的地標，出現在很多城市的明信片上。

sentences.en: Our tour includes a visit to a historic landmark in the old town, as well as lunch at a traditional restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我們的行程包括參觀老城區的一個歷史地標，還有在傳統餐廳吃午餐。

sentences.en: The new bridge has quickly become a landmark, and many tourists stop to take photos of it at night.
sentences.zh: 新橋很快就成了地標，很多觀光客晚上會停下來拍照。

sentences.en: The court's landmark decision will change the way companies protect the personal information of customers.
sentences.zh: 法院這項里程碑式的判決將改變企業保護顧客個資的方式。

sentences.en: Please meet the tour group in front of the famous landmark at the center of the old town at nine.
sentences.zh: 請九點在老城區中心那個著名地標前和旅行團集合。

words.note: 語塊：famous landmark（著名地標）、historic landmark（歷史地標）、a landmark decision（里程碑式的決定）。landmark 是「讓人一眼認出的建築或地點」，也可以比喻「重要的里程碑」。

sentences.en: The hotel offers free internet access as well as a free breakfast for all guests who book online.
sentences.zh: 飯店為所有網路訂房的客人提供免費網路以及免費早餐。

sentences.en: The new manager speaks English and Japanese as well as Korean, which is useful for our clients in Asia.
sentences.zh: 新經理會說英文、日文以及韓文，對我們亞洲的客戶很有幫助。

sentences.en: The course covers basic accounting as well as marketing and other skills needed to run a small business.
sentences.zh: 這門課涵蓋基礎會計，以及經營小企業需要的行銷等技能。

sentences.en: The museum displays modern paintings as well as traditional crafts made by artists from the region.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出現代畫作，以及該地區藝術家製作的傳統工藝品。

sentences.en: Employees will receive a bonus as well as an extra day of vacation if the team reaches its sales goal.
sentences.zh: 如果團隊達成業績目標，員工將獲得獎金以及額外一天的假期。

words.note: 語塊：A as well as B（A 以及 B）。A as well as B 重點在 A；當主詞時動詞跟著 A（The manager, as well as the staff, is…）。

sentences.en: Mr. Huang studied for two years before he passed the civil service exam and started working for the city.
sentences.zh: 黃先生準備了兩年才考上公務員考試，開始在市政府工作。

sentences.en: Many young people want to join the civil service because the jobs are stable and offer good benefits.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕人想當公務員，因為工作穩定、福利又好。

sentences.en: Ms. Ortiz worked in the civil service for twenty years before she started her own consulting company.
sentences.zh: Ortiz 小姐在公部門工作二十年後，自己開了一家顧問公司。

sentences.en: The civil service exam is held twice a year, and thousands of people take it in every major city.
sentences.zh: 公務員考試一年舉辦兩次，每個大城市都有數千人應考。

sentences.en: The government plans to make the civil service more efficient by moving many services online.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫把許多服務移到網路上，讓公務體系更有效率。

words.note: 語塊：civil service exam（公務員考試）、join the civil service（成為公務員）、work in the civil service（在公部門工作）。civil service 指政府機關的「公務員體系」；civil servant 是「公務員（人）」。

sentences.en: The judges praised the originality of the design, which used recycled materials in a creative way.
sentences.zh: 評審稱讚這個設計的獨創性，它以很有創意的方式使用回收材料。

sentences.en: Students who show originality in their projects will receive extra points from the teacher at the end of the term.
sentences.zh: 在作品中展現創意的學生會從老師那裡得到額外加分。

sentences.en: Critics said that the new movie lacks originality because the story is very similar to an older film.
sentences.zh: 評論家說新電影缺乏創意，因為故事和一部舊片非常相似。

sentences.en: The advertising agency is known for the originality of its campaigns, which often go viral online.
sentences.zh: 那家廣告公司以廣告活動的獨創性聞名，常常在網路上爆紅。

sentences.en: Our company values originality, so we encourage employees to share new ideas at every meeting.
sentences.zh: 我們公司重視創意，所以鼓勵員工在每次會議上分享新點子。

words.note: 語塊：show originality（展現創意）、lack originality（缺乏創意）、the originality of（……的獨創性）。originality 是名詞「原創性」；original 是形容詞「原創的；原本的」；origin 是「起源」。

sentences.en: The village is famous for its traditional handicraft, especially baskets and bowls made from bamboo.
sentences.zh: 那個村莊以傳統手工藝聞名，尤其是竹子做的籃子和碗。

sentences.en: The handicraft market opens every Saturday morning in the square in front of the old train station.
sentences.zh: 手工藝市集每週六早上在舊火車站前的廣場開放。

sentences.en: Local artists sell handicraft items such as jewelry, pottery, and wooden toys at the summer festival.
sentences.zh: 在地藝術家在夏季慶典上販售珠寶、陶器和木製玩具等手工藝品。

sentences.en: The government provides training to help young people learn traditional handicraft skills from older artists.
sentences.zh: 政府提供訓練，幫助年輕人向年長的藝術家學習傳統手工藝技能。

sentences.en: Tourists often buy handicraft goods as gifts because they are unique and made by local people.
sentences.zh: 遊客常買手工藝品當禮物，因為它們很獨特，又是當地人做的。

words.note: 語塊：traditional handicraft（傳統手工藝）、sell handicraft（販售手工藝品）、handicraft market（手工藝市集）。handicraft 也常用複數 handicrafts；handmade 是形容詞「手工的」。

sentences.en: Please pay attention to the safety instructions before you begin using the machines in the workshop.
sentences.zh: 開始使用工作坊的機器之前，請注意安全說明。

sentences.en: The new advertisement has attracted a lot of attention on social media since it was released last week.
sentences.zh: 新廣告上週推出以來，在社群媒體上吸引了很多關注。

sentences.en: Drivers should pay attention to the new traffic signs that have been installed near the school.
sentences.zh: 駕駛應該注意學校附近新設置的交通標誌。

sentences.en: The colorful window display is designed to attract attention from people walking along the busy street.
sentences.zh: 色彩繽紛的櫥窗展示是為了吸引熱鬧街上行人的注意。

sentences.en: Please mark the envelope "for the attention of" the human resources manager so that it is delivered quickly.
sentences.zh: 請在信封上註明「交給人資經理收」，讓它能快速送達。

words.note: 語塊：pay attention to（注意……）、attract attention（吸引注意）、for the attention of（交給……收）。pay attention to 的 to 是介系詞；attentive 是「專注的、體貼的」；intention（意圖）長得像。

sentences.en: Our technical support team works twenty-four hours a day to resolve problems as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 我們的技術支援團隊二十四小時工作，盡快解決問題。

sentences.en: The two companies hired a lawyer to help them resolve a dispute about the price of the land.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司請了一位律師，幫他們解決土地價格的糾紛。

sentences.en: The manager met with the customer in person to resolve an issue with the delivery of her furniture.
sentences.zh: 經理親自和顧客見面，解決她家具送貨的問題。

sentences.en: If we cannot resolve the issue by phone, a technician will visit your home on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 如果我們無法在電話中解決問題，技師會在週一早上到你家。

sentences.en: The city council hopes to resolve the problem of traffic jams by building a new road around the city.
sentences.zh: 市議會希望在城市周圍蓋一條新路，解決塞車問題。

words.note: 語塊：resolve a problem（解決問題）、resolve a dispute（解決糾紛）、resolve an issue（解決問題）。resolve 比 solve 正式；名詞是 resolution；resolve to do 是「下定決心做」。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz was chosen to head a team of designers who will create the company's new website.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐被選為帶領一個設計師團隊，負責打造公司的新網站。

sentences.en: After the meeting ends, we will head for the airport to catch our flight to Singapore.
sentences.zh: 會議結束後，我們會前往機場搭飛往新加坡的班機。

sentences.en: Mr. Lee will head the marketing department after the current director retires at the end of June.
sentences.zh: 六月現任總監退休後，李先生將主管行銷部。

sentences.en: Many families head for the beach during the summer holiday, so the roads are often very busy.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭在暑假期間前往海邊，所以道路常常很塞。

sentences.en: The company hired an experienced engineer to head the new research center that it opened in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位資深工程師帶領首爾的新研究中心。

words.note: 語塊：head a team（帶領團隊）、head for（前往）、head the department（主管部門）。head 當動詞可以是「領導」或「前往」；head office 是「總公司」。

sentences.en: Working in an emergency room can be a stressful job, so hospitals offer support to their staff.
sentences.zh: 在急診室工作可能壓力很大，所以醫院會為員工提供支持。

sentences.en: Many people find moving to a new city stressful, especially when they do not know anyone there.
sentences.zh: 很多人覺得搬到新城市很有壓力，尤其是在那裡不認識任何人的時候。

sentences.en: The training teaches staff how to stay calm in a stressful situation with an angry customer.
sentences.zh: 訓練教員工面對生氣的顧客時，如何在緊張的情況下保持冷靜。

sentences.en: The weeks before the product launch were stressful, but the team managed to finish everything on time.
sentences.zh: 產品上市前的那幾週壓力很大，但團隊還是設法準時完成了所有工作。

sentences.en: Some employees find giving presentations stressful, so the company offers a course on public speaking.
sentences.zh: 有些員工覺得做簡報很有壓力，所以公司開設了公開演講的課程。

words.note: 語塊：stressful job（壓力大的工作）、stressful situation（緊張的情況）、find sth stressful（覺得……很有壓力）。stressful 是「讓人有壓力的（事物）」；stressed 是「（人）感到有壓力的」。

sentences.en: The company was confronted with a serious problem when its main supplier suddenly closed last year.
sentences.zh: 主要供應商突然倒閉時，公司面臨了一個嚴重的問題。

sentences.en: New managers are often confronted with difficult decisions during their first few months in the job.
sentences.zh: 新任經理在上任頭幾個月常常面臨困難的決定。

sentences.en: The small town was confronted with a shortage of doctors after the local hospital reduced its staff.
sentences.zh: 當地醫院裁員後，那個小鎮面臨醫生短缺的問題。

sentences.en: When confronted with an angry customer, staff should listen carefully and try to find a solution.
sentences.zh: 面對生氣的顧客時，員工應該仔細聆聽並設法找到解決辦法。

sentences.en: The airline was confronted with many complaints after it canceled dozens of flights during the storm.
sentences.zh: 航空公司在暴風雨期間取消了數十班航班後，面臨了大量投訴。

words.note: 語塊：be confronted with（面臨……）。be confronted with 是「必須面對（問題）」；be faced with 意思相同。

sentences.en: The CEO gave an inspiring speech about the company's future at the end of the annual meeting.
sentences.zh: 執行長在年度大會的最後，發表了一場關於公司未來的鼓舞人心的演講。

sentences.en: The magazine published an inspiring story about a woman who started a successful business at the age of sixty.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌刊登了一個激勵人心的故事，講一位六十歲才創業成功的女性。

sentences.en: Employees describe Ms. Patel as an inspiring leader who always encourages them to try new ideas.
sentences.zh: 員工形容 Patel 小姐是一位啟發人的領導者，總是鼓勵他們嘗試新點子。

sentences.en: Many visitors find the museum's exhibition about space travel very inspiring, especially young students from local schools.
sentences.zh: 很多參觀者覺得博物館的太空旅行展覽非常激勵人心，尤其是年輕學生。

sentences.en: The conference will end with an inspiring talk by an athlete who won three gold medals.
sentences.zh: 研討會將以一位贏得三面金牌的運動員的激勵演講作結。

words.note: 語塊：inspiring speech（鼓舞人心的演講）、inspiring story（激勵人心的故事）、inspiring leader（啟發人的領導者）。inspiring 是「讓人受鼓舞的（事物）」；inspired 是「（人）受到啟發的」。

sentences.en: The government will give a tax break to companies that build factories in less developed areas.
sentences.zh: 政府將提供減稅優惠給在較不發達地區設廠的公司。

sentences.en: Families with young children can receive a tax break to help pay for childcare and education.
sentences.zh: 有幼童的家庭可以獲得減稅優惠，幫忙支付托育和教育費用。

sentences.en: The new tax break for electric cars has led to a large increase in sales this year.
sentences.zh: 電動車的新減稅優惠讓今年的銷售大幅增加。

sentences.en: Small businesses that hire young workers may receive a tax break of up to ten percent.
sentences.zh: 聘用年輕員工的小企業最多可以獲得百分之十的減稅優惠。

sentences.en: Many economists believe that a tax break for homeowners would help the housing market recover.
sentences.zh: 很多經濟學家認為給屋主減稅優惠會幫助房市復甦。

words.note: 語塊：give a tax break（提供減稅）、receive a tax break（獲得減稅）。tax break 是「政府給的減稅優惠」；tax advantage、tax incentive 意思接近。

sentences.en: The company holds team-building events every year to strengthen relationships between employees in different departments.
sentences.zh: 公司每年舉辦團隊建立活動，加強員工之間的關係。

sentences.en: The government hopes that the new trade agreement will strengthen the economy and create more jobs.
sentences.zh: 政府希望新的貿易協定能強化經濟並創造更多工作機會。

sentences.en: After the break-in last month, the building manager decided to strengthen security at every entrance.
sentences.zh: 上個月遭竊後，大樓管理員決定加強每個入口的保全。

sentences.en: Regular meetings with clients help us strengthen relationships and understand their needs and concerns better.
sentences.zh: 定期和客戶開會幫助我們加強關係，更了解他們的需求。

sentences.en: The bank plans to strengthen security on its website by asking customers to use stronger passwords.
sentences.zh: 銀行計畫要求顧客使用更強的密碼，加強網站的安全性。

words.note: 語塊：strengthen relationships（加強關係）、strengthen the economy（強化經濟）、strengthen security（加強保全）。strengthen 是 strong 的動詞；weaken 是相反詞「削弱」。

sentences.en: In the long term, investing in new technology will help the company reduce its costs and grow faster.
sentences.zh: 長期來看，投資新科技會幫助公司降低成本並成長得更快。

sentences.en: Prices may rise slightly in the short term, but experts expect them to fall again by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 價格短期內可能小幅上漲，但專家預期年底前會再下降。

sentences.en: The mayor was elected for a term of four years and plans to focus on improving public transportation.
sentences.zh: 市長當選一屆四年的任期，打算把重點放在改善大眾運輸上。

sentences.en: Please avoid using a technical term that customers may not understand when you write the product description.
sentences.zh: 撰寫產品說明時，請避免使用顧客可能看不懂的專業術語。

sentences.en: Hiring more staff will cost money in the short term, but it will improve our service in the long run.
sentences.zh: 短期內增聘人手會花錢，但長遠來看能改善我們的服務。

words.note: 語塊：in the long term（長期來看）、in the short term（短期內）、a term of（為期……的任期）、technical term（專業術語）。term 可以是「期間、任期」或「術語」；複數 terms 常指合約「條款」，in terms of 是「就……而言」。

sentences.en: After an exhausting day of meetings, the sales team went to dinner at a restaurant near the hotel.
sentences.zh: 開了一整天會、累人的一天之後，業務團隊去飯店附近的餐廳吃晚餐。

sentences.en: The flight from New York to Singapore was exhausting, so Ms. Lee rested for a day before starting work.
sentences.zh: 從紐約飛新加坡的航程很累人，所以李小姐先休息一天才開始工作。

sentences.en: Working on a construction site in the summer can be physically exhausting for many people.
sentences.zh: 夏天在工地工作，對很多人來說體力上可能很累。

sentences.en: Moving all of the furniture to the new office was an exhausting job that took the whole weekend.
sentences.zh: 把所有家具搬到新辦公室是一件累人的工作，花了整個週末。

sentences.en: The training course was exhausting, but the participants said they learned a lot of useful skills.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程很累人，但學員說他們學到很多實用的技能。

words.note: 語塊：an exhausting day（累人的一天）、an exhausting trip（累人的旅程）、physically exhausting（體力上很累的）。exhausting 是「讓人很累的（事物）」；exhausted 是「（人）筋疲力盡的」。

sentences.en: Several runners suffered from exhaustion because of the extremely hot weather during the city marathon on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 因為馬拉松期間天氣極熱，好幾位跑者體力透支。

sentences.en: Working long hours without enough rest can lead to physical exhaustion and serious health problems for workers.
sentences.zh: 長時間工作又沒有足夠休息，可能導致體力透支和健康問題。

sentences.en: The nurses were close to exhaustion after working several night shifts in a row during the flu season.
sentences.zh: 流感季期間連續上了好幾個夜班後，護士們幾乎筋疲力盡。

sentences.en: The company introduced flexible hours to prevent stress and exhaustion among its employees in the busy season.
sentences.zh: 公司推出彈性工時，防止員工出現壓力和過度疲勞。

sentences.en: The doctor said that her headaches were caused by exhaustion and recommended that she take a week off.
sentences.zh: 醫生說她的頭痛是過度疲勞造成的，建議她休息一週。

words.note: 語塊：suffer from exhaustion（筋疲力盡）、physical exhaustion（體力透支）、close to exhaustion（幾乎筋疲力盡）、caused by exhaustion（過度疲勞造成）。exhaustion 是名詞「極度疲勞」；exhaust 是動詞「使筋疲力盡；耗盡」，也指汽車「廢氣」。

sentences.en: If you have any problems with your order, please call the customer hotline at any time.
sentences.zh: 如果你的訂單有任何問題，請隨時撥打客服專線。

sentences.en: The city set up a 24-hour hotline for residents who need help during the storm.
sentences.zh: 市政府為暴風雨期間需要幫助的居民設立了二十四小時專線。

sentences.en: Customers can call the hotline to report a lost credit card and receive a new one within three days.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以打專線掛失信用卡，三天內就能收到新卡。

sentences.en: The company's customer hotline is open from eight in the morning until ten at night every day.
sentences.zh: 公司的客服專線每天早上八點到晚上十點都有人接聽。

sentences.en: Employees who see a safety problem in the factory should call the safety hotline immediately.
sentences.zh: 在工廠發現安全問題的員工應該立刻打專線通報。

words.note: 語塊：call the hotline（打專線）、customer hotline（客服專線）、24-hour hotline（二十四小時專線）。hotline 是「緊急或客服專用電話」；helpline 意思接近。

words.meaning: 營業中的；開放的；未決定的

sentences.en: The new library will be open to the public every day from nine in the morning until eight at night.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館每天早上九點到晚上八點對外開放。

sentences.en: The pharmacy on Main Street is open until midnight, so you can buy medicine late in the evening.
sentences.zh: Main 街那家藥局營業到午夜，所以晚上很晚也可以買藥。

sentences.en: Despite the heavy snow, most stores in the shopping center will remain open as usual this weekend.
sentences.zh: 儘管下大雪，購物中心大部分商店這個週末仍照常營業。

sentences.en: The position will remain open until a qualified candidate is found, so please share the ad with friends.
sentences.zh: 這個職缺會一直開放到找到合格人選為止，所以請把廣告分享給朋友。

sentences.en: The museum's new garden is open to the public on weekends, but it is closed during the week.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新花園週末對外開放，但平日不開放。

words.note: 語塊：open to the public（對外開放）、open until（營業到）、remain open（繼續營業）。open 當形容詞是「開著的、營業中的」；opening 是名詞「開幕；職缺」。

sentences.en: Only registered users can download the reports and watch the training videos on our website.
sentences.zh: 只有註冊使用者可以在我們網站上下載報告和觀看訓練影片。

sentences.en: Important documents such as contracts should be sent by registered mail so that you can track them.
sentences.zh: 合約等重要文件應該用掛號信寄出，這樣你才能追蹤。

sentences.en: All registered members will receive an email with a special discount code early next week.
sentences.zh: 所有註冊會員下週都會收到一封附有特別折扣碼的電子郵件。

sentences.en: The number of registered users of the app has doubled since the company added new features last spring.
sentences.zh: 自從公司去年春天增加新功能後，App 的註冊使用者人數增加了一倍。

sentences.en: Please send the signed form by registered mail to our office in Taipei before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 請在月底前把簽好的表格用掛號信寄到我們台北的辦公室。

words.note: 語塊：registered users（註冊使用者）、registered mail（掛號信）、registered members（註冊會員）。registered 是「已登記的」；register 是動詞「註冊」；registration 是名詞。

sentences.en: The company offers a generous retirement plan to all employees who have worked there for five years.
sentences.zh: 公司為所有工作滿五年的員工提供優渥的退休金計畫。

sentences.en: We are planning a retirement party for Mr. Lopez, who has worked at the bank for thirty-five years.
sentences.zh: 我們正在為在銀行工作了三十五年的 Lopez 先生籌備退休派對。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim decided to take early retirement so that she could spend more time with her grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 金小姐決定提早退休，好有更多時間陪孫子。

sentences.en: Financial experts recommend that young workers start saving for retirement as early as possible in their careers.
sentences.zh: 理財專家建議年輕上班族盡早開始存退休金。

sentences.en: The new retirement plan allows employees to choose how much of their salary to save each month.
sentences.zh: 新的退休金計畫讓員工可以選擇每個月存多少薪水。

words.note: 語塊：retirement plan（退休金計畫）、retirement party（退休派對）、early retirement（提早退休）。retirement 是名詞；retire 是動詞「退休」；retiree 是「退休人員」。

sentences.en: Good managers know how to delegate tasks so that they have time to focus on planning.
sentences.zh: 好的經理懂得分派工作，讓自己有時間專注於規劃。

sentences.en: The director decided to delegate responsibility for the new project to her most experienced assistant.
sentences.zh: 總監決定把新專案的責任交給她最有經驗的助理。

sentences.en: If you are too busy, you should delegate some of your work to other members of the team.
sentences.zh: 如果你太忙，應該把部分工作分派給其他組員。

sentences.en: Many new managers find it difficult to delegate tasks because they worry about the quality of the work.
sentences.zh: 很多新任經理覺得很難分派工作，因為他們擔心工作品質。

sentences.en: The CEO will delegate responsibility for daily operations to the managing director while she travels.
sentences.zh: 執行長出差期間會把日常營運的責任交給總經理。

words.note: 語塊：delegate tasks（分派工作）、delegate responsibility（授權負責）、delegate to（委派給）。delegate 當動詞是「把工作交給別人做」；當名詞是「代表」（重音不同）。

sentences.en: After reviewing all of the data, the committee came to a conclusion that the project should continue.
sentences.zh: 審閱所有資料後，委員會得出結論：專案應該繼續進行。

sentences.en: In conclusion, I would like to thank everyone who helped make this year's conference a great success.
sentences.zh: 總而言之，我要感謝每一位幫助今年研討會大獲成功的人。

sentences.en: Refreshments will be served in the lobby at the conclusion of the award ceremony on Friday evening.
sentences.zh: 週五晚上頒獎典禮結束時，大廳會提供茶點。

sentences.en: The researchers have not yet come to a conclusion about the cause of the problem with the machines.
sentences.zh: 研究人員對機器問題的原因還沒有得出結論。

sentences.en: The conclusion of the report recommends that the company invest more money in online advertising.
sentences.zh: 報告的結論建議公司在網路廣告上投入更多資金。

words.note: 語塊：come to a conclusion（得出結論）、in conclusion（總而言之）、the conclusion of（……的結束）。conclusion 是名詞；conclude 是動詞「下結論；結束」；conclusive 是「決定性的」。

sentences.en: The president of the association will give the concluding speech at the end of the conference.
sentences.zh: 協會理事長將在研討會最後發表結語演講。

sentences.en: The concluding session of the workshop will focus on how participants can use what they have learned.
sentences.zh: 工作坊的閉幕場次將聚焦在學員如何運用所學。

sentences.en: In the concluding chapter of the book, the author offers advice for people who want to start a business.
sentences.zh: 在書的最後一章，作者給想創業的人一些建議。

sentences.en: Please stay for the concluding session, where we will announce the winners of the design competition.
sentences.zh: 請留下來參加閉幕場次，我們會在那時宣布設計比賽的得獎者。

sentences.en: The concluding speech thanked all of the volunteers who helped organize the festival this year.
sentences.zh: 結語演講感謝了今年所有幫忙籌辦慶典的志工。

words.note: 語塊：concluding remarks（結語）、concluding session（閉幕場次）、concluding chapter（最後一章）。concluding 是「結束時的」；final 意思接近；conclusion 是名詞。

sentences.en: Applicants who meet the requirements for the position will be contacted for an interview next week.
sentences.zh: 符合職位要求的應徵者下週會接到面試通知。

sentences.en: The building does not meet the requirements for safety, so it must be repaired before people can use it.
sentences.zh: 那棟建築不符合安全要求，所以必須修好才能使用。

sentences.en: To meet the requirements for graduation, students must complete at least one internship at a local company.
sentences.zh: 為了符合畢業要求，學生必須完成至少一次實習。

sentences.en: Products that fail to meet the requirements set by the government cannot be sold in local stores.
sentences.zh: 未符合政府要求的產品不能在當地商店販售。

sentences.en: Our engineers will make sure that the new design will meet the requirements of the client.
sentences.zh: 我們的工程師會確保新設計符合客戶的要求。

words.note: 語塊：meet the requirements for（符合……的要求）、fail to meet the requirements（未符合要求）。meet 在這裡是「符合、達到」；satisfy the requirements、fulfill the requirements 意思相同。

sentences.en: The company will pay relocation expenses for employees who move to the new office in another city.
sentences.zh: 公司會為搬到其他城市新辦公室的員工支付搬遷費用。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed accepted the job in London because it came with a generous relocation package.
sentences.zh: Ahmed 小姐接受倫敦的工作，因為它附帶優渥的搬遷補助方案。

sentences.en: The relocation of the factory to the south will take about six months and cost several million dollars.
sentences.zh: 工廠遷往南部大約需要六個月，花費好幾百萬美元。

sentences.en: The human resources department can help employees find housing as part of the relocation package.
sentences.zh: 作為搬遷補助方案的一部分，人資部可以協助員工找住處。

sentences.en: Please submit your receipts for relocation expenses to the accounting office within thirty days of your move.
sentences.zh: 請在搬家後三十天內提交搬遷費用的收據。

words.note: 語塊：relocation expenses（搬遷費用）、relocation package（搬遷補助方案）、relocation of（……的搬遷）。relocation 是名詞；relocate 是動詞「搬遷、調任」。

sentences.en: The factory is replacing its outdated equipment with new machines that use much less electricity and make less noise.
sentences.zh: 工廠正在把老舊設備換成用電量較少的新機器。

sentences.en: Some of the information on the website is outdated, so please call our office to check the prices.
sentences.zh: 網站上有些資訊已經過時了，所以請打電話到我們辦公室確認價格。

sentences.en: Technology changes so quickly that many computers become outdated after only a few years of use.
sentences.zh: 科技變化快到很多電腦只用幾年就過時了。

sentences.en: The training manual contains outdated information and will be updated before the new employees arrive in May.
sentences.zh: 訓練手冊裡有過時的資訊，會在新員工到職前更新。

sentences.en: The hotel is renovating its rooms because many guests complained that the furniture was outdated.
sentences.zh: 飯店正在翻修客房，因為客人抱怨家具很老舊。

words.note: 語塊：outdated equipment（老舊設備）、outdated information（過時的資訊）、become outdated（變得過時）。outdated 和 out-of-date 意思相同；up-to-date 是相反詞「最新的」。

sentences.en: The train station was packed with travelers on the first day of the national holiday.
sentences.zh: 國定假日第一天，火車站擠滿了旅客。

sentences.en: The new smartphone is packed with features, including a powerful camera and a long-lasting battery.
sentences.zh: 新手機功能豐富，包括強大的相機和超長續航的電池。

sentences.en: The conference schedule is packed with workshops, so there is little free time between sessions.
sentences.zh: 研討會的行程塞滿了工作坊，所以場次之間幾乎沒有空檔。

sentences.en: The restaurant was packed with customers on Friday night, and many people had to wait outside.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳週五晚上擠滿了顧客，很多人只好在外面等。

sentences.en: The guidebook is packed with useful tips about where to eat, shop, and stay in the city.
sentences.zh: 這本旅遊指南塞滿了在城裡吃、買、住的實用建議。

words.note: 語塊：be packed with（擠滿……）、packed with features（功能豐富）。be packed with 是「裝滿、擠滿」；be crowded with 意思接近，偏指「人很多」。

sentences.en: The company plans to initiate a project to reduce energy use in all of its offices next year.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫明年啟動一項專案，減少所有辦公室的用電量。

sentences.en: Sales staff are trained to initiate a conversation with customers as soon as they enter the store.
sentences.zh: 銷售人員受過訓練，顧客一進店就主動和他們交談。

sentences.en: If you are interested in working with us, please feel free to initiate contact through our website.
sentences.zh: 如果你有興趣和我們合作，歡迎透過我們的網站主動聯絡。

sentences.en: The city will initiate a new recycling program that requires residents to separate their garbage.
sentences.zh: 市政府將推行一項新的回收計畫，要求居民垃圾分類。

sentences.en: The manager asked Ms. Lin to initiate contact with several suppliers in Vietnam to compare prices.
sentences.zh: 經理請林小姐主動聯絡幾家越南的供應商比較價格。

words.note: 語塊：initiate a project（啟動專案）、initiate a conversation（開啟對話）、initiate contact（主動聯絡）。initiate 比 start、begin 正式；initiative 是名詞「主動性；新計畫」。

sentences.en: Every apartment in the building must have a smoke detector that is tested once a month.
sentences.zh: 大樓的每一戶都必須有一個每月測試一次的煙霧偵測器。

sentences.en: All visitors must walk through a metal detector before they enter the concert hall on Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 所有訪客進入音樂廳前都必須走過金屬探測器。

sentences.en: The factory will install a detector that warns workers when the air contains dangerous chemicals.
sentences.zh: 工廠將安裝一個偵測器，在空氣中含有危險化學物質時警告工人。

sentences.en: Please replace the batteries in your smoke detector at least once a year to make sure it works.
sentences.zh: 請至少每年更換一次煙霧偵測器的電池，確保它正常運作。

sentences.en: Security staff at the airport use a metal detector to check passengers and their bags.
sentences.zh: 機場的安檢人員用金屬探測器檢查乘客和他們的行李。

words.note: 語塊：smoke detector（煙霧偵測器）、metal detector（金屬探測器）、install a detector（安裝偵測器）。detector 是「偵測的機器」；detective 是「偵探」；detect 是動詞「偵測」。

sentences.en: The factory produces a small electronic component that is used in smartphones and laptops around the world.
sentences.zh: 那座工廠生產一種全世界手機和筆電都使用的小型電子零件。

sentences.en: Good communication is a key component of successful teamwork in any large company or organization.
sentences.zh: 良好的溝通是任何公司成功團隊合作的關鍵要素。

sentences.en: The price of the car increased because one important component had to be imported from overseas.
sentences.zh: 汽車價格上漲了，因為一個重要零件必須從海外進口。

sentences.en: Training is a key component of our plan to improve customer service in all of our stores.
sentences.zh: 訓練是我們改善所有門市客服計畫中的關鍵要素。

sentences.en: Each component of the machine is tested carefully before it is assembled in the factory.
sentences.zh: 機器的每個零件在工廠組裝前都經過仔細測試。

words.note: 語塊：electronic component（電子零件）、key component（關鍵要素）、component of（……的組成部分）。component 是「組成整體的一部分」；part 是一般說法；element 意思接近。

sentences.en: The manager will visit the construction site every week to check on the progress of the new building.
sentences.zh: 經理每週都會到工地查看新大樓的進度。

sentences.en: Could you call the supplier to check on the status of our order before the end of the day?
sentences.zh: 你可以在下班前打給供應商，確認我們訂單的狀況嗎？

sentences.en: The nurse comes into the room every few hours to check on the patients during the night.
sentences.zh: 護士晚上每隔幾小時就會進房間看看病人的狀況。

sentences.en: Please check on the delivery and let the client know if there will be any delays.
sentences.zh: 請確認一下送貨狀況，如果會有任何延誤請告知客戶。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant stopped by the office on Saturday to check on the new employees who were working overtime.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐週六順道到辦公室看看正在加班的新員工。

words.note: 語塊：check on the progress（查看進度）、check on sb（看看某人的狀況）。check on 是「確認某人或某事的狀況」；check in 是「報到、入住」；check out 是「退房、查看」。

sentences.en: The IT department will configure the settings on your new laptop before you start work on Monday.
sentences.zh: 資訊部會在你週一開始上班前，把你新筆電的設定調好。

sentences.en: It took the technicians two days to configure the system for the new office in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 技師花了兩天替東京的新辦公室設定系統。

sentences.en: The technician will configure the printers to print on both sides of the paper in order to save paper.
sentences.zh: 技師會把印表機設定成雙面列印，以節省紙張。

sentences.en: Please do not try to configure the network yourself, as mistakes can affect the entire office.
sentences.zh: 請不要自己嘗試設定網路，因為出錯會影響整個辦公室。

sentences.en: The app is easy to configure, so customers can start using it within a few minutes of downloading it.
sentences.zh: 這個 App 很容易設定，顧客下載後幾分鐘內就能開始使用。

words.note: 語塊：configure the settings（調整設定）、configure the system（設定系統）、configure the printers（設定印表機）。configure 是電腦用語「設定」；set up 意思接近；configuration 是名詞「配置」。

notes.note: 意思像 make（讓某人去做某事），但句型不同：prompt + 人 + to + 動詞（The rain prompted us to stay home.）；make + 人 + 動詞原形，不加 to（The rain made us stay home.）。make 較口語、帶「不得不」的感覺；prompt 較正式，指某件事成為原因、讓人決定去做。prompt 當形容詞是「迅速的」（a prompt reply）；放在名詞前通常是形容詞，後面接「人 + to + 動詞」就是動詞「促使」。

improve 和 enhance 意思很接近，都可以接 quality（品質）。improve＝把不好的變好、改善；enhance＝把本來就不錯的再提升、加強（例如 enhance the flavor 提升風味）。

語塊：outgoing／friendly personality（外向／親切的個性）、strong personality（個性很強）、personality traits（人格特質）。personality 也可以指「名人」（可數）：a TV personality（電視名人）、a well-known personality（知名人物）、a radio personality（電台主持人）。和 character 的差別：personality 偏外在個性，character 偏品格。別搞混 personnel（全體員工、人事）。
